He wants to be viewed as the Psych God he is.

One of only three professors I had at KU that truly felt cared, wanted to be there, and actually gave 100%. Engaging lectures, great jokes, accessible, and just overall fun to talk to even outside of class. I actually felt like a missed out the times I missed this class, which I tried my best to never do.

A well-respected teacher! If you pay attention to his lectures and take good notes, then you should pass his class. In this class, we did not use the book. The lectures are tangible to real life making the content easier to remember.

Dr. Ilardi is one of the most charismatic professors i've ever had and is definitely the reason I became a psych major. He's hilarious and genuinely cares about all of his students, he wants everybody to pass and makes it easy if you put in the effort. Best professor i've ever had and wish he taught more classes.
Best prof I've ever had, is always engaging and cares about how well you do. He is always wanting to see you outside of class and gives extra credit for coming to class.
My best professor so far. He was very passionate about everything he talked about and made every lecture interesting. Just study for the tests and do the paper and you'll be fine.
By far my favorite professor I've had at KU. He makes lectures interesting and cares about his students. He makes sure he learns everyones name and he gave out a lot of extra credit.

Super amazing professor. Very caring and really wants his students to do well. Attendance is not necessary as he posts videos of his lectures online; however, he does give out random extra credit just for showing up. Definitely a class to study hard for by rewatching lecture videos.

Truly my favorite teacher I have ever had. He is incredibly engaging, intelligent, and up to date on the most recent findings in his field of psychology. Not to mention he is hilarious and keeps his lectures fresh and entertaining every day. Highly recommend!!

Amazing teacher! Very engaging lectures, especially interesting because he uses patients he has met with as cool examples in class. He really cares about his students and makes an effort to meet each one
Amazing teacher! Very engaging lectures, especially interesting because he uses patients he has met with as cool examples in class. He really cares about his students, favorite teacher so far

Theres TONS of extra credit! Talk in class  extra credit point. The exams are NOT bard. Just study. He is the absolute best professor in the psyc dept. Hilarious. Talks to his students as if he was your bestie. He was the reason I switched my minor to psyc. Very interesting and exciting class!! He also did a TedX talk. Hes legit famous.
Honestly one of the most inspiring and creative teachers I've ever had as a student. He cares exceptionally about the subject and truly wants to get to know and help each of his students.

Dr. Ilardi has been my favorite professor thus far at KU. He is not only brilliant, but his lectures are engaging and he keeps it lively and interesting. Attendance is not required but all of the material covered in class are on the exam. I had no problem passing this class with flying colors because I actually liked learning from him. 11/10 GREAT
Love him to death.

His classes fill up so quickly because hes one of the best professors at KU. I learned so much in this class, and in 120. Great lectures, funny and never boring. Cares about students, and basically gives free counseling if you need it. Ilardi knows his stuff!

Clearly passionate about what he's teaching, and actually calls for student input throughout the course of the lecture. Yes, he might go off on tangents, but they almost always apply to the information in the lecture. Very approachable too.

He's definitely passionate about his work and seems quite knowledgable. However, I don't get the professor worship this man receives. His lectures are EXTREMELY tangential. He humble-brags like no other. I'm not offended by profanity, but he uses it so often that it comes off as unprofessional. Be a skeptic. Don't fall for the showmanship.

reviews.comment: One of my favorite teachers at KU. Very engaging with the class even though it was bigger, and really funny. He actually cares about you grasping the concepts and leaving the class having learned something important.

Ilardi is an amazing professor. He is extremely smart and I feel like he knows everything you ever need to know about psychology. He uses a lot of dad humor and he is always so excited to lecture. He made me change my minor to psychology! I am taking a class with him next semester and I can't wait. His classes fill up quick so snag him while u can!

Dr. Ilardi is the best professor at KU. I have taken psych 120 and psych 350 with him. He is so passionate about his work and makes the information so interesting. He cares about all of his students and wants to hear from them. He learns your names and gets to know students even in a huge lecture hall. 20/10 would recommend.
Best professor I've ever had

I took PSYC 120 my 1st semester of my freshman year and PSYC 350 my 2nd semester. I really love Ilardi! He provides plenty of opportunities for EC & will never finish each lesson on time, so expect EC lectures before each test. Don't have to go to class but GO! Take SUPER detailed notes  & make flashcards. Tests are hard so study! He is fast paced.

This man knows how to take what could be very boring material and make it seem interesting. He's SO passionate about his lectures, which is so refreshing from the "I don't want to be here" attitudes. He taught a big lecture, so it's hard to get to know students, but he still seemed to genuinely care about how everyone was doing. His class is great!

Attendance isn't mandatory, but you will want to go to this class. He is engaging, personable, and shows that he really cares about the students and has a passion for his field. You will need to take good notes, but the tests aren't incredibly difficult. In both courses, he has assigned a lengthy final paper, but it is fun. Also took PSYC120.

This professor made me want to become a psych major...  took psych 120 and looked forward to his lectures every single morning. He offers amazing advice throughout his course and you will be surprised how much you learn about yourself and others around you.

He is my favorite professor I have had at KU! I'm not even a psych major and I will be taking more of his classes because I truly enjoy going to his class. He is so nice and will do anything for his students, he wants everyone to be successful. As long as you understand the notes he gives in class you'll get an easy A.

Dr. Ilardi is well spoken, and well respected.  He has a lot of patience, and listens to his students.  His lectures are more of a dialogue, and you will likely immediately respect his opinion after meeting him.    Easy to relate to, funny, smart, and a compassionate person - which shows through his work.  I am really happy that I took his class.

He makes learning so fun and there is basically no homework and not textbook. It's all lecture based but he's really entertaining. I plan to take future courses of his as well. I completely recommend everyone experience this.

I absolutely loved Ilardi! I started with a psychology major so I took his psych 120 class and when I decided to change my major to something that has nothing to do with psych, I still took psych classes with him because he has a way of making the 90 minutes fun and interesting. It feels like story time that can be related to the material

Steve is by far one of the best professors at KU. All of his lectures are entertaining and engaging. He offers SO much extra credit, so if you don't pass, then you didn't try hard enough. If you didn't score well on tests, then you had optional papers that you could do to help your grade. He is a great guy and genuinely cares about his students!!!!

this guy is incredible! Even if you have no interest in psychology as a major, he will inspire you beyond belief. His class has been one of the most impactful on me yet and his lectures were all online to watch but they were just too good to miss actually physically being there. you would make a mistake to not consider this course.
Best teacher I've ever had. Makes the class really interesting while also making sure you understand the material.

Dr. Ilardi is absolutely AMAZING. Psyc 350 was my favorite class I've ever taken, and he was the best professor I ever had. You will learn truly valuable information that is sure to better your life and others. He knows exactly what he is talking about and really cares. His lectures are so interesting, you won't ever want to skip class.

Pay attention in lecture and take detailed notes. It was very easy to retain information from his engaging lectures so I only had to read through my notes once before each test. By far one of my favorite professors on campus. If you go to class, take decent notes, and go over them before the exam you'll do well. He tells real life stories that can help you understand the materials more, even though sometimes he gets sidetracked easily, but it's helpful and fun! Take the class! And don't buy the textbook, you won't use it.

Dr. Ilardi is my favorite professor at KU, and one of the few I'll remember years from now. Yes, his lectures are 'riveting', but you can also tell he really cares about his students, and WANTS them to do well. And even though he's brilliant, he's easy to talk to. He also knows his stuff, and backs up every point with cutting edge research.

Also, I double checked a lot of the information provided with actual doctors and credible sources and most of the material he taught was absolute fairy tale. He loved to make fun of doctors and was very full of himself. Seriously, I never need to see him again.
Dr. Ilardi is a great lecturer! His exams were a little bit more difficult than I was expecting, but he was very fair.

Ilardi is absolutely brilliant, he cares so much about his students and his lectures are fascinating. You don't have any work for the class except taking good notes during class to study. I've probably learned more in this class than all of my others combined, largely because he loves what he teaches and he shares real-life stories. So great

Best professor I have ever had. He is inspiring and moving. He is everything I hope to be in a psychologist someday. Take this class, change your life. Would take any class by him in a heartbeat. Do not need the book at all. I have gotten an 'A' on every test by taking in class notes. Gives extra credit, has study sessions before tests. TAKE IT.

I really enjoyed his lectures and found them interesting. Ilardi is much more out-going and less intimidating in lecture- meet with him in office hours and he is a different person. The paper at the end of the semester was tedious but not difficult per se. Attendance is not mandatory, but if people do not show up, he will not post lectures online.

This has been one of my favorite classes at KU. I usually don't write reviews unless I feel strongly about something. And, I strongly feel that Dr. Ilardi is an amazing professor. Attendance wasn't mandatory for this course, but I would go anyways as the lectures were interesting. Ilardi has a great sense of humor and cares about his students.
Great lecturer. I found his class so enjoyable that I wanted to be in class! Make sure to talk in class to get the extra credit points and put a lot of detail into your final paper.

Dr. Ilardi is an engaging and interesting professor. He has an opinion about everything and you'll learn a lot just listening to him speak. Tests are easy and straight forward. I took psych 360 from him in the fall and it was basically the same class twice. That's my only complaint really. The classes were way too similar.

Ilardi is a great professor! He is really passionate about what he does & he is very knowledgeable. He makes lecture fun and he's not bad on the eyes either. He's very helpful if you need it and his exams are funny. The class is not hard to pass if you pay attention. Overall, I had a great time in his class and I almost wish I could take it again.

Ilardi is by far my favorite professor at KU.  He makes the material very clear and easy to understand.  I have never actually enjoyed being in lecture until I took this class.  He truly wants everyone to succeed and if you attend lecture and pay attention you will do fine on the tests.  Truly a great man and wants everyone to succeed.  Fun class.

Ilardi has been my favorite professor at Ku and the reason I decided to get a minor in Psychology. He is by far the most engaging, intelligent, and enthusiastic professor I've seen take on a large lecture hall and have the entire class excited to learn.

Dr. Ilardi is by far my favorite professor at KU. His lectures are incredibly engaging and inspiring. He will make you want to become a Psychology major if you aren't already! Not sure where the reviews saying he's arrogant are coming from. I have to disagree! Overall, an awesome class over really cool material.

Dr. Ilardi is awesome. His perspective on mental illness, especially his position on depression is incredibly refreshing. He has so much experience and insight into this subject that he sometimes comes off as arrogant, but he is really just extremely well-versed in his field. Take this class if you need 300+ credit. Easy & interesting.
Arrogant.
He's great!

I took Abnormal Psych with Steve Ilardi 6 years ago, and I still carry so much of it with me. He's really amazing, and that class is wonderful. I'm now in grad school, and I can only hope for a professor that engages me the way Dr. Ilardi's lectures did. Take his class. You won't regret it!

This class has been the best class I have ever taken. Steve is one of the most intelligent members in the psychology department at KU. He knows his material extremely well and so any arrogance that may be seenheard can be excused. You do have to take notes for everything and you won't need the books at all. Take the class, you won't regret it.

If you need a 300+ level PSYC class, don't pass up the opportunity to take Dr. Ilardi's class. Hands down the most intriguing and capturing lectures you will attend on campus and he brings it every day. Tests can be a bit difficult but only if you aren't paying attention in class but he lets you drop your lowest test score anyway.

Ilardi doesn't make class attendance necessary, he does however make his lectures so interesting and entertaining that nobody ever wants to skip! This pertains to both his PSYC 120 and PSYC 350 courses. All in all I'd honestly say out of the four years i was in college (2 @ KSU/ 2 @ KU) Steve Ilardi is the best college professor I had

Ilardi was easily one of the best professors I've had at KU. He is well educated on the subject he is teaching, knows how to keep his lectures interesting, engaging and relatable, and is always willing to help students and encourages them frequently to utilize his office hours. I would definitely recommend his courses!

Ilardi is super interesting and definitely knows how to keep the class interested. Attendance isn't mandatory, but extremely helpful. He is a great teacher and really knows his stuff. The tests are weird and hard, but having him as a teacher is worth it.

Ilardi has more passion about his study than anyone else I have ever known. His lectures are so engaging I look forward to them days in advance. His tests are all fill in the blank (with a work bank) which can be kind of tricky if you don't study. Overall this man is phenomenal at teaching. His stories are great, they really help information stick.

I don't get the hype.He is so easily distracted it's frustrating.He cannot focus. We are almost in November and he has only covered anxiety disorders because he spends so  much time telling stories that aren't relevant. If you are a excited about abn.psyc try a different teacher because you'' only have time to learn about 2 classes of disorders.

350 words on one of the best/most brilliant professor/mentor/human I've ever met?  Instead of typing 350 words, I'm going to let destiny decide whether or not you choose to take this hugely popular class and allow it to change your life. All the hype on this page is weak compared to the class, you can't put it into words. P.S. Watch his TED talk ;)
Best professor I've ever had! He makes the course fair and interesting, and his enthusiasm is contagious. I didn't think it was possible for me to be any more interested in psychology, but he did it.

Excellent lecturer! You do not need to buy the book, but you do need to be in class and take detailed notes (even the random stuff). ANYTHING said in class is fair game for the exams. His grading is fair and he offers extra credit for struggling students. Loved attending his class!
"Duuuuuuude, you're standing on it!"

He is easily the BEST professor at KU. He knows what he is talking about and clearly LOVES what he does. Incredible teacher. Went to his office hours and was amazing there, too. TAKE HIS CLASS! You won't regret it!
FANTASTIC teacher. Seriously. TAKE HIS CLASS.
AWESOME TEACHER!

He is a GREAT teacher! He knows what he's talking about and can be pretty interesting. DO NOT BUY THE BOOK! You don't need it, it's a waste of money. For the tests, study EVERYTHING in your notes, make sure you remember examples given in class too. Overall, I loved him! Class was challenging but not impossible. Best teacher at KU!

Easily the best Psych professor at KU. Offers a challenging course and is always fun to listen to. He can be a little cocky, but he's never condescending and always makes students feel good about asking questions.

Hands down THE best professor I've had at KU. Dr. Ilardi is incredibly engaging and interesting. I looked forward to going to this class. Dr. Ilardi is truly an exceptional and entertaining professor. He has a very dynamic teaching style. All test questions come from lectures, so don't buy the textbook. TAKE THIS CLASS! You will NOT regret it.

I took both Abnormal and Personality Psych from Dr. Ilardi...very intelligent and easy to understand. I loved both classes and I think many students would find his lectures interesting and NOT boring in the least. The tests can be a bit challenging..but as long as you are coming to class & paying attention, you will do well! Best classes at KU!

Prof Ilardi is a great teacher. He's funny, passionate, intelligent, and he really knows his material.  Yes, he's got some swagger, but he also really cares about his students.  Easily one of the best profs at KU!

He is a good lecturer--there is no doubt about that. However, I don't get why everyone is so obsessed...he is very arrogant. I don't think he always means to be, but he definitely comes off that way, and it is slightly demeaning. Anyway, his tests are kind of hard; make sure you study EVERYTHING in your notes, even the random stuff.
He is a very good lecturer, even though he seems to be a bit full of himself. I did not study much and ended up with a B. His class is much easier than the other Abnormal Psych professor.

Best professor I have had thus far! You will love his lectures! Be in class and take good notes.  Textbook is helpful, but not mandatory.  Tests will be difficult if you do not engage in the class material.  ANYTHING from lecture is fair game on exams.   I highly recommend this class!

Dr. Ilardi is the best instructor I have ever had. He is engaging and exceptionally intelligent. His tests are derived completely from his lectures and his lectures are very interesting, so this is not a class you will want to miss.

Dr. Illardi is the most engaging professor I have ever had. He loves his job and teaching. Attending class will help your test scores although class is not mandatory and his lectures can be found on Blackboard. You will WANT to go to his class.
Best professor I've had at KU so far. Engaging, intelligent, and actually makes me want to learn the material.
Hands down the best professor at KU.  Literally, the only class I ever went to in which I was excited to attend every single day.  Five-Stars.

Fascinating class, almost too much so. You will often be tempted to just sit back and listen to what he is saying but anything he says is game for the exams so you need to constantly take notes (even if it seems like it's not going to be on the test!).  That being said, you don't even need to book since he does cover everything and more in class.
Excellent class
Can not say enough good things about Ilardi. He made every lecture interesting and he really cares about his students.

He is pretty great. He uses anecdotal examples that make the material really easy to remember. I never bought the textbook and am expecting an A in the class. Awesome, awesome guy. And really friendly!
Such a great teacher! I can actually listen through his lectures without dosing off. I suggest him to everyone
Ilardi is by far one of the best professors at KU. TAKE HIS CLASS

I took Dr. Ilardi's Psych 120 personality class and his Psych 350 abnormal class and he is by far the best proffessor I've ever had.  He knows his stuff, and is always interesting.  Lectures are not required but if you go to lecture the tests will be easy.  And you drop lowest test grade so you can skip one test for a little added bonus.
Great teach
Dr. Ilardi is by far the best teacher I've ever had. I've always had trouble attending classes, but I was always SO excited to go to his class every week. He is an amazing teacher - take his class!

He has been on of my favorite professors by far. Really great guy that really wants all of his students to do well and be involved in the class. The material is interesting and Ilardi makes it easy to stay engaged. Take this class!
Illardi is one of the most interesting teachers out there. He's passionate and well worth the money!!

Dr. Ilardi is phenomenal! His lectures are thought-provoking, interesting, and worth showing up to. He genuinely cares about his classes and students and it shows. Tests are easy if you show up to lectures. I'm sad that this is my last semester having him as a professor. He really is the best! I miss him already and my class isn't even over!

Ilardi is amazing! Best prof. I have had at KU. Almost made me consdier switching to a psych major. This class is one of my top favorites at KU. Ilardi is passionate about his teaching and it really shows. Interesting stuff and great prof! Take this class if you can!

Seriously one of the best teachers at KU.  His class is very interesting and fun, you don't want to miss it.  Pretty easy to, so long as you pay attention to what he is saying in class.  You don't really need to use your textbook, I never even opened mine, so you might not want to buy it.  Great class though, the best one I have taken so far at KU.

Dr. Ilardi is probably the most inspiring people I have ever met. He made me want to be a better person and his lectures were something I legitimately looked forward to every TR. He gives a lot of info without being boring.. Best teacher I have ever had and a phenomenal person all in one. I'm so sad I can't in his classes forever!

BEST TEACHER I'VE EVER HAD! Both my brother and sister advised me to take at least one of his classes while at KU, and I now see what they were talking about. The class was so interesting, I'm now considering changing my major to psychology. He is interesting, and always willing to talk to students after class. You will love him.

He is an AMAZING teacher. There is a reason there are no bad reviews. I never missed a class because every class was worth attending. You know a teacher is good when the front of the class fills up first and there is usually about 95% attendance.

One of the most engaging and entertaining teachers I've ever had. Go to class, you have to if you want to get a good grade but if you do and take good notes and review them a couple times nearly impossible to get a bad grade. Even the final project is interesting and easily able to exceed 10 page limit. Amazing teacher!

Easily one of the best professors I've ever had. Brilliant, interesting and a great teacher. Attendance wasn't mandatory and there were rarely in-class assignments or quizzes but 95% of students showed up every day because class was fascinating. Learned a lot. Loved it.

Well versed in his subject, he often inspired much discussion - impressive for a 300-person class.  He TAUGHT everything you needed to know, instead of telling you to just read, which was nice. His talks about medications and his TLC program got old. He made himself available but was sometimes slow on responding to emails. Recommended!
Sad to see the semester end, great teacher!

The absolute BEST teacher I've ever had! So awesome, he made the class and material extremely enjoyable. He really cares about his students well-being, and will do anything to help them. Always lots of students in class because he makes you not want to skip! Easy A if you go to class. Don't buy the textbook, you'll never open it once!
Seriously the BEST teacher I've ever had in college. He is hilarious, helpful, and a really good teacher. Learning the material was easy.
WONDERFUL prof! He conducts his class like a talk show complete with intro music and viewer mail, makes class fun and interesting.  Learned alot, with no homework/ readings.  Easy to get an A

After 4 years of college he is by far the best and most interesting teacher. He makes his lectures extremely interesting and it is a fun class to go to. His tests come exclusively from the notes you take during class.  As long as you take good notes they are easy. I recommend this class to anyone from any major for an elective.
Probably one of the best professors I've had so far. He is amazing, and very helpful.

I had this guy for psyc 120 and he was so good i took him again for psyc 350! He is my favorite teacher at college and is the reason i want to minor in psych now. He makes the class incredibly interesting and is hilarious. The tests are quite easy too if you pay attention at all in class. He really makes it fun to attend lecture!

Brilliant professor anyway you look at it and a nice guy to boot. Never once used the book (though I did glance through it and it can be used as a supplement to his lectures) and everything he puts on the tests comes from his lectures. Which works as his lectures are some of the most interesting & engaging you will find. Take this class.

Ilardi is unlike any other professor I've had. He is VERY friendly and opens the lecture of 300 up for discussion to better understand topics. I almost feel like he is a friend of mine though he doesn't know me. I'll miss the class. No info from the book is on the tests. Study well for the tests. Final is an opt test and a 10 pg paper.

My favorite teacher i have had in my entire lifetime! He made me decide to minor in psychology. Very hilarious and interesting. No text book use and Exams are very easy if you just take good notes. He makes students look forward to attending lectures... I was actually disappointed if i missed one of his lectures. VERY RECOMMENDED!

Dr. Ilardi is really awesome. His class is very interesting and fun to attend. The final project is very extensive and takes quite a bit of time. His tests are difficult, but he offers quite a bit of extra credit to boost your scores. Very fun and interesting class, but can be very difficult at times.
Awesome class, Awesome teacher. Some of the material can be challenging but Awesome. Nuff said.
Steve is amazing! His classes are extremely entertaining and informative. He is very helpful and he is an amazing person to encounter.

This was a very interesting class. I had no trouble staying awake (which I usually do) and paying attention. He relates class to personal experiences and stories. Class is interesting. Highly recommended.

This is a great teacher who is very engaging, organized and available if you have a question (even just for fun).  Everything he covers in class might appear on the test, so show up for all the lectures and take detailed notes.  The book is not used and I haven't even opened it.

Take this class!!!! He is one of the best teachers i have ever had. the hardest part about this class is that it was on thursday and i would be all hungover from dollar night but it was still interesting to me once i got there, if you go to class and take good notes, he wont surprise you with the tests and you dont have to read a page in the book

If you're contemplating taking this class, it's a no brainer: you will not regret having ilardi.  Personally, he's my favorite professor I had at KU.  The test are 100% from lecture, so you should attend every one.  However, his lectures are the most interesting of any i've had at KU (both the topic and him are superb).  Take this class.

He is an excellent professor of psychology. He uses relatable stories and makes class fun when he knows it is getting boring. However, he lets lots of annoying people talk and ask questions. I wish he would use an example he knew was correct sometimes then letting some annoying girl bring up an irrelevant example.

Absolutely amazing professor.  I've never lost interest in a single lecture.  Fascinating stories, interesting points, clear info, and overall very helpful while still being agreeable and kind.  I highly recommend going to every lecture -- lots of stuff on tests is only covered in-class, plus it's so interesting!  Never a waste of time.

I adore Dr. Ilardi.  I loved going to his class! Everyone was upset on the last day of class; I saw a girl in tears.  He's that awesome.  You must take this course! It will probably be the best decision you make as an undergrad at KU.
Absolutely awesome class.  I learned so much, and it was always fascinating.
best teacher at KU

best professor i ever had! take good notes & your set. textbook is never used but still very interesting to skim through. he is an amazing public speaking and is so engaging in the lectures that you will be excited for "another riveting installment of psyc 120!"
Hands down, best teacher there is. All I can say is you have to take his class.
Dr. Ilardi is awesome! he knew what he was talking about and made the topics interesting. he gets into his lectures and makes sure you do too. best teacher ive ever had. take his class!!

I have to admit that I was not enrolled in his class, but attended almost every class period.  I loved going to his lectures.  Very entertaining and informational.  Has to be the best professor on the KU campus!

Dr. Ilardi is the best teacher I have EVER had!  He is so interesting & knows so much about the subject.  If you go to class every time and take good notes you can easily get an A in the class.  Also, if you take good notes you don't need the book.  I bought it and never even used it b/c I learned it all in his lectures.

Steve is probably the best professor at KU. I really enjoyed this class, it was both interesting and manageable. The tests were very easy and I got A's on every one which allowed me to opt out of the final. There is a final project which consists of a 10 page (at least) paper, demonstrating your knowledge of the class. It was actually really cool.
best teacher ive ever had
cool
He is awesome! Easy to understand and interacts so well. Besides that he's entertaining. He'll make you laugh everytime! I actually wanted to go to his class. I highly recommend him.

I took this class last semester, and it was one of the greatest classes i've ever taken.  The ta's are awesome too. Ilardi and the TA's had a competition to memorize everyones face with their names in the 300 person class.  tests are all essay, but the TA's offer review sessions where they basically give you almost all the answers! TAKE THIS CLASS!
He rules!
Great prof, keeps everyones interst. Makes class fun;-)
I never miss a class! Each day is so interesting, and he makes it fun to learn it! One of the best professors ever! Even if you don't major in psychology..take this class!

Dr. Ilardi is by FAR the best professor I have ever had while being in college. He is engaging, he has a lot of actual student participation during class (it works even in the large class), and he has a passion for what he does. You fall in love with the GOOD of psychology because of what he expresses. His energy and humor is the icing on the cake!
My favorite class of college so far! I looked forward to going everyday in large part due to Dr. Ilardi. He makes everything exciting and interesting.
VERY COOL TEACHER!!! HE HAS A WAY OF TEACHING THAT MAKES YOU WANT TO LEARN. HE IS VERY PASSIONATE ABOUT WHAT HE IS TEACHING. GREAT PERSONALITY AND VERY FUN CLASS!!!
Best professor I've ever had. Always kept the class interesting and was available anytime a student needed. Tests are pretty simple if you attend class and he makes it so you want to go to class.

Best class ever, maybe the most important pysch class you can take at KU. Inspires dozens to be psych majors and grad students every year, and that has a great deal to do with Ilardi. Expect information that's at the grad level to be understood easily.
Great teacher! I loved going to this class, he teaches to students level and is really funny.Brian his TA was hot too
Great Class, I loved it and he kept my interest which is hard to do!! Really interesting and I would recommend this class to anyone, definitely one of my fav. teachers at KU.
SOO GOOD!  I loved this class....VERY easy if you go to class.  Ilardi was awesome, adorable, and fun.
he is an really funny teacher, and makes every class really interesting
loved it!!
No Comments
Dr. illardi is EXTREMELY funny.. tests are all essay, but if you go to the review sessions they tell you what the essays are, class is never boring!

Ilardi is fabulous. I wasn't TOO interested in PSYCH, but heard it was a fun class and by far it has been my favorite class + teacher out of many classes that I've had here at KU. He's fun and very into it. He uses personal stories also, so it makes you feel like you can speak in front of 300 people without being nervous.
awesome class!  life changing!  Take it!

Unlike Holmes, I took two classes from Illardi, and loved every minute of them. I think he's a great teacher with enthusiasm for the subjects he teaches. I really enjoyed Personality (psych 120); even writing the long analysis paper at the end was fun. I l
No Comments
Great enthusiasm for the subject, extremely helpful in and out of class, good sense of humor.

He's a fun teacher that made sitting in class for 1hour20 mins fun and interesting. The test are kinda hard, but I actually enjoyed the class and thought it was very interesting. Take this class--or any class he teaches!

He is a great guy and a very smart man in his field.    He makes class fun and has a great sense of humor. His tests aren't the easiest thing though. Some questions have choices a-i which makes it hard. He talks a lot from his head which makes it hard to right everything down. But get him for a prof
AWESOME BRILLIANT PROF! He definately deserves the H.O.P.E. Everyone shold take is class, is easy, is fun, is informative!
He is honestly the best teacher I've ever had.  He is very smart and funny.  He made going to class a great experience.  Definitely take a class from him if you get the chance!!!!!!!!

Ilardi is hyper. hilarious. brilliant.  Two one-page papers.  about 300 students and he tries to learn everyone's name!  plays music before each lecture.  I think he's better than Holmes.  Holmes gets mixed reviews, but everyone loves Ilardi.
He's an excellent teacher
The dude is good, oh yes, he is good - but going bald
brilliant!
Great teacher
very easy to listen to and understand, totally interested and knowledgeable in his field
No Comments
Incredibly smart!
No Comments
No Comments

The class itself is not that hard. However, her teaching is very unorganized and rubrics for upcoming assignments made no sense. Pop quizzes weren't very hard if you did your reading. However, if you missed one because you were sick she will not let you make it up. She wasn't the worst professor in the world, but I wouldn't recommend her.

Janet is extremely picky and has her favorites, but she has an extensive background in advertising and public relations, and shares a lot from her experiences. She is a decent professor, but if you ever underperform, she will make your semester a living hell. Just make sure you participate and read the books and you'll end with a decent grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Janet is VERY rude. She does not care if you have a doctors note she will not excuse absences or let you take tests. She puts your name in orange or red if youve missed a class. She also changes your groups about every class. Pop quizzes are easy but there is ALOT of reading. She is not nice and will pick on you in class. No HW just the quiz/final
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Dr. Rose is very intelligent and knows a lot about the advertising world. Although she is one of the most intimidating professors I have had (I say as I am about to graduate), she genuinely taught me a lot. Get ready to present every day. This class is hard, but read the book and actively listen and you will be fine. Attendance is necessary.

Janet was a horrifying professor. She was downright cruel and would pit students against each other constantly. The students in her NSAC class were berated to the point they would cry, and she regularly threatened to fail them. These students would stay at the school until well past midnight, I think the latest I heard about was 4 am. AVOID.

"Putting in the work" isn't enough for Janet. After communicating thoroughly, never missing class, and participating daily, I was still not one of her preferred students. After a month of advance notice that I was under contract and not able to attend the midterm, she failed me and made the rest of the semester hell. Has zero regard for students.

Where is Professor I have ever experienced, just straight rude, and mean to her students. I watched somebody cry from words said by Janet. She enjoys watching her students fail and enjoys failing them. I maintained a good grade throughout the entire semester and decent attendance, but she failed me for no reason. Do not take this class!!!

not my favorite class or teacher, very vague and rude and disrespectful. I think if she doesn't like you, it's painfully obvious. Never seemingly satisfied, I cannot tell if the work that we gave was just never good enough or simply needed more work based on her having real-world experience. No tech/notes, no nothing but maintains written tests...

This class was my introduction to the J school and its the only class i've ever actually looked forward to. Janet is definitely an acquired taste, instructions will be vague but that forced me to be more creative and think more. Also, she is not gonna sugar coat anything AT ALL, but wouldn't you rather hear the truth and make yourself better?
Shes weird and mean
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The worst professor I ever had throughout my academic career at KU. So incredibly rude and all over the place. The class is hard to follow because she does not follow her own instructions. Cuts students off and interrupts them all the time, watched her cut someone off and tell them to sit down during their presentation because she didn't like it.

I took both J260 and J340 with Dr. Rose my freshman year and did fine in them. I found that if she likes you, she's not that bad to deal with, but if she doesn't like you... different story. Her method of teaching was all over the place, and the class was pretty hard to follow. She's very knowledgeable in the advertising field, but not a good prof.

She wants the best for her students and gives constructive feedback without sugarcoating anything, and I appreciate that. Assignment guidelines aren't always clear, but I get a clear answer when I ask for one. She rewards effort put in rather than knowledge of every little thing. Would've liked more time for hefty assignments.

If I could give Janet Rose a 0/5 I would. Having to see Dr. Rose twice a week was soul crushing and caused a decline in my confidence. Aside from her personality, she was a relatively easy grader and she definitely knew what she was talking about. She should not be shaping young minds, but would be super successful in the advertising world.
If she reminds you of president coin get ready cuz she teaches this class like it too. Bad feedback, confusing hidden motives and backhanded statements, overall terrible would not recommend

I can not recommend enough against taking this course. Dr. Rose does not have the patience or clarity to be teaching. At the end of the class, everyone in our final group wrote our teacher reviews together.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Great professor
Professor rose is a great professor, as long as you put in the work she is very helpful.

Dr. Rose is my favorite professor at KU. It's all about communication with her. Her criticism is all to help you grow. I've had her for three courses now and I can confidently say she's pushed me to be a more well-rounded and open-minded person. She also has a top-notch sense of humor and a big heart for students who just put in the work.

Not what I expected this class to be. Reminded me a lot of a film class. Books are required with a reflection. You present an AD and a movie to the class. Very unorganized course, very judgmental and not understanding!  She assigned a huge project over spring break due the Monday after. Gave us only one week to complete the final group project.

Janet thrives off of being feared by students and has zero respect for anyone that doesn't agree with her. She is not helpful in class and rarely gives positive feedback. She's disconnected from reality and has no empathy, even for the most motivated students. Don't get me wrong, shes very knowledgeable in her field, but she shouldnt be a professor

The most disrespectful, heartless, and malicious professor I have ever had in my years at KU. Although the material in this class was fascinating and she's an easy grader, she ruined every day by publicly humiliating her students and providing zero grace in any situation. Stay far away lol

Janet is an acquired taste. I found her to be quite odd and off-putting. Her class was not difficult -- read a book and write a response, then apply book's contents in class. She is an easy grader and if you put in the work you get an A. LOTS of group work and she's not afraid to tell you when you're wrong in front of the whole class!!

Janet is mean, cold-hearted, and not accommodating at all. After explaining to her that I missed a few classes due to my clinical depression that hospitalized me, she would not grant me an incomplete as it was "my fault I missed class" and I have to complete my final project alone, which is usually completed by a group of around 5 or 6 members.

This course is pretty hard. It takes quite a bit of brain power. She purposely structures it like a real-world ad agency job. The class mainly consists of papers over reading, a mid-term group project, and a final group project. If you pay attention, you'll be fine. She doesn't grade very hard, but she critiques in class pretty hard.

Professor Rose is well-versed in the field of advertising. Grades consist of papers that go over readings, the mid-term and the final project. She grades the papers very easily and the other projects somewhat easily as well. Her instructions are typically very unclear and while she is open to questions, the responses are not clear and change often

Janet does have a lot of experience in the field of advertising. The class itself is heavily lecture-based and is accompanied by research papers and readings (do them bc there are pop quizzes). There is a final group project at the end, which I found that her teaching was lacking. Instructions were kind of unclear and she never gave clear feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: Janet is obviously very experienced in her field and knows a lot about it but I find her teaching is lacking. She is very confusing and unclear about instructions. For the big final project, many things were left out of the instructions sheet. She's an okay person, I'm just not fond of her teaching style. Do the readings, there are quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Her class was okay, but honestly I found myself so unbelievably confused and directions were never clear. I would ask her questions of clarification and receive such vague answers that I did not understand. Her projects she would think she was explaining well, but it was so confusing. This was the main issue, lack of clear directions.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Just a note: This class will be J5XX from now on.  Janet is incredibly successful in the real world. She brings a wealth of experience to KU and is a stealthy genius. She's energetic, knows her stuff and will help you with anything if you just ask.  Reading is really interesting but you'll ace most quizzes without it. Up to you.

The workload is packed into the second half of the semester. Little to no structure in his syllabus (which he did not follow) and assignments graded very late. Ironic because he assigned a 15 page paper with a 15-20 min presentation to follow. No heads up for the presentation aspect. For a guy who doesn't like to grade, he sure assigns a lot!

Very kind guy but an egregiously awful professor. Up until the final day that grades were due, I had a single 15 point grade in the grade book, he didn't follow his own syllabus or grade distribution AT ALL and he has not answered a single one of my emails ALL SEMESTER. Kind man who should not be a professor!

Very unclear guidelines for his class, continuously asks students to tell him what activities we want to have in class. He emails our reading assignments one or two days before class. He does not stick to his syllabus. Every time I raised my hand to answer a question I would be cut off after one word, and would respond in a condescending manner.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor was single-handedly the worst Spanish professor I have ever had at KU. He took months to grade anything and the grading was harsh. He will call on you in class but claims participation is not mandatory. The readings were so difficult and essays. His questions are hard to understand sometimes what he is asking. Would not recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He almost never lets class out early. He also struggled to follow his own schedule, and graded things extremely late.

I think that Professor Mayhew is a nice guy. However the class felt very unorganized and we never followed the syllabus. He took over 2 months to put a simple test grade for me. The content was a little difficult, but we never had quizzes and lectures were boring. He responds to questions nicely. If you do your work and show up, the class is fine.

Study abroad prof. The course materials were written by Argentine authors, but the course was taught as if it was at KU/online. He did not take advantage of the fact that we actually *were in* Buenos Aires. Students would benefit if he would incorporate the parks/museums/cafes into the assignments along with exploring career options in Argentina

Prof. Mayhew is a very nice guys, but his teaching technique isn't very good.  He knows his Spanish very well, but didn't provide many useful assignments or activities.  He also was very unorganized.  However, he is a very fair and easy grader, so if you are just looking to take an easy class, he is your guy.

Nice guy. Terrible professor. Honestly I have never seen a professor put such little effort into their job. We rarely had assignments and when we did he never graded them. Absolutely no clue what my grade is. Lectures were dull and boring. If you are a Spanish major, I really recommend transferring. The majority of Spanish professors at KU are bad.

Kind of awkward and quite but he's very nice and tries to make jokes. Lecture will almost never get out early and it's very dry majority of the time, his voice is pretty monotone too so that doesn't help either. Doesn't use blackboard and isn't very punctual about returning essays but his feedback his typically pretty helpful.

Be wary of how long the class is--you will always have to be there for the entire class period, no matter what. He's really intelligent, kinda quite, and very knowledgeable. But sometimes you wont understand what he asks as questions during classroom discussion. He's usually pretty accepting when you have trouble with material.

Kind of a quite guy, but knowledgeable. He always requires you to know the reading, if you do not read, you will do horrible in the class. Decent grader, but he gives more slack on assignments if you attend class. If you miss class you will be completely lost on the topic.

Professor Kennedy is one of the best professors I've had at KU so far. He's very knowledgeable on the course topics and uses his experiences and research to teach the class. The in-class debates further the understanding of course topics. Although attendance isn't required, I'd highly recommend going. The 2 exams aren't too difficult if you study.

Professor Kennedy rocks. He knows what he's talking about and knows how to make class fun. POLS150 was engaging and one of my favorite classes. With the labs he creates a hands-on simulation for constitution building which is a blast. Take Kennedy if you can!!

I had Prof. Kennedy for my first year honors seminar (HNRS190), and it was absolutely fantastic in every respect. He knows so much about China and is excellent at teaching that information in an interesting, nuanced, and easy to understand way. I have literally zero complaints about Prof. Kennedy - he is what every college professor should be.
A very interesting and passionate guy. The class was engaging and involved real-world problems and solutions. I enjoyed this class and was engaged throughout the lectures and discussion groups.
He's an interesting dude; has said some questionable things, but overall is quite a good lecturer and I was never bored during class. I definitely learned a LOT in this class; definitely recommend.

As a seminar prof he couldnt be better. He was so knowledgeable about China but his way of storytelling makes it understandable and never condescending in the slightest. Workload is fairly light and hes incredibly reachable outside of class. One of my favorite profs so far!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I took him for an honors seminar, so I didnt get to spend too much time with him. He was very knowledgeable in what he knew about China, and every single class I was writing down a tons of information. We only had 3 three page essays for the entire semester, which isnt too bad for a credit hour class. Overall, I enjoyed the class.

In his intro political science class he introduces you to so many different cultures from a personal experience, his stories are awesome and he really enjoys what he does. I though it would be hard to match his enthusiasm at 9am but he doesn't dwell on topics too long. He also is very awesome at telling you what to study for on exams. just pay att

This professor did a good job providing a thorough look into China's recent political history, the developments over the last century and also trying to identify the nation's trajectory. Class was very informative, the lectures were great and assignments very fair and inspired critical thinking. Would definitely recommend to those interested.

He's a really great guy! I've had him for 3 courses over the period of 3 years and loved him every single time! Goes out of his ways to help you with everything. Always looks to assign the cheapest books but rarely ever used. If you go to class and follow his notes, you'll do great! Never did a ratemyprofessor but had to for Dr. Kennedy. Love him!

The best professor I've ever had!! He puts a good amount of notes online, but you really need to go to class to listen to this guy. He has amazing stories and lectures. So cool and nice. The class is super interesting. No homework. Tests are fine also.

Fascinating class, and Professor Kennedy is a great lecturer. You will learn a ton if you just show up and pay attention. The simulation at the end of the class is probably the best part of the whole semester. He is also very straightforward about what will be on the test. Not difficult to get an A.
DO NOT BUY THE TEXT BOOK. You will never use it. Just read over his lecture notes for the tests. He gives you study guides. Also, he is rad. Great teacher, great guy.
I have had about 10 different poli sci teachers in my time at ku and professor kennedy is the best one by far i advise you take all the classes that he teaches.
Great teacher. informative and loves what he teaches. he can tell u anything u want 2 know about china. fair tests

I have had Kennedy for three classes. He's interesting and insightful as a prof especially regarding China. Speaks the language, does a lot of research, etc. Everything on the test is in the study guide, and you learn a lot in his classes. Not a walk through by any means but not a stressful class either. Nice guy, will help you get a scholarship!

What a FANTASTIC professor! I had absolutely no interest in this topic before, and actually dreaded the class. Not only did he make each topic interesting, he showed how each is applicable to everyday life. I learned so many things that I will continue to use, probably forever!

He was by far one of my favorite teachers while I was at KU.  He always kept the material interesting and he knows a lot about what he's talking about which is so important.  He's really nice and helpful.
On the topic of Chinese politics, did far more to inform than other comparable classes.
Very interesting professor.  Knows his stuff.  If you go to class you will do well on his tests.  Not too difficult.

I took his class because of the comments on this website. I had very little interest in the topic beforehand and took the class purely to fulfill a requirement. This class ended up being one of my favorites at KU. He is INCREDIBLY knowledgeable and an all-around awesome teacher.
This guys is pretty great.  It is really easy to understand what he is saying and he doesn't try to talk over your head.  His tests are easy because he tells you exactly what you need to know.

Prof. Kennedy is, without a doubt, in the top 5 of the Poli-Sci faculty. He's always willing to help out and also loves to just have students stop by his office hours to catch up on what is going on with them. He truly cares. Great guy!
Really easy class, but does what he can to make it interesting. Always willing to help outside of class, and a great guy.

Best teacher in the dept. Helpful and enthusiastic about teaching- truly cares about the students. Knows subject well and has a lot to say about subject. All knowledge very current. The more you go to class and do the more you learn and he will explain anything to you in and out of class. Take this guy!

He is awesome. Goes out of his way to help if you need it. Gives out study guides before tests. You do have a write a 10-12 page paper, but you don't have to do much besides the two tests. He LOVES teaching and it shows! AWESOME Prof!
He makes it as easy as possible for you
Awesome professor. Super excited about the subject and it shows. You know what to expect on the tests. He's your man.
This professor is really easy, his tests are totally fair, and he wants you to do well AND he is really enthusiastic about his subject
This guy is fantastic. He is not only easy, but makes the class interesting and worth coming to. He is extremely helpful outside of class too, going well beyond his office hours.
EASY EASY EASY! Just read the online notes, go to class sometimes and do the homework. Such a helpful man.
I wouldn't take POLS 306 from anyone else.  Absolutely the easiest class I've taken in the pols department.
Extremely clear and helpful teaching style.  Tests are very straightforward and fair.

Mark was my teacher for ENGL102, and he's so chill and honestly a funny guy. The class almost always ended early and never took the whole class time. Easy grader and not much homework except unit essays. In class, he just talks, and then you leave. It's so chill and not a class you need to worry about.
Very hilarious, never a dull moment. He's very easy to talk to and would definently recommend taking his class. Not too much work in his class, and seems like a very knowledgeable guy.
He was really nice, and super funny. Really enjoyable class
It feels like he's learning the material alongside us as he's teaching it.
The best english teacher ive ever had.
Great professor! He understands what he is talking about but I do wish he had a syllabus that he followed and gave a clearer standard on when things were due such as big projects.

If you want to be taught by someone who cares about their students and their work, take Mark Jaskowski's class. As long as you attend class and listen (which isn't hard, he teaches like a stand up comedian), you will be fine. He cares about his students, so care about his class!
English is my worst subject, and this is the best grade I've gotten in an english class. As long as you try your best and go to his class regularly, you should be good.
Amazing person to be around, truely cares about his students. Will give extra credit if you bring a DVD copy of Forest Gump to the first day of class.

This man was possibly the best English teacher I've ever had. He is very fair with grading and you don't have to participate, but he makes it very easy to. He is a professor that lets you relax. Even if you aren't participating in class, he still gives you a good grade for attendance.

Attendance is mandatory regardless of what people tell you, he does use it for your overall grade the end of the semester. Show up, he's a good guy and funny. VERY EASY CLASS, SUPER basic assignments compared to all other english teachers. Take this class, TRUST
Very interesting guy, kind of strange. All assignments were just due at the end of the semester so it was pretty easy. There were a lot of assignments but they were all very easy.
He was a good professor, I wish he had made a clear syllabus. Don't get the textbook if you need borrow it from a friend.
Funny and engaging lectures. Not the boring college lectures you see on tv. Very chill and understanding.
Hates ice breakers.
Legend professor. Super understanding and interesting projects.
Hes super laid back, doesnt take off points for late work and definitely has of the most interesting lectures
He's nice

Mark is one of the best professors I have had since coming to college. He makes class fun and interesting, which in turn makes students want to show up. I had him for English 101 which I was required to take, but the papers we had to write were on interesting topics.

Absolutely wonderful, he's one of my favorite teachers that I had this semester. For our final we had a presentation and it was very easy and fun to do, he didn't want to stress us for our final. I took him for Weird fiction and it was one of my favorite classes. 10/10

His paranoia ruined this class. You will be recorded on camera and show a photo ID during every exam. Never seen a professor go so overboard because a few bad cheaters got caught. He simply cares more about catching people cheating then he does helping students learn. The exams/quizzes aren't like the homework or practice and no study guide.
This is a minor class and it has been easily the most stressful class I have ever taken.

He is knowledgeable, but his lectures and slides don't adequately prepare students for the quizzes, which make up a large portion of the grade. Students are essentially expected to teach themselves from vague materials without clear guidance on what will be on the quizzes.

He completely threw the syllabus out the window half throughout the semester. He also takes every opportunity he gets to not teach his in person classes. Countless class meetings either switched to online or canceled for whatever reason. I see little enthusiasm out of him and his teaching style.

The Fin 305 experience hasn't been fun. He caught a few students cheating and threw the syllabus out the window and has been requiring in-person assignments, quizzes, and exams. Really hard to vouch for this class after that, especially if you have a work schedule that you've submitted. Hard to ask questions when he isn't happy to answer them too.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: half way through the semester, he started recording 30 minute - 50 minute lecture videos for before class. That would be fine and all if we went over what he talked about in the videos during class but he just moves on to stuff he hasnt talked about. it turns the class from a 50 minute class 3 times a week to a 50 minute class 5 times a week.

Knowledgeable, but unfortunately his class's quality is extremely diminished by his paranoia and obsessiveness. Every time he catches a few students cheating or misbehaving, he panic-responses. Everything, from the syllabus to the class schedule, is at his whim and is thrown around impulsively. Class-wide/group punishments galore. Exhausting.

Kurt often cancels classes and makes sudden adjustments to the course layout. Mid semester, he moved the exams from online to more challenging in person formats, and the first exam's class average ended up at just fifty seven percent. He's knowledgeable, but his teaching style lacks consistency and follow through.

Don't waste your time. Kurt constantly cancels classes and randomly changes the course structure. Mid semester he shifted exams from online to harder in person versions, and scores dropped sharply. He's knowledgeable about finance, but his teaching is inconsistent, unpredictable, and often feels like he lacks real passion for the class.

He's kind of mean to students. If anyone asks a question, he acts like he explained it 30 times when he didn't and rolls his eyes, puts his face in his hands, etc. He was rude to students that weren't even in his class. Last test he recorded us and yelled at people to take off their hats.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Kurt Krogull does not support you to succeed. After having switching from online quizzes/exams to in-person ones, he did not appropriately handle students who needed accommodations because it was his "first time doing something like this." The content is understandable when you teach yourself. Lecture is just reading off slides from the book.
There was a quiz every week and and he gave us a lot of work on hw from McGraw hill every week and it was hard on top of other classes

Kurt Krogull decided to switch his quizzes and tests to in-person (which they were online throughout the semester), randomly out of suspicion because of a few specific students. Rather than transitioning the whole class, he probably should have either asked the students or transitioned those specific students separately to in-person. Bad move.

Kurt was great! He's a funny guy and made it easy to stay awake during his 8am. If you go to class and pay attention you'll be fine. He goes through quiz and homework questions in class so he basically gives you answers which is nice. There's is usually a quiz about every week as well as homework but its not too bad.

Please DO NOT TAKE HIM!!! literally likes to humiliate you in front of the whole class. Picks on the back row or side rows by asking questions and if they don't know the answer, he's very condescending and tells them go to the front. Also yells at the students at the front and tells them to go sit in the back and cusses too might I add.

Krogull liked to shout at students who left class early for other important obligations. 
He was known to make sarcastic and patronizing comments when students answered questions incorrectly.
He makes you buy an expensive textbook for the class and all his lectures read straight out of the book. Might as well not even sign up for his class. 0/10.

Dude loves to put things on the test we either hardly went over or never went over at all. Gives us the bare minimum and makes tests exceptionally hard for no reason. Absolutely no savviness for computers or tech at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I honestly think Kurt is a great professor. His classes are not the easiest and required me to put in a lot of extra effort outside of class, but he is willing to help if you go to his office hours! This is the only teacher I've gone to office hours for. Also, go to class! Missing a class will make you fall behind and miss out on important topics.

Krogull's knowledge is completely unhelpful when he spends most of his time reading directly from slides or wondering out-loud during class time why his students don't understand the material. He is not cut-out for teaching students. He took every opportunity to not teach his in-person class in-person and then complained about low attendance.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Krogull does very little to use his knowledge to help his students. His mandatory lectures are straight out of the textbook, monotonous, and condescending. He spent a majority of each lecture either reading off the slides we already have or patronizing students for not knowing the lesson prior. He's lazy and seems to not care to help his students.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Krogull has a lot of domain knowledge revolving finance, and does his best to transfer it to the classroom. This class is mainly lecture where you learn terminology and review practice problems. Go to class, because you will need your notes for the matching vocab sections on exams which are worth 30%. Offers EC if you have high attendance

I will be honest, he definitely knows finance, but is not a great teacher. He attempts to act caring but after a few classes you will see its all a show, he can't decide whether he wants to meet in person or online and will throw your schedule around. All tests and homework are done outside of class and while material is similar you have to read.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He goes over stuff in class and puts slideshows on canvas but never puts anything from the book or the notes on the quizzes or the tests. He is a boring lecture giver and half the stuff is not on the test, even when I take notes I still feel like I'm going to fail. I squeaked by with a C+ in the class but if you can, try not to take this guys class

This is by far the most frustrating class I have dealt with so far. It is insane how he goes over so much material and none of it is reflected on our quizzes or chapter readings. I find it mind boggling that he expects his students to pass this class when the only grades he submits are the quizzes that are worth 15 POINTS!!! Missed 4 points? failed
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: First of all I want to say it pissed me off that he reiterates his class is "hybrid" and we only had 1 day in person the WHOLE semester! his class has a very small workload, I showed up to class 3x a week (not mandatory but ec) basically do the reading (also ec) an ABA, and a quiz every week. They're hard but he offers so much ec, it's a easy A

I really struggled in this class, we used McGraw Hill for the textbook, quizzes, and exams and the material in the lectures never lined up with the material on the tests. I had to teach myself everything every week. VERY limited office hours, only had 1 hour the entire week that we could go for help. Does not make helpful accommodations.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Krogull thinks he's hilarious and is super arrogant. He thinks that everyone should be able to master the concept with ease. His lectures are useful and not interesting. He mainly reads off PowerPoint slides and talks about his personal life. You have to teach yourself the material and there is really no room for error on the quizzes.

I had him for Personal Finance and really enjoyed his class. You had to teach yourself a lot of the material. For every chapter expect reading, and activity, and potentially a quiz. He was easy to reach when you had questions and very kind and flexible with due dates. He gave many extra credit opportunities that were open to all of his classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Kurt is a great professor. Very kind and genuinely wants to see his students succeed. He treats his students with respect and his course content is very clear and easy to follow. I learned a lot of useful information in this class. Lots of busywork but its very rewarding! Highly recommend FIN101 with Kurt.

Krogull is very fair when it comes to being a professor, he sympathizes with students and finds ways to be more caring in many aspects, my only critique is that sometimes he forgets that this is a 101 class and needs to soften up on materials. He respects work ethic, if you show it, he will reward you. If you don't care he will call you on it.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Kurt is a funny guy and makes lecture fun, but lecture is a waste of time as he is awful at explaining and seems unprepared on what he is going to go over. If you aren't good at accounting or math and stuff like this doesn't come naturally you will have to teach yourself everything on the slides and homework. There is a good curve at the end.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: I took his class fearing the worst and he turned out to be pretty great. Funny guy who is willing to work with his students and be flexible. I'm bad with math and finance stuff, but if you don't get at least a B it's probably your own fault. Decent amount of work due outside of class, but it is a lot of free points. Underrated professor.

HELP ROOM DAD RIGHT HERE. If you forgot homework or cannot do it, visit him during help room hours. It is helpful. Finance is very hard and all finance teachers will make you feel stupid. Did not feel it with this class. I was originally a business major and took FIN 310 already. This is much better. 11/10 would recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Kurt does not explain material well. Be prepared to teach yourself all of the material. There are several slides each class period that are incorrect. He is not prepared for class. Kurt does not aim for student success.

He has gotten better at explaining the course material this semester. At the beginning, not many students were doing well and now the percentage of students getting A's is pretty solid. It is important to go to class if you want an A but not if you just need to pass. It's a difficult course but I think he explains the concepts well. Optional Final
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Has been rude to students during class and doesn't explain the concepts very well. Says things constantly like "this is easy stuff" despite his many years of experience and masters in Finance, not taking into account this is an entry level course for Finance.

I think this class needs improvement in both assignments and grading. The assignments were very specific and focused on topics many students didn't know which made them confusing and less helpful. The grading didn't feel consistent, expectations were unclear, and feedback often made it seem like I was always doing something wrong. He has huge ego.

Genuinely, I LOVED Professor Johnson. I'm not quite sure why others are saying his lectures were boring or a waste of time. I felt my writing was challenged a lot in his class and participating was incredibly easy as he made the environment fun. If you put some work into this class, you'll get an A or B easily. Loved this class so much.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class is extremely boring and pointless. Half of time he is just rambling about pointless stuff. You don't really learn anything in the class.Useless class and waste of time.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Johnson's class is poorly put together. He rambles on about irrelevant topics that are unrelated to the course content and does not describes what he expects out of your paper. The semester was very boring and I didn't feel like I got anything from the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: To be honest he's just kind of in his own world while teaching. Almost like talking to himself. The whole semester has only about 6 assignments and its mostly completed on ur own time. All the work can be found on canvas as well as prompts. Honestly felt like I wasn't challenged, didn't learn anything new, felt like I taught the class to myself

Overall initially reading the reviews I thought I was in for a long semester, but honestly he really isn't that bad. Class is extremely boring and there are only like 6 assignments, but other than that I would say he really isn't too harsh of a grader. Pretty easy to get an A if you show up and put somewhat effort into papers
i mean just save yourself he is so miserable like this is ENG 102 lighten up.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Save yourself the money and headache. He spent an excessive amount of time sharing his political views but trying to get questions answered or feedback was like pulling out wisdom teeth with my bare hands. The class was relatively easy but anything I learned was from the textbook, not the professor.

Professor Johnson genuinely cares about his students and I don't understand all the low ratings. If you show you care about your assignments and just turn something in you should be okay. Yes it's an English course you have to write but we're in college, it wasn't hard at all. Overall if you have a problem, ask him and he would be happy to help.

Prof Johnson is a very kind guy, he wants students to do well. His grading is inconsistent and his assignments are vague. It took me all semester to realize he did that on purpose. He wants you to do assignments based on your own interpretation. I never spent time on this class besides for the final paper. The textbook isn't necessary, don't buy it

Johnson was not as bad as I initially thought he would be. He has favorites in the classes and if you're not in that category, it's going to be a long semester. Johnson will try to push his left political views on you and if you don't write your paper to align with his views you will receive a poor grade. He also begs you to attend his office hours
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Was not a good teacher. Assignments were always unclear and when you asked for clarification he would proceed to make it more confusing. He is bad with technology and does canvas differently from my other professors that throws me off. He's a nice guy and his lectures are usually pretty interesting.

So far Stephen Johnson has been my worst professor. He is more of a politician than a teacher. He will try and force his left political agenda on you by making irrelevant ties to the book we are reading. His instructions are unclear and we had to read half a novel in the first 2 weeks of class. Find a different professor for this course!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Assignments are unclear and little instruction is provided. He is a hard grader and will dock you points on an assignment without giving you any background as to why. If you have a question, you may not get it answered. He dances around your main concern and leads you to be more confused with the task at hand. Would not recommend.

To this day, I still have no idea why Professor Johnson decided to assign so many vague and tedious assignments for a class whose subject he clearly loves very deeply. He is unclear about what he wants for his assignments, and his grading of those assignments reflect a standard that is far higher than that which is appropriate for the course level.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: I really loved the assignments in this class. All of them are important, there is no busy work. He is a tough grader but if you put in the effort and the work you can achieve a grade you deserve. The only thing I wanted more is a clear and specific grading rubric for each major assignment. Otherwise, this class wouldve been 5 stars.

He's deaf so get ready to yell during class. He also doesn't give clear directions, you have to figure everything out on your own (look at other people's submission to get an idea that helps too). He takes years to respond to emails, and they're very brief, unhelpful responses. Just participate a lot, you'll be ok.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: He seems to be a great person, but his rubrics and grading were unclear. Examples are almost never provided/ don't reflect the actual assignment, grading takes forever, and there are days he literally say he won't be answering questions. It is also important to note, getting an A in this class will be more difficult than any other 100 level class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He's way to vague when giving instructions and is very slow on grading things. I mean a week before end of semester and hasn't graded anything since October 30 slow.

Yeah, probably the worst teacher/professor I have ever had. Complete liberal, so don't write about anything that will upset him. Had family members who work in journalism field for living basically write my papers for me and still got a B-. Never clear on assignments. The dude can't hear either.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Not being in class will definitely effect not only your grade but the work you turn in as well. Everything is dependent on the reading. He is understanding and assigns grades fairly.
