Hes a nice enough guy, but not nearly as smart as he thinks he is. Knows accounting well but makes some stuff unnecessarily difficult. He also has this ridiculous homework policy where you have to fill out handouts online type them up show your work typed up and then print them out and he refuses to accept any emails or handwritten homework.

Larry is a very likeable, fun professor, and I really enjoyed going to his class due to his personality. That said, the course is structured very poorly, and he is an extremely harsh grader. It is unnecessarily difficult to do well, and his instruction style is very hard to learn from. He also doesn't post solutions, so hard to study mistakes.

His ACCT321 is very lecture heavy and fast-paced. Many times I had to supplement lecture notes with other readings outside of class; the textbook is hard to interpret. Like anything, just be ready to really apply yourself and make sure you understand all the concepts. Show up to class b/c he'll go over quizzes and exams as well as give study guides
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He makes concepts and problems way more difficult than they need to be. He presents information boringly, making it hard to follow. He also does not post a lot of information online, so take as many notes as possible and go to office hours for anything you miss.

This guy is a character to say the least. Second course I've taken with him and would do it again in a heartbeat. He is extremely intelligent which is why it's easy to see why he's annoyingly into himself. Although we didn't get along the best he's still the second if not the best professor I've had at KU.

Larry is super smart and a nice guy. Easy to listen to. Sometimes class objectives get lost in the mud but it's fun to listen to him talk about his business experience. This class helped a little concerning fair value when studying for the CPA exam. Gotta go to class, do the homework, memorize the slides for the exam, and always "write that down"

reviews.comment: He is a leading expert in the subject matter and I learned things that I believe will benefit my career. For example, I passed the CFE exam partly on the basis of the course. Receiving full credit is nearly impossible. Exams are typically essay format and primarily "state what you know." ephx 210 fun

he's nice and cares about his students but exams are a large portion of ur grade and if u bomb it ur cooked, midterm 2 grades came out and half the class dropped. pls dont take physics 1 here, you WILL regret it. you can beg for more points on ur exam if you rlly try but he barely curves exams.

One of the best teachers i have ever had. Very insightful and really cared about his students. Very passionate for his field... Very very good.
Class is useless. Only reason of going is for the ridiculous mandatory attendance worksheets EVERYday. I suggest taking the class with any other instructor.

Dr. Murray may be the best professor I ever have. He is always willing to help, he even gave us his phone number and always responds to texts/call immediately. The homework is hard but manageable since he is a great professor. Try to take from him
Excellent teacher.  Find time to visit his office hours and you will truly see that he cares about his students.  Also visits lab (taught by TA's) from time to time to say hello.
Very helpful, he goes out of his way to help students. Interactive class and gave our class 2 chances on each exam.

I wish I could have him again!

His lectures are entertaining, but they don't apply to homework or tests. The homework is ridiculously difficult, and the study guides often don't match the tests. Luckily, he offers retakes, and a large amount of extra credit on the final.

Tests are easy with optional retakes. Homework assignments are more difficult than the material covered in class and he doesn't consistently respond to emails. Assignments are also due online on Saturday nights. Despite a 94% test average I ended up with a C in the class.
Really enjoyed class with Dr. Murray. Wish I could take him for PHSX 212.
Maybe in a low capacity class this professor would be good but he lacks any control of the lecture hall and fails to communicate the subject effectively.
Inadequate.
Awesome teacher! Very easy to get along with. I would suggest going to his office hours and getting to know him-it will help you out in the long run.
Great Professor. I wish i could take more classes from him. Very helpful.
He is an awesome teacher and person to talk to. Willing to do whatever it takes to help you understand. I wish I could take him for 212.
Murray is a funny badass from England or somewhere in Europe. Need I say more.

He is an amazing teacher and does his absolute best to help you to succeed and keep class interesting.During class he likes to stand on the desk though and will occasionally pick up students to prove a point so maybe don't sit in front. Excellent teacher. Avg test scores are around 80%
Awesome professor! He is easy to understand and has funny examples to get his point through. If you get him as a professor consider yourself lucky.
Great professor! He is easy to understand and has funny examples to get his point through. If you get him as a professor consider yourself lucky.
Energetic, very nice man. Uses a lot of visual examples and is interactive. His tests are on the easy side, but he sometimes uses the other 212 prof's tests, which are heck. Very willing to help.
I like his movie
Niccum is genuinely one of the best professors I've had during my time at KU, if you have an opportunity to take a class with him, TAKE IT.
Truly the best professor I've ever had.
Niccum is the absolute man, I could not imagine having a better professor. He is very understanding and personable, constantly proving that he does indeed want what is best for his students.
Great and cool guy!
Great guy!

Instructor Niccum is passionate about teaching film studies, which shows through his ability to give informative, digestible, and entertaining screenwriting lectures. I enjoyed how watching example films was built into the curriculum.

Literally my favorite professor I've ever had. Class discussions are always engaging, and he's always able to get at least one guest speaker to come talk to the class (sometimes two or three in a semester). I've taken all three of the classes he teaches and still wish I could take more classes with him!

Niccum is straight up the GOAT. He treat's his students like people first, and not just robots. He puts effort into making class interesting or fun. He's always quick to crack a joke. He's willing to have a conversation with you about almost anything. Makes himself available after class if need. That's my GOAT fr.
One of my favorite professors. Gave a lot of neat advice and is super chill. You get to write a full screenplay which is better than basic screenwriting! 10/10 super awesome

Prof. Niccum was a great professor. I liked how he has a background in journalism; the journalism program lacks the core elements that the film school has, so its great to be in a film class w a journalistic professor. I would say that communicating with him about any sensitivities when watching movies in class, i.e. gore, violence, etc. is good!

I really enjoyed his teaching style, we always started with a brief lecture that gets us thinking about the concepts we'd cover. After that we'd watch a movie and discuss what we noticed or saw afterwards relating to the topic of the lecture.
Best professor I have ever had, I have so much respect for him.
Jon is amazing! I have another class with him next semester and I'm super excited. He makes the class honestly just feel like a group hang out. Even better if you're passionate in what he's teaching.
I really enjoyed going to this class every week. Professor Niccum was great, and we watched a lot of great movies and had really cool guest speakers.

He cares a lot about his students and try's to make class very engaging. You have to write a full screen play so don't push it off. You have 6 assignment through out the semester, all are 400-600 word essay but as long as you complete it you get 100 on them. Attendance is a big thing. Very good one on one.
Very much enjoyed the class. Nothing but good things, never had any problems, and gave good feedback on how to improve.

Niccum is a very down to earth guy who has a TON of industry experience in the film / journalism world. I really enjoyed his lectures and most of the films he showed in class. If you show up and turn things in on time you'll get an A.
I absolutely loved class with Niccum. He is a real-world journalist, and gives you tips that are actually useful for writing. Wish he taught more courses at KU!

SPAN324 with her was great. She expects in-class participation, but provides assignments that are interesting. Homework is super manageable as well as the writing assignments. She will be flexible about grading/getting things in on time if you participate in class.

the class itself was cool but i found her to be a bit condescending at times and quick to call out any mistakes or opinions she disagreed with. she seemed very friendly with some students she already knew, but could be less engaging with those that weren't as outgoing. she also required us to volunteer once which was a bit annoying schedule-wise...

To be frank, I wouldn't recommend for anyone to have Megan as a teacher. SPAN104: she's a great lady, and she makes class interesting. There's online homework almost every day, but it's relatively easy. There are 2 group projects, but those are easy as well. Overall, the class is excellent.

She yelled at me for using my laptop to take notes. And the whole semester was trying to catch me using my laptop for anything other than taking notes. She kept trying to call me out in class the whole semester, but never caught me doing anything but taking notes. Jerk...

At least in this class, Dr. Sheldon grades papers on content>grammar. She asks students about deadlines and out-of-class workdays to make things more manageable, but you still learn (and are expected to) in this class. Grades are 3 papers, a presentation, and a test. reviews.comment: Megan really cares about her students and is willing to help you. Shes nice and accessible- she responded promptly to any questions. I felt comfortable talking with her in class.

Totally rude and acts like shes smarter than everyone. If you dont agree with her opinions she makes it extremely awkward. Not helpful and extremely critical. Very blunt and has poor manners. Regularly embarrasses students in front of the whole class.

Not gonna lie, I hated the Spanish department at KU until Megan. She is so helpful and caring, I am comfortable speaking around her. She lays out the week so nicely and we had one synchronous day and one asynchronous day, which gave us time to complete everything. Dr. Sheldon loves her students and puts a great deal of effort into her classes, and it really shows. She's very approachable, treats students as equals, and has a great sense of humor. Overall, she makes classes enjoyable even if the material isn't always interesting, and is a wonderful professor. Highly recommended!

Megan was a good teacher for my first Spanish class, my first semester of college. She gave tons of helpful feedback on rough drafts and was lenient with grading for the first few papers. The actual class was barely boring but she explained topics well and knew what she was talking about. Answers emails and questions well!

reviews.comment: Megan is an awesome professor, she is encouraging and motivates you to learn. Enjoyed her class, films and readings were all interesting. The class focuses on analysis, her handouts for terms and concepts helped a lot.

Megan wants you do do well in her classes, and will work with you to learn where you can improve. Lectures are generally required, and although you can tell Megan cares a lot about the material, they just aren't terribly interesting.
Megan was one of the best teachers I've had at KU she was very understanding and wanted to make sure everyone did well! She is the best I've had from the Spanish department!

Wonderful and engaging professor, very understanding , easy/fair essay grader. Used relevant news in class discussion to make it more interesting. Speaking speed was reasonable and she used English when needed for directions.

reviews.comment: Megan is really sweet. You can tell she really cares about her students, and she's very passionate about the subject. I really enjoyed being in her class.

I really don't understand why Megan's reviews are so bad. Yes, she speaks in Spanish, but this is a college level Spanish class, so that's to be expected. She is amazing at Spanish and really knowledgable and fun in class.

I'm in this class now, Megan is a not that bad.She repeats what she says several times and translates for students when they don't know words. If you come prepared and make an effort, you have no problem.

Sheldon is one of the worst teachers I've ever had. She talks entirely too fast, is hard to understand, and gets easily frustrated when the class gets confused.
