reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Tom does not give grades students deserve. One of the best designers in the class received a B+ on a project that was excellent and he didn't want to give the A. reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: He's a super nice guy, super funny. Overall, I actually really enjoyed him. My only complaint is that a lot of the times, he doesn't seem to know what's going on, which is frustrating in a studio class. Super chill guy, though!

First year design students, I would advise you not to take Tom. He picks his favorite students the 1st week of class and if you are not one, good luck with any feedback on your work. Isn't clear about assignments and will tell you your work is good but then grades it badly. He is unorganized and hypocritical. Can be cool some days if you're lucky.

Tom never helped me when it came to critiques. His assignments, when assigning in class were about as clear as mud, and he takes a minimum of four days (if you're lucky) to respond. He's a wonderful person, interesting to talk to. But a very poor teacher if you're not an ID student.

Participation is key! Also keep up with the homework load. And get the caffeine ready youre going to need it for the all-nighters. He also grades hard, his not afraid to give you an F so keep the craft looking good.

Tom is so cool. He is sort of out of it a lot of the time and never gives a straight answer, but that's because he likes his students to make their own decisions. He critiques and when you ask for help, he'll sit with you and give advice. He tends to leave class early and not respond to emails, but that's hardly a problem. I'd take his class again.

I was not excited to take this class in the begining because I had taken 3 drawing classes at my previous college. I like Tom as a person but he absolutely made me hate drawing. He does not teach in a way that is easy to understand. Luckily he had a TA that was a lot better at teaching the class than he was.

Tom is that man. He is probably the easiest industrial designer too relate to in the department. I have learned more from toms classes than all of the other teachers combined. While he might not be the most organized, you always know what you have to get done. His classes will challenge and inspire you in multitudes of design thinking.

Ok, here's the thing; he's not super involved or organised, but all that means is it's a traditional college course where you are in control of your own work, and go to him for advice/help, but he's not holding your hand.  Great guy, great class, you'll get out of it what you put into it.
Seems to be almost completely out-of-touch with most of the class. Has a tendency to run off when students need him the most. Much of the time, he seemed to not have a clue as to what was going on.

I am a teachers pet, its a fact, but Tom only likes the students who are the best in his class. He isn't a good teacher at all. He tells you one thing one class and  another the next class. He made us change our project at the last min. because he didn't like the design. The other teachers loved it and thought Tom was being difficult for no reason.
He was ok. It was hard tell what he wanted and for a design teacher he was somewhat lacking for inspiration
Tom is tough and is a self-proclaimed "hardass" when it comes to grading but i learned a ton in his class. He has a genuine interest in your education which is hard to find at KU.

Tom has a lot of knowlage to share, so listen to him.  He likes nice craft, so don't be sloppy in his class. More than halfway through the semester, and I am still enjoying this class.  Don't expect him to answer emails, though.
Get Tom Ming Huang as teacher, be enlightened.

Brandon has been arguably the best professor I've had through my first year at KU after taking classes like calculus, acct 200&201, Bsan 202 with him, and Econ 142. Attendance is only mandatory on days where we have in class quizzes that you can complete with other students. Brandon makes the class simple as he can and he always is in a good mood

Really chill guy. He's the type of guy that you can have a good conversation with about anything outside of class. He makes it a priority to make sure every student understands the content so no one falls behind. In addition, he also makes the lectures seem understandable because some professors over complicate it.

Brandon is funny and clearly cares about the content and his students. The material is hard and the grades are pretty test-dependent, but he curved the heck out of them because he wants students to succeed.

I sat next to a guy in one of my other classes that never showed up and claimed there was no point. He would cold show up and bomb the test, and that is likely the other students in here claiming Tripp is harsh. Show up and put in effort and get help if needed and I promise the curves and couple of EC assignments in the semester will save you.

This class is not as challenging as other people claim. Exams are worth 80 percent of your grade, but all the questions are easy, common-sense multiple-choice questions. He also puts a 10 to 20 percent curve on the exams. Just show up to class, take good notes, study a little bit before the exam, and you will get an A on all the exams.

Brandon is a great guy. He is very nice and caring to students. Lectures were not mandatory, but it was highly beneficial to attend. Grade was made up of 80% exam and 20% homework, so doing well on tests was paramount. Lectures moved fast, but Brandon would go back and re-explain if asked during lecture. Take good notes and study hard for exams.

A lot of these other kids who are complaining about Professor Tripp are the ones who didn't come to lectures or care to study one bit for the class. The class itself is a little bit difficult in terms of having to memorize a lot of the concepts-but if you come to all the lectures and do a couple hours of studying before each test, you're good.

For Tripp's first semester at KU, he did pretty well. He gave curves on pretty much everything, which helped my grade out a bunch. He's a super nice guy, and here are the only bad things about his teaching style: He goes through the material in his lectures and review lectures VERY quickly, and the review isn't structured the same as exams.
he was very precious and a good person but goes through lectures fast and test are only 20 questions MC making it hard to do well if you miss a few questions

Brandon Tripp was one of my favorite professors I've had at KU. His class is pretty exam heavy with 80% of your grade being exams but Professor Tripp puts a lot of curves on the exams so everyone end up with a good grade.

Grade is entirely test based, so going to lectures is essential. He curves all test grades and the final grade generously. The homeworks are very easy. He's a great lecturer and uses lots of examples. I can see why people who hate school might hate this course, but I learned more in this class than in any KU class so that is nice.

80% of our grade is from exams. The practice tests are not like the exams at all. The exams are really hard to study for and very difficult. There are 3 midterms and a cumulative final. He does curve exams and will curve the final. He does genuinely care and tries hard to make sure students understand but be ready to study A LOT.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Don't listen to the bad ones. Tripp is the GOAT. Yes, his classes are more difficult. Not bc he is a jerk, he wants to challenge you bc you are paying to learn, so might as well. Attendance was not mandatory but if you don't go, it will be harder. GO TO HIS OFFICE HOURS; he loves teaching and just talking about life in general. TAKE THE CLASS
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Tripp is a great lecturer. If you show up to class and take notes, you have already won most of the battle. There is minimal work, and our grades are mostly based on exams; however, he is generous with the curve, so there is some padding. All of the exam content is pulled straight from lecture, there are no surprises. Great class/teacher.

Show up to lectures, a lot of critical information is provided in class but even without that he provides the slides after each class. I've missed maybe 3 classes and still gotten a good grade; He is very easy to talk to and encourages you to visit his office hours or to just talk to him. Ask questions and show up and you'll do well. That simple.

I have never struggled with a class so much in my life. The exams are impossible to study for as the practice questions are nothing like the actual tests. Getting 100s on all homework does nothing for your grade as 80% of it is based on exams/the final. Don't take any classes with this professor!

reviews.comment: Hardest class I have EVER taken. The exams are not like the practice questions AT ALL. You will be waiting weeks to get your exam grades back. reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Tripp has been one of my favorite professors at KU. The material is challenging and exams are a large portion of the grade, however he listens to student feedback and wants everyone to succeed. His lectures are engaging and it doesn't feel like you're being lectured by a robot. Great guy who just wants his students to learn.

One of the worst professors I have had yet at KU. Exams are worth 80% of your grade ( the exams are very hard and only have 20 questions), and his study guides are awful. Be ready for him to talk for an hour and a half during class. Will never take another one of his classes again at KU.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Brandon Tripp cares for his students. If you don't come to class, don't expect the exams to be easy. Brandon makes class easy to come to as his jokes are engaging and he is inspirational. Although his tests are hard, he gives big curves and helps you LEARN. He is a GREAT person but the class is only based off lecture slides and the exams are super difficult and not worded like his reviews.

reviews.comment: He's probably the nicest guy ever, but the exams are worth a ton and the material is very challenging

reviews.comment: Super nice guy. His lectures were engaging and he provided relevant applications for everything we were learning. Practice tests and quizzes were provided, and if you review lectures an 80-90% is easily obtainable on them.
I loved this professor he was the bomb and he had great lectures I really learned a lot

I loved Professor Unckless for his humor and caring for his students' well-being. However, I would have appreciated much more homework or other activities for points. It was easy to convince myself that I knew the material, but the homework often didn't reflect the information needed to know for exams. Textbook isn't mandatory. Go to office hours!

Dr. Unckless is a super nice guy, however he is not a good professor at all. Constantly skips over things in class that were put on exams. The class was just super unorganized in terms of the actual lecture material. He gives practice tests for the exams but thats all you get for exam prep.

Unckless is an entertaining professor. I enjoyed how he used practical applications in lectures to teach the material and does practice problems. Only one homework a week that is useful in enforcing the material from the lectures. Practice exams/quizzes are given before test dates. However, you do have to put in the effort for this class.
The first exam was daunting in that there were so many short essay questions. The class was also very lecture-heavy. You need to watch the lectures to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Unckless is a nice guy and a great professor. The exams are moderately challenging but definitely manageable. Does not provide the most practice, though. Side note, if you have an obsession with fruit flies/Drosophila, you will do well in the class, lol.

Unckless is a nice guy, but don't be fooled, this class isn't easy. It is very easy to convince yourself that the content is all "common sense" before getting rocked by an exam or quiz. This class is also difficult because Unckless doesn't give a lot of material to help study other than the weekly homework assignment and the occasional review.

Took this in Fall 2021, and I think the only reason I passed was that he made the Final optional, because he didn't want to make the extra credit promise he made about us all respecting COVID guidelines. All he did was lecture about his fly lab, and gave us no meaningful examples to use to practice for exams. Hated his class, harder than necessary.

Dr. Unckless's lectures are pretty great. He weighs the exams nicely so that if you really screw up one of the three exams, it doesn't demolish your grade. As long as you have a general understanding on all of the material, you should be able to get an easy B, albeit a low one. I never had to force myself to go to class because it was so chill.

Lectures provide a superficial understanding of the subject matter and may lead to a false sense of security. Evaluations are much more in-depth. Do extra practice to ensure you are prepared. Seems like a very busy dude.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Genetics is a tough class, but Dr. Unckless helps make it more enjoyable. He shares a lot of interesting stories during lecture that help you stay engaged. The exams are tough and he doesn't provide a ton of practice problems for studying, so make sure you take advantage of your TA for helping with certain concepts/problems.

Dr. Unckless is passionate about the subject, but his lectures lack adequate practice and explanations for solutions. If you want to do good in class go to office hours, and GTA sessions, and pay attention in lectures. Highly recommend doing really well on the first two exams, as the second half of the semester is much more difficult.
he chill and super silly and funny

Genetics is not an easy course! With that being said, Unckless is a great professor and provides all of the resources necessary to understand the material. Lectures are very thorough and great at answering questions!
Rob is the man. Great teacher, hard class, but lots of fun!

I thought he was a very good professor and the class was very straight forward. Everything on the exams is either discussed in lecture, discussion, or on one of the previous quizzes. I personally found his lectures interesting and enjoyable, and useful for exams. Grading is heavily based on exams, with some homework. Basically the entire class is graded on the 3 tests, with a few points for discussion and sapling HW. Go to discussion, that is what saves you. He is an enjoyable guy and the lectures are okay, but hard.

reviews.comment: Hated the MC exams, and I studied hard for the exams and still got Cs on them. Most unreasonable. He was a very fun professor and cared. The lectures were a little disorganized but it didnt matter because his lectures were easy to pay attention to. Tests were extremely difficult. I recommend taking it with the other professors since the tests were easier.

He is very good at explaining ideas. He really listens to the class and pays attention to what the class needs more work on. reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Urish is easily the worst professor I have ever had. He changed the syllabus the week before finals and, when confronted about it, he said retorted with little sympathy. He doesn't care about students and makes excuses for why he's so bad at his job. Insufferable class, insufferable man.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Yes, as he is more than a Lecturer. So easy to relate with and accessible to students. Always ever willing to help out with all courses relating to Literature and literary studies.

I am not having a good experience in his class. He takes forever to grade and is very hard when he does. I wish I took the class with someone else. He is very unorganized and expects us to learn off of videos. Came to class late and gave a pop quiz the same day. He just needs to do better!

Extremely nice professor! He does get distracted, which made the class very frustrating because it was unclear what content we actually needed to know. The assignments consist of weekly one-page essays, a map quiz where you label 20 countries in Africa, and a 12 page class summary. As long as you do the assignments, you'll be fine!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: This professor is not fit for graduate level teaching. DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASS if you are in graduate school. Firstly, he is a terrible grader & I am sure that he does not have a grading rubric. He is very unorganized and in many of the classes that we had everybody sat around and did whatever. None of our assignments or readings apply to discussion.

One of the nicest professors ever! Make sure you take detailed notes; the final is a 12 page summary of the course. Sometimes he gets really off topic, which is frustrating, but he generally does good lectures. You write a paper per week but they're only a page and he's a very easy grader and willing to work with you. Would definitely recommend.

Nicest man on the planet. Never stops smiling, so simple. Class is so funny. we read plays in groups (don't memorize them), and then we have quizzes over every play that are 2 questions. SO easy but also very interesting. Boring at times, but so is every class. We have 2 papers that are so simple and thats it. no tests, just quizzes on plays.

Very simple and easy class. Professor is very friendly and funny and never stops smiling. The class consists of reading plays aloud (not acting) and taking quizzes on each quiz that consist of two questions. As long as you attend and read the plays, you will get an A. Two papers that are simple and it is a piece of cake class. I learned a lot as we
No Comments
Excellent Professor.  Maintains high classroom standards yet very approachable and understanding.  Interesting lectures, guest lectures, and very inspiring.
AWESOME!!

Dr. Kamanga was inconsistent and vague with her instructions, leaving many students unsure about grading criteria. She also made the environment very tense. Many of us were incredibly nervous to present as she would grill students with difficult or confusing questions afterward.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: For having a communications degree, I find that Professor Kamanga lacked communication and empathy. If you don't do things the way she wants you do to it, your grade will suffer. For our policy speech, we called her out for not following the rubric (that she changed 2 days before it was due), she shut down the conversation and ignored us.

I held off on writing my review of this professor until the end of this semester in hopes that she would improve, but I was let down. All previous reviews of Dr. Kamanga are factual. I personally felt like a child being scolded by their mother in this class. I can only hope that she will take her course evaluations into consideration next semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Better read that syllabus, no leniency. I became a worse public speaker, and many other peers say the same. She makes the environment tense and calls you out. Not a single person has gotten a 100% in any of the speeches, and many did exceptionally. The smartest person was the one that dropped the second week.

If you got her as a professor, drop the class. I've had to personally quit my job in order to keep up with all the work that she assigns. She says we're a "family" but she refuses to see you as a human being. Don't expect compassion, understanding, or humanity. She's rude and will make you feel inferior. I pray that no one has to take her class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: This professor has unrealistic expectations, there is an assigned textbook where she will ask very specific questions and get mad when the class doesn't know them. She will assign more homework depending on the performance of the class (which never met her standards). She is very strict with her grading and extremely rude with her feedback.

She is very rude to her students and is unclear about what she is expecting in the assignment. Some instructions come from in-class and is never enforced causing you to lose easy points. Follow her outline perfectly, give the speech fluidly, and she will find anything to dock more than 10% of the grade, including instructions never even said.

for someone who teaches public speaking she sure can't explain things clearly. So much of the class is guessing what she wants, being wrong and then getting told that you aren't trying. because you don't remember the textbook verbatim.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She asks awful question, expects students to memories every single word of the textbook. She will make an example out of you. She once gave out homework because we "didn't" read the chapter. My class was warned about this from the earlier class. Everyone read the chapters and she still found a way to give us homework. 0/10. Don't take this class.

Dr. Kamanga is really sweet. But her instructions are vague, everything is vague, always asks things out of the textbook and if you answer wrong, or reference the part that isn't what she's looking for, then she will get upset. For this week we were assigned chapter 8 (156-160) but she said that we were supposed to read the whole thing.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Does not answer to emails or any contact option whatsoever. The only way to access her is going to her office hours. Does give good feedback on speeches, I'll give her that. She does not provide instructions on homework on the web. She gives the instruction during lecture so attendance is a must, and focus at all times.

Shes a TA for JOUR 150. Take literally any other TA. She is not clear on deadlines or expectations, rude to students, and if you ask for help or clarification she will pull you aside in class and embarrass you. I was given a zero on an assignment because she switched up the due date without telling us and it really messed up my grade. Awful TA
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS! Literally chose any other professor for your journalism lab classes. She doesnt care about you or your other classes, and shes straight up rude to students. I felt like every time I walked into her class room everyone was walking on egg shells, scared to not get yelled at. Dont make my mistake!

She was the sweetest but I had a hard time understanding her lectures. They were interesting but she went fast and the information was random. She did grade very hard on homework which caused my grade to suffer. I am a linguistics minor and did not learn anything in this course. I loved her as a person as she is very caring, but a hard professor.

The prime example for why I am giving her this rating is because of her unrealistic grading scale. Her course material is very difficult to get a grasp on the subject. Her scale went from assignments being worth 1 and 2 points to random 100 points assignments. It was near impossible to catch up (I couldn't anyhow).

I love her class! She is very understanding and her office hours are really helpful if you're ever confused. Lecture heavy, so try and make them all. She moves through notes fast, but she posts the slides on Blackboard and is very organized. LOVE THIS CLASS
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: A very nice lady who explains a lot on the basic concepts. She makes extra presentations on Japanese culture, which are inspiring. You don't need any background in Japanese or linguistics to join. Lectures can be long, but it's worth taking since she summaries what's on the textbook for you. She's approachable at any time. I love her!

She is a very nice woman. You don't need the textbook - just keep all the handouts she gives you. Her lectures are very long though and she can take a while to get to the point. She will read the handouts word for word as well. It's worth having the patience though, since an A is very easy to get.

I love her! Granted, I actually liked linguistics prior to taking this course, but I have a high A without having to stress about anything. Her lectures are full of information and some of it may be intuitive, but it's easy to get lost if you're on your phone. She has a fun personality and shows up enthusiastic every day. I highly recommend her!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Utako Minai is very enthusiastic about what she is teaching which makes paying attention a little easier. If you ever become unsure of the material asking her additional questions won't really help. She basically talks around the question rather than answer it directly. She packs her lectures entirely too full of information. Nonstop talk for 75min

Good at explaining linguistics in an easy-to-get way. Very passionate and interesting -- always gave us fun factoids on Japanese culture. Seems like a nice and cool person. Goes out of her way to be a good teacher. Great feedback on our final project. I learned a lot. Listen in class, read, do all the work, get help if needed, and it will be fine.

Truly an amazing teacher, Professor Minai was both enthusiastic about her subject and able to present it in a way that was easy to comprehend.                                              Her power points were interesting and well put together and she was very quick to get back graded assignments. I would definitely recommend her as a teacher.

Dr. Sun's lectures are really organized, and the review before exams is very helpful. He explains concepts clearly and makes expectations easy to understand. Chemistry is challenging, but his class feels fair and well prepared.

I had Dr. Sun for chemistry, and he is an amazing professor. He is very organized with lectures, homework, exams, and study materials. The practice problems are really helpful and prepare you well for tests. Chemistry is hard, but he makes it much easier to follow.

I really enjoyed taking Dr. Sun's chemistry class. He is super organized, clear, and approachable. Chemistry is still a hard subject, but he makes it as understandable as possible and gives students lots of resources to succeed. I would definitely recommend him.

Some reviews here feel kinda unfair. I've literally heard of people not even handing in exams and then asking him for grades anyway, getting told no, and then coming on here to complain. Like if you actually do the work, this class is very manageable and honestly really well taught.

Not gonna lie, he's one of the best professors I've had so far as a freshman. His lectures are clear, organized, and easy to follow if you show up and pay attention. He gives plenty of study materials before exams too. Some reviews here feel unfair—if you actually do the work, the class is manageable and well taught.
I am not a big fan of the way he lectures, its hard to understand what exactly he is teaching and not alot of study materials before a test

He was a fantastic teacher. Coursework is super light, so get familiar with the free games on Steam, but just something to play in the background while listening. He is a super funny teacher and makes the lecture hilarious. You get a full-page cheat sheet for the tests and can also retake them. Write the entire practice exam on the cheat sheet.
Overall great guy, only thing I don't like is that he leans on Ai too much to grade which is frustrating when answers don't line up exactly with what Ai thinks is correct.
Very fun interactive lectures, gives plenty of extra credit chances and exam retake opportunities.

Shuai is a great professor. He genuinely cares about students and wants everyone to do well. Go to his office hours, he has them every day. Also allows you to bring a cheat sheet to each exam and allows you to retake each exam. He is the best i loveeeeeeeeee him

Pretty funny guy. I found chemistry to be quite difficult but his character made class entertaining and engaging. He can come off kinda harsh but I believe that's just his way of encouragement. Sometimes you have to wait hours to talk to him in office hours due to the large amount of students in his class.

Shuai is my bestie he cared about his students made class fun with up to date jokes. Class is slow paced so everyone knows the material so it might get boring so download Minecraft or clash. He allows a full page of cheat sheets and tells you what to put on it. Love this class

Super fun teacher. Loves to make jokes during the lecture to keep it engaging. The material does move slowly so that people can have time to practice concepts, so if you pick up things quickly, you might get a little bored.
He was an amazing teacher. He cares about you and make sure you go to his office hours to just chat.
His lectures sometimes feel like they're only there for IClicker questions and practice problems, but his office hours very nicely make up for them.

Very chill professor and seems like he actually cares about if his students are learning or not. You make extra credit by going to office hours. The only issue is that he has AI grade homework, but he will help you out if it's a concern.
love you shuai, you have such a great personality. the class was overall a good experience, just wish AI didn't grade everything
The goat, impossible to get less than a B in chem 150

The most unique person in the state of Kansas. He is the nicest professor at KU and will do anything to make sure you understand the material and he WANTS you to get an A. He notices extra effort as well and is super easy to talk to. Loved him and his class.

Shuai Sun is the best professor that the University of Kansas has to offer. He is incredibly funny and clearly cares for individual student success. His office hours are almost every day for 2-4 hours, and you get extra credit each time you attend. Lectures are very engaging, and cheat sheets are allowed on exams. I 100% recommend taking his class.

He is the greatest proffesor to ever do it. I met my wife in his class actually. He makes sure to get to know every student personally if you allow him too. He tries to make sure every student understands the material. He cares more about you learning than jus tests in grades.
Gives great feedback and advice about anything you want to talk about. Very funny and personable and also very helpful with understanding the class especially at office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Can redo the tests. Very interactive and go to his office hours for extra credit and lots of help on the homework. The redo test are just like the original test so you should get a good grade on the tests.

His personality is great and he enjoys teaching chemistry although his lectures may be hard to follow at times. With that said, he has amazing office hours and will enthusiastically explain anything that you didn't understand from lectures. He's well liked for good reason.

While his lectures were hard to follow at times, and I didn't work great with his fast paced style of teaching, any gaps I had in lectures could be filled in office hours. Shuai made himself readily available outside of class, and he was always very helpful at providing clarity during office hours. He also provided plenty of helpful extra credit.

He is very funny during his lectures and his worksheets are very useful in preparing for the test, he also holds office hours every weekday where you can get extra credit for showing up. The class is very easy, but thats not a bad thing.

Let me start off by saying I like him as a person. He's a really good guy. But his class is not as fun as he is. There's so much content and the material on the exams are a foreign language to what he goes over in lecture. If you want to be successful you need to memorize almost everything on his lecture slides which are usually 300 pages.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I love Shuai as a person (like LOVE him), and his office hours are very helpful and comfortable. However, his class structure made no sense to me. Most days, it felt like we were just wasting time with iClickers that didn't make sense. The class also felt very rushed close to exams, and I found myself having to teach myself everything at home.
He made me love chemistry and he explains so well and hes funny

Shuai is an amazing teacher. Easily super charming in lectures and his office hours are super useful is you are confused. You get extra credit for just showing up to his office hours and just creates a positive environment to learn. Super chill and likeable.

Really funny, enthusiastic, and caring. Clearly explains content during lectures and is easily available for office hours. GO TO EXAM REVIEW SESSIONS. The TAs basically tell you what is covered on the exams. I rarely paid attention in class and still got an A. Retakes are also available and are usually identical to original exams.

Sun is upbeat and passionate but does not teach the coursework in depth and this will not prepare you for chem in the future. Lectures are required and rarely helpful, but he offers a lot of opportunities for extra points. I would assume this is because students will need it most of the time.

His class prepared me heavily for organic chemistry and ended both with an A. He holds office hours OFTEN and making it a priority to go will make this class a piece of cake. Retakes for tests if needed but they are slightly more difficult than you would assume. Pay attention in lecture, the clickers style questions appear on exams.

I took general chem 1 and 2 with him last year and now am taking organic chemistry. I felt like he really prepared me to do well in organic chemistry. I also appreciated the ability to take the exams twice and how he was always available to help with questions on the homework. However, the homework modules did take me hours to do and were difficult
He was very funny and very knowledgeable in the subject. He required you to attend 2 office hours every month (which wasn't bad). It wasn't a hard class as long as you stayed on top of it.
Chem 150 was so easy, definitely take this class. You get to retake tests, you can only fail if you don't pay attention. Easiest class ever. Make sure you get Shuai

He is the goofiest little ball of joy at KU. He really wants students to learn the material and you can tell he really cares about you. He does move quite quickly though.
He lets you bring a 'cheat sheet' to every exam, has 2 retakes on every test, and offers 2 grading styles to get you the most points.
Bro really wants you to succeed.

Shuai is a fantastic professor who genuinely cares about his students' success. His engaging lectures and open-door office hours make the challenging material manageable. I found Unstuckstudy super helpful for study prep too.
The Best Prof you will ever have for a required class, makes chem fun!!!

Professor Sun was amazing due to how he was able to engage with his classes. All of his lectures involved some kind of personal activity that made it feel a bit more hands on. He also deeply cares about all of his students when it comes to their mental health and ability to succeed in his course. I would not hesitate to take his class again!

This class was a fun one. It was a little fast paced, but I was still able to learn the material well. He has office hours almost daily so it is extremely easy to get help from him whenever needed. There is a pretty good amount of assignments, but many of them are extra credit/ help a lot with understanding, so there is often reason to do them.

This is a good course to take if you want to take chemistry and want a teacher that'll help you without fear of asking. I personally feel like it is easy to get a B/A, because of the retakes, extra credit, and in class participation. As long as you come to class, finish assignments, this class shouldn't be too stressful. HE is very funny!
Shuai is amazing. I would definitely take him again. He gives amazing opportunity and he will definitely give you many chances to pass the exams and class.

Dr. Shuai is a goated professor and one of the best ones I have had so far. He has office hours every day which makes it easy to meet him outside of the class if you have concerns. He is also giving you multiple opportunities for retakes and the class is designed for students to succeed.
He was very fair and let you retake the exams. There is quite a bit of homework outside of class which is about 3 times a week.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Not much need be said. Dr. Shaui is a great professor and if you're taking CHEM 170 with him, you'll have a good time. Lots and lots of opportunities to get the grade you want. It's apparent he cares about the students' learning.

He is an amazing professor who cares about his students and wants them to succeed. His class is set up so you have multiple chances to do well and he has office hours ALL THE TIME. The course material is difficult but he will help you if you need it. His lectures are very engaging and cover a lot of material.

Prof sun cares a lot for his students (and chemistry) and gives so many resources to make sure you succeed. His grading system was intimidating at first, but it really is made to ensure that those who work hard succeed. He was always open to feedback and took time to remember each student in his 100+ student classes. Could not recommend him enough!

Dr. Sun is the best professor I have had. He is super entertaining and makes chemistry fun. Attendance is mandatory and there are clicker questions in class so you have to be there, but even if attendance was optional I would have still gone because the lectures are genuinely entertaining and helpful. He also has office hours for hours per day.

Amazing professor and an amazing person. Class is difficult because of the content. Quite a bit of homework but it does help with understanding. Uses IClicker. If you go to his office hours you will get a LOT of help and get to know him more.

Shuai's office hours were very long so it was easy to get help from him. I think he was funny and he was a very nice person. He ended up making our final not cumulative, and he gives multiple retake opportunities and extra credit for attending his office hours. He was not very organized though and jumped from topic to topic randomly which was bad.

If you're taking any General Chemistry classes (specifically CHEM 130, 150, 170, and 135) PLEASE do yourself a favor and have Dr. Shuai as your professor! I had him as a professor for CHEM 170 my very first semester of my Freshman year and he was hands-down one of my favorite professors I had. He is so kind and hilarious as well!

Shuai is fantastic, I am so sad I only get this class with him. He genuinely cares, and while there is a lot of homework, he reopens assignments periodically and allows you to retake all exams. He even created a retake of the final. Best professor ever, I will miss this class.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Shuai was one of the most entertaining professors I have ever encountered. While chemistry isn't the most thrilling subject to most people, Shuai does his absolute best to keep his lectures engaging and interactive. The material can be quite difficult at times but his accessibility outside of lecture is incredible.

Shuai is amazing! He truly cares if you understand the class content. Go to his office hours! He hosts office hours 2-3 times every day, so there's no excuse not to go (go to get help or just to socialize). He allows a cheat sheet for tests (you can write any notes/equations) and allows test retakes. An A in his class is very achievable.

Through the semester Shuai proved numerous times how he cares about his students. He is always hosting office hours, engaging and listening to students about work load problems or any problem and making adjustments to fix it. During office hours Shuai is one of the most kind and helpful professors I have ever met, any student is lucky to have him.

Shuai is the best professor I've had. He makes lecture entertaining and genuinely wants you to succeed in his class. He changed the grading system so the majority of students would do good. Although the class is somewhat tough he makes it worthwhile.
hard class, amazing teacher

The best professor I have ever had. I still visit his office hour even though I am not taking his class anymore. He welcome everybody. He love talking to people during office hour, so if you attend his office hour during his course, he'll love you for life.

Professor sun provides you with lots of material and practice to make sure you are understanding the topic you are learning. In class, he breaks down subjects so that they are easy to understand. Also in class, he promotes participating and talking with your group members. He also allows retakes on exams which is very helpful.
Great lecturer, makes chemistry not so bad.

TAKE CHEM WITH SHUAI, you will not regret it. His class is very easy to get an A in. Class is set up so you only have to get an 85% on Tests to receive an A, so long as you do homework and participate. Go to office hours, he enjoys receiving feedback from his students. If you miss homework they will reopen it for you with no late penalty.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Shuai is by far the best teacher at KU. He gives very clear and easily understandable exams. Also allows retakes on every exam. Definitely recommend him for chem 130 & 135.

Shuai is by far the best teacher at KU. He gives very clear and easily understandable exams. Exams are exactly like the practice exams just with different numbers. He gives a half sheet of paper for each exam which allows students to write needed equations and other material on it to help with your exam. Definitely recommend him for chem 130 & 135.

One of the few professors that can make something as boring or terrible as Intro to Chemistry actually fun. His tests are incredibly hard, but is generous with his curves. He is fun and cares about his students. Would definitely recommend taking him if you need to take a chemistry course.

Shuai gives excellent lectures and provides plenty of resources to help on all the exams. He also allows exams to be retaken once and is very understanding when it comes to turning in late homework assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I hated chemistry, there was not a single thing about it that made sense to me ever. Ive taken shuai for three semesters now, and every time its one of my favorite classes. shuai's effort to connect with their students shows they care.even though there is a lot of homework and the exams are hard; I really recommend taking shuai if you can.
Best professor out there

Shuai is such a fun professor, and he makes chemistry learning really engaging! It took me a while to get used to his unique teaching style & grading system, but when I look back, I learned so much more. He strongly encourages participation, so get ready to discuss! Make sure to attend his office hours, even if you don't have a question.

THE BEST PROFESSOR AT KU. He made this class easier this last semester as well so it's a joke. You should be able to get an A very easily. Get to know the man he is cool and will give extra credit if he knows your name. TAKE HIM!

Dr. Sun is a great chemistry professor. If you are a disabled student, I highly recommend that you take his Chem170 course over a Chem130 course, even though it is more difficult as he is extremely understanding. His unique grading system prioritizes learning and flexibility over rushing for the A.

Shuai is a fantastic professor. Super caring and compassionate about his students. The lectures are jam packed so come into class paying attention and ready to take good notes- IMO, good notes are the key to success in this class.

Professor Shuai was the best professor I have had the delight of having in any course in my academic career.His dedication to the student is clear and he will go the extra mile to help you.Attendance is paramount and the content is intense but very doable.The exam content is difficult but he offers the chance to retake unit exams.Overall 10/10.

I had always heard chem was one of the hardest classes you would take in college, but I feel like Shuai showed me what chemistry could be. Don't get me wrong, you're going to have to work hard and study, but he is so understanding and one of the most genuine people you will ever meet. The grading system is strange but makes sense in the end.

One of my favorite professors this semester. He is caring towards his students and willing to accommodate, he knows students by their first names in the 200+ lecture halls. Lectures are informative and enjoyable, but attendance and clicker are mandatory to get a good grade. Just follow what he tells you to do and you will have no trouble.

great, personable teacher that actually tries to be friends with his students. lectures are helpful but mandatory since he uses iclicker and posts questions in class. grading criteria is confusing since there are so many factors that go into getting an A. don't go to office hours? automatic C. other than that, he makes the class very doable.

Dr. Sun is a great person that cares about students/makes an effort to build relationships. This semester his grading system was primarily effort based. Office hours/assignments were required, class is fast paced, but assignments were for completion. We could retake his tests. His teaching/grading style might not be for everyone, but he's great.

Dr. Sun is a professor that truly cares about his students. His grading can be considered to be on the harder end of the spectrum, but he is there to make sure everyone succeeds. As long as you show up for class and go to office hours when needing help, there is no doubt that you will get a grade you want in the class.

Shuai is such a nice guy and a really good professor as well. He teaches in a way that helps you actually understand the topics, and gives lots of examples to practice. He makes an effort to learn everybody's names in his 150+ people lectures. He is always available for office hours, and will talk with you about anything. He is an amazing professor

Shuai is a nice guy, and does care about your success in the class. However, he believes what is common sense to him is automatically common sense to the students, which isn't too helpful, especially if you struggle with chem. Lectures are fast paced, so come to class prepared beforehand. Also, iClicker is a HUGE part of the class. Good luck.
Teaches material really well and is always available to help if needed. Tried to make sure everyone learns material before moving on
Chem 150. Definitely a tough class (took last year), but one of the more clearly-spoken lecture profs I've had. Friendly.

Has good intentions but fails to successfully teach the concepts. Assumes what is common sense to him is common sense to students. assigns homework due in class the day he is giving the lecture over what the homework is about. Which is kind of reversed, considering you should go into class, learn the concept, and then do homework over the concept.
Very funny and is invested in students learning.

So I took this class after a semester of gen chem 1, the exams are extremely hard and he does give you study materials but it's WAY too much and hard to hone in on exactly what you need to study. I am usually great with chemistry but I had to drop due to not having 8+ hours a day to study for each exam and do the post test analysis.

Professor Shuai is a professor who will always take time to help you understand things outside of class. He is very caring of students and wants you to succeed but his exams are very difficult. They are usually not anything like what you went over in lecture or on reviews. A hard class with a lot of work but you will pass with lots of effort

wont lie Professor Shuai's class was hard but definitely manageable. Lectures are great, would say his exams arnt really like what you work in the lecture and exam averages were really low (like 40%) but you can still easily pass. He offers lots of EC and its VERY accessible out side of class. You can tell he loves to teach and genuinely cares.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I think Shuai just wasn't a professor that worked for me, especially with the class online. If you're someone who struggles with science courses in general, he's not the professor for you. He does care and is very knowledgeable, but I just could not keep up or follow along with his class.

Fantastic professor especially given how many students he has. If you go to office hours he will make sure you leave understanding whatever you ask. His lectures are amazing despite having so many students.

Prof Sun (Shuai) is amazing. He is letting me do an incomplete until I can finish exams due to medical issues both semesters. He truely cares about your undertsanding in the class and provides extra credit and office hour opportunities. He's extremely nice and caring. He is also really funny. Definitely recommend Shuai!

I took this class as a visiting student. Shuai has the students best interest at heart. He offered extra points on the exam so you could get some questions wrong while still achieving a 100%. I recommend going to office hours when you can. On the last day of class Shuai gave me a hug and wished me the best of luck at my home school.

Very enthusiastic lectures and values participation heavily. A majority of the classes points come from tests and in-class participation with iClicker questions. Always is available for office hours, class has a lot of homework compared to other classes as well as required readings. Great teacher and super approachable. He also loves Disney.

Professor Sun was one of the best professors I've had. The course was pretty challenging, but he was very good at explaining things, and if you didn't understand he was very accessible during his office hours for more one-on-one help.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Sun was one of my favorite professors this semester. He finds a way to make Chemistry lectures fun and exciting. The lab is helpful sometimes and TAs are always available. He gives practice exams and the solutions for every exam he does. Solid professor for it being his first year teaching the course.

One of the best teachers I've ever had. I hate chemistry, but he made me want to go to class. He's helpful any time and answers emails quickly. My only issue with the class is the difficulty of the tests. I had an A average in everything except for tests, which I failed most of. Just make sure to not put off studying and you'll be fine though.
Shuai is one of the best people that I have ever met. He genuinely cares and wants his students to succeed. And he makes that doable as long as you put in the work too.

Shuai is probably the best prof to take for chem, his class is a little harder because of the exams and homework, but he gives you everything you need to succeed and gives a ton of extra credit at the end of the semester. If you don't put in the work you probably won't get a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Great guy, above average difficulty

Fast-paced lectures, but lots of opportunities to practice the concepts discussed in the lectures. Provides notes ahead of time, so you're not completely blindsided. Loves when students come to office hours, amazing TAs.
gives awesome extra credit. Really cares about you. the exams are hard but he gives you all the materials you need to succeed.
Office hours everyday which are very helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The material in this class was extremely hard and I felt like Shaui was great at trying to make the material learnable. He was super flexible and nice. His explanations always made sense and I felt like his notes helped me study for the test. This class is very hard and confusing but I think Shuai has the students best interest at heart.
Very difficult class for me. Learned a lot. Very difficult tests but lots of extra credit available.
Hard tests but wants students to succeed. Will work out something to make harder tests more fair.

He is AMAZING, better than any other chem teacher you will have. Try to have a personal relationship w/him by going to office hours, he'll help you with other classes,career opportunities and life advice. His teaching style is v easy to understand, you just need to put in bare effort. He cares a lot about his students and prepare u well for ochem.

Shuai is SUCH a nice guy and truly wants you to pass with a high grade. He understands a majority of his students are pre-med and the pressure of wanting to receive an A in chem. You have unlimited tries on the HW to get 100% and doesn't have quizzes. 3 test and then a cumulative final. His test are insanely hard but gives so much EC to balance it
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Sun's class is HARD. It's much harder than the other CHEM130 classes but I would take it again any day. He's an amazing teacher and wants his students to do well. His exams are extremely hard but he's generous with extra credit. You definitely have to earn an A but it teaches you really good study habits. I definitely recommend Dr. Sun.

Shaui is a nice guy, and easy to contact, but his class was hard. I met with him after the first exam (class average of a 55% percent... was 'curved' later tho). He informed me that the practice exams wouldn't benefit me for studying for the exam. He was frustrating to have as a professor, but very caring nonetheless. Definitely don't fall behind.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Truly one of the most caring professors. It almost feels like he's too nice at times! Tests are no joke, but in chemistry they never are. He gives you the tools to pass, such as his well-organized lecture slides, homework questions, etc. Take time to actually study, don't put it off, and you'll do fine. He wants everyone to pass and it shows!

Dr. Sun is a FANTASTIC professor to take introductory chemistry courses with. He cares like no other, and you will find yourself laughing constantly at lecture. He wants to work with you and get to know you. Reach out! He even offers extra credit if he remembers your name by the end of the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Very very hard tests but very understanding and wants you to succeed.

Hands down the greatest professor at the University of Kansas. Very passionate in teaching and in the subject of Chemistry as well. Attend his office hours as much as you can because you will learn the most there. Study a lot for the course and do lots of practice problems before showing up for the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Though the class material itself isnt exactly easy, Shuai makes sure to give all of his students a chance to excel with tons of open office hours and a very approachable personality when expressing the opportunities for any help or extra credit for the class.

He was such a good professor! His lectures were fast paced, but he's almost always in his office hours and would love to help you with anything. VERY caring, helpful, and kind! You can tell how much he cares about his students and chemistry in general. There is a lot of EC given at the end of the semester, so no need to panic about not getting an A

One of the greatest professors I have ever had in my life. He is so loving, caring, and respectful to all his students. His lectures/powerpoints are very long but they are well-organized and easy to understand/read. With all the EC he gives I don't see how you cannot get a B or even an A. He's very accessible outside of lecture, so don't hesitate.

Lots of extra credit. I don't even like chemistry but shuai is such an awesome human I didn't even mind his class. Best professor you will ever get. Always has his door open for students and is very understanding. His tests are difficult but he helps a lot with preparing for them. 10/10 human

Shuai Sun wants his students to fail and does not care about them as a person. His tests are nothing like anything you ever do in class. He pretends like he cares about his students until he decides that it's okay to give a 5 question exam worth 120 points. He is one of the worst professors KU has to offer. Good luck getting into med school.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Shuai is THE BEST professor I've ever had. He really cared about his students, and it was obvious. Very funny and personable, he made chemistry fun. I actually looked forward to class every day. It's hard to put into words how amazing of a professor he is. I regret not taking CHEM130 from him.

The information comes at a very fast pace and you are expected to learn it from the textbook before the lecture. There is online homework every class. The professor is so kind and genuinely cares about all of his students inside and outside of class. He does everything he can to make sure each student really understands the material. Really funny.

AMAZING professor. He knows how hard chemistry can be and he really tries his best to make everyone understand it. He offers sooo many resources so USE them. I've never had a prof have as many office hours as him and it genuinely makes him happy when you come. So much extra credit but you do have to work for it. Go to lecture and do the HW!!
Dr. Sun is a very kind first-year professor, and he really cares about the well-being of his students. The course within itself isn't easy, but he provides the tools necessary to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I have had so far. The lecture go fast and he covers about 5 sections a day so attendance is important. Also clicker points are super important and easy to get. I failed almost every test and still got a B from all the extra given.

I am now a pre med junior and having him as my first chemistry professor was amazing. He really cares about everyone and wants them to continue on the pre med path. Gives SO much extra credit to where if you put in effort you will get an A in both chem 130 and 135. Labs are dull but you get out early! Definitely take him for gen chem.

I had Shuai for CHEM 130 and 135. He is the better of the Gen Chem professors by far. He genuinely wants you to succeed--there are tons of opportunities for extra credit, and he WANTS you to COME INTO OFFICE HOURS. The lectures are very well structured. Part of your grade is clicker points, so you should go to as many as you can.

Prof Sun truly wants his students to succeed. Not only is he a great professor, he has a great sense of humor and made the class interesting. He also gives a ton of extra credit. I had a friend in the class who failed almost every test but still came out with a B in the class. Definitely the best chemistry teacher at KU, he is known for it!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Shuai is probably my favorite professor at KU. I took CHEM130 and CHEM135 with him. He has great slides, teaches clearly, provides extra credit and practice exams, and is overall a great instructor. He really cares about his students. The content and tests can be difficult, but he provides everything you need to be successful. 10/10.

Shuai is hands down the best general chem professor you could ask for. He is very clear with his expectations and will help every last student in the class. Literally answers your emails in 60 seconds and gives a crazy amount of extra credit at the end of the semester. Dont waste time reading the textbook. He gives you plenty of study materials
Hes honestly amazing and one of the best profs Ive ever had. He gives so much extra credit at the end its crazy. He really wants you to succeed.

Shuai makes chemistry easy. Show up to class, go in his office, do the practice exams and homework, get B's on the tests and you'll be fine. All lectures are posted online. Also gives like 30 extra credit points at the end of the semester. Super good dude.

He is super nice, and really wants you to succeed. I did well on lecture grade, homework, and lab, however, got a D and a C on some of the tests. Still ended with an A because of the extra credit. If you study and complete all of the easy work an A or B is possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I loved chem 130 with shaui! He is so sweet and cares so much about you. If you go into office hours, he is willing to sit down and figure out what you are struggling with. I was convinced that I would end his class with a B until he added extra credit. The extra credit boosted my grade up to an A!

Never had more caring teacher than dr shuai . Best teacher in ku. I really recommend taking a class with him. H egices a lot of extra credit and motivates you to do better in class and makes you live chemistry even if you hate it.

The best class for those of us that work hard and are dedicated but bad test takers. If you just do all the homeworks and extra credit opportunities you can get an A. His lectures are fun and he is a very nice and entertaining guy. He really wants to see students learn, always available for help.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: GIVE THIS MAN A RAISE! Dr. Sun was hands-down the best professor I had this semester. He loves it when students go ask him questions and he's super helpful. His lectures are pretty fun (as far as lectures go). There's a decent amount of homework, but if you do it you'll be in good standing for the tests (which were all MC or TF by the way). :)

Shuai is great. He's really nice and all his students love him. Don't be deceived by a low score on this because he deserves well into the 4 point range. If you're in his class, stay in it. If you're in a different chem class try your hardest to get into his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Shuai is a fantastic individual and an even better teacher. He truly cares about his students and not only want them to get an a but also wants them to fully understand the material. He hands out extra credit like candy and the tests are fair to boot. Office hours are great. A glowing review of this angel of a chem professor isn't enough.

Shuai is the best professor I have had while at KU. He genuinely cares and he will do anything he can to help you understand the information. He offers a ton of office hours and so much extra credit. Just try in this class and you will get a good grade.

Shui is one of the best professors here at KU. He genuinely cares about his students and wants them to succeed. He is always available outside of class and its almost impossible to fail his class unless you really don't care. I got solid B's and C's on exams and ended with an A in the class because of extra credit. He offers a TON of extra credit.
He is so funny and really wants to know you and help you. It would be very hard to fail his class if you utilized all the resources he gives you.

Shuai was a great, he truly knew how to make things understandable for the majority of the class. With that being said, office hours were a great, a very hands on type of professor, he made it a point that you understood the concept before leaving his office. Take all the extra credit opportunities that are offered, the practice exams are crucial!

If you do all the homework (pre and post), attend lectures regularly, and actively participate in lab you will be just fine. With all that being said, studying for the exams is the most important thing. Practice exams are very similar to the exams. If you want an A, spend lots of time studying. Getting an A is possible, but you have to work for it.
Great teacher, wants to help as much as possible and a has a ton of office hours.

I took Chem 130 with a different professor and had only heard great things about Shuai. It was a little bit of the let-down as lectures were hard to follow, however he seems to be very available outside of class and is well respected by most students. The amount of extra credit he gives is such a huge help. Just be sure to apply yourself.

One of the BEST professor at KU. Lots of easy extra credit opportunities (50-55points) and office hours. Chem 130 has 4 exams and 135 has 5 exams (accumulative final). It is not hard to get an A in the class, but you have to work for it. Make sure to do well in the lab and the homework+iclickers.
Absolutely amazing professor, you will absolutely love having him. He gives inspirational talks every now and then and they are really what got me through the semester. Also a pretty easy A!

BOTTOM LINE: he's a great professor and provides you with all the tools AND MORE (hella extra easy credit) you need to get an A in this class. I don't care what others say, I hated chem in high school but got A's in both 130 & 135. Do hw, study and be engaged in lecture. If you fail, its because you failed to prepare. Not Shuai's fault whatsoever.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: He is one of the nicest, sincere people I've ever met. He wants all of us to succeed and understand chemistry. Make sure to study for the exam, since there's only 25 questions, but if even if you don't do well there's a lot more points that you can make it up with. My class definitely fell in love with him, he's the sweetest.

Shuai is super helpful and willing to go the extra mile for students. He is consistently sending midnight reminders and updates about homework etc. Super committed to students. Get to know him early on in office hours. He loves that. He makes chemistry as enjoyable as it could be. Tests aren't bad if you do the test reviews. Take the class with him

Shuai is an incredible professor. I am no longer a STEM major, but I always enjoyed his class and would take more chemistry just to be near him. Such a cutie and gives tons of extra credit, plus inspirational speeches.
Shuai was a great professor, gives lots of opportunities for extra credit and is always available outside of class, especially around exams.

His lectures were very fast paced with clicker questions for participation. Tests we hard and worth a lot of points. Pre and post lecture homework online. The extra credit saved my grade! DO THE EXTRA CREDIT
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: he is one of the only professors i have met who truly cares about us as people, not just bodies he is forced to teach. And he loves the material he teaches. By far the best chem professor at this school.

Shuai is a great lecturer and is always available to help. I chose to take his higher level chemistry course the following semester because I enjoyed him so much. His tests are multiple choice and he gives great opportunities for extra credit as long as you take them. Pay attention, do your homework, and study for the texts, you should receive an A
He is super nice and will help you if you reach out. If you do the work and study you'll be fine.

Shuai is a LIFECHANGING proffesor. He is incredibly inspirational and will make you cry many times during lectures from his inspirational speeches alone. When it comes to classwork, there is a lot of it but it is very easy and not time consuming at all. Shuai is always available to help and is an awesome Prof!

Prof. Sun is very enthusiastic and patient to answer students' questions, which is like what he did in the class. The course he does is also very easy to pass because he gave extra credit in everyexams. Same as chem135 he does.
One of the easiest classes I've ever taken. Do the nightly homework, show up to a few lectures, and study the practice tests hard. No reason to not get a high A in this class.
He is a great guy and will help you whenever you need it. He also understands everyone is human.

He makes his lectures interesting with his humor throughout the class. It's easy to get in contact with him outside of class if you need help understanding anything. He provides tons of resources to prepare for tests that will make exams easy if you take advantage of them all.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Shaui was a great professor but moved extremely fast and sometimes passed over subjects too quickly. He offered a lot of examples in class and adapted his style to fit our classes needs based on feedback. Overall very funny and very smart, you'll pass if you put in a little effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Sun was a great professor! If you read the textbook, as he instructs you to, complete the practice homework, and study his slides, you will do well in his class. He gives you ALL the resources you need to pass his exams, just do what he says! He is a bit hard to understand at first, but you get used to it .
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: I enjoy his lectured and never missed a class. I did not do well on exams but that is my own fault because he offers so much in the way of practice that if you put in the time and effort you can get a really good grade. He always has office hours and has always been very nice to me when I went.

Shuai Sun is an okay professor. He is a terrible lecturer, as he is loud, fast, and doesn't explain his clicker questions very well. He can also tend to be a little condescending. However, he makes himself accessible and if you try, it isn't hard to get an A.

This is honestly one of the worst classes I've taken at the university. Although he is charming during lectures and explains things kinda well, his exams are no where near as simple as his lectures and he asks you questions that he hasn't even covered in the notes. Would NEVER take the class again. I had to drop it because of how poorly I did.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: The class is very disorganized. Dr. Sun went through the first module so slowly it was maddening, then went through thermo, gases, and quantum way too fast, then slowed down again for orbitals. Be prepared for homework with only a day's notice, and to use outside sources to teach yourself, especially if you're moving on to the next chem class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: My time in Dr. Sun's class was fairly good.  He was a decent professor, often funny, and was willing to help outside of class.  The tests are hard, the homework is long, but it's chemistry, what did you expect?
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Good profesor! Can have trouble translating his slides.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Sun knows his chemistry well and he makes class fun. Just like any class you have to study in order to pass. He has office hours and I go to him or the TA whenever I need help. If you put in the effort, like I have than I'm sure you'll get a fair grade.

Clearly knows his material, but is absolutely abysmal at transferring this information onto the class. Lectures are all over the place. Many of his slides are often ill prepared or even incorrect, Had only 1 exam where he hasn't had to correct a choice or question in the middle of the work time. Lectures you on why his shoddy work is excusable.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Shuia Sun's class will probably be a real treat.  You've gotta actually try to do well, but it's not too hard.

His lectures are all over the place and very difficult to understand. The homework is unhelpful because it is hardly related to the material on the test. The class overall is disorganized and hard to understand. I do not recommend.

Dr. Sun makes this class WAY harder than it has to be. I took AP chem in high school and expected this class to be fairly easy. His lectures and notes are very disorganized. When I went into his office hours for help, he told me to look at the lecture notes-not helpful at all. I was able to get an A in this class only because I had a helpful lab TA

Professor Sun tries really hard to make everyone pass. He is almost always available outside of class, makes notes so you can follow along during class, makes practice assignments to do at home, etc. If you want to pass, you will, but it's very easy to get away with minimal effort. If you don't take advantage of his handouts, tests will be hard.

Dr. Sun makes this class ridiculously confusing - I took several chemistry classes in high school, so this class should not be hard. The lectures are worthless, but you need to be in class for clicker points.

Dr. Sun makes chemistry more confusing than it has to be. I took AP chemistry in high school, and he is teaching the harder way to do things. The Mastering Chemistry takes forever and isn't even worth that much of your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Get a tutor

Smart man, but should not be teaching other people. Makes things more complicated than they have to be. I went into this course with a lot of Chemistry knowledge and am leaving more confused. Homework is too hard and too long.

He's got a good sense of humor, but like the person before me said, he is all over the place and very hard to understand.  Attendance is basically mandatory because of clicker questions.  I've found that I learn more teaching the material to myself that I do going to lecture.  Only really good thing is he always tells you what is on the next test.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Professor Sun is very funny, but can be difficult to understand at times. His lectures can be all over the place. I would definitely read his lecture notes and the chapters out of the book before exams

I'm not surprised by the people that don't give Max high ratings. His class is for people who are serious about working in the broadcast industry and he treats you how a news director would treat a reporter. He prepared me more than any other teacher to work in an actual newsroom. But don't expect him to hold your hand.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Max is one of the best professors I have had at KU. He is one of the few professors that will give it to you straight about working in the industry. He is extremely well connected and is a valuable resource in getting a good job post grad.

Max was one of the toughest professors I ever dealt with.  His tends to ramble on unrelated topics during his lectures, making them seem long and boring.  When it comes to actual journalism, though, my writing improved significantly because of him.  Good journalist, okay teacher.

His grade scale makes absolutely zero sense. It seems as if he reads the name of the student at the top of the paper and then just gives you a grade based on whether he likes you or not. Didn't learn anything from his lectures, he just sort of throws out random facts in which majority of them are from 6-10 years ago. Terrible professor.

I took Professor Utsler for Jour 620, TV-News class. He can be a little dry during lecture and a tough grader, but he is so helpful and knows his stuff (especially for broadcasting.) He is a great resource if you want help with an assignment or something like job searching

Interesting class, half online half in lecture which was nice and different. Max is fine if you give him a chance, he tries his best to keep things fresh and enthusiastic. The class isn't the easiest but you have relatively little work to do and it's not too rough getting an A.

He sucks, I didn't learn much of anything  from his lab, but lecture was key. He grades you the same on every assignment but doesn't really make clear what he is looking for or due dates. Don't recommend his lab but he's an okay guy.

Agree with comment saying Max decides A and B students at beginning of semester and then stays consistent. Unfortunately, I was a "B." Expectations are never clear, grading is unnecessarily harsh and then he wonders why nobody works hard to get involved.
He is crazy. He never tells you what his expectations are, but grade you poorly. Never gives feedbacks. Terrible guy

DONT BUY THE BOOK!  There are reading assignments, but he never talks specifically about it during lecture and there are no tests.  I'm sure it has handy tips in it, but it's not worth $75.  Max's criticism is brutal, but I think you'll find that in any 415 class.  To succeed, do more work than you think you should.

I had Max for Message Development Lab. He was extremely boring in lecture, and I felt most of the things he told us were common sense. He is not very helpful in lab, and does not tell you what he expects out of projects, then grades you lower on them. Very nice guy, but not a good teacher, he grades hard, without telling you what he wants.
He decides what he thinks of your work before he sees it..and then he stays with the style the whole year
Max decides which students are "A" students "B" students etc at the beginning of the semester.  Then, he consistently grades them that way for the entire course.
