He did seem like a cool guy, so I'd recommend getting to know him in his morning lectures. He will call on you in class though.

Exams contained information that wasn't gone over in class. He has one whole slideshow for the entire semester so it's impossible to find what you need to go over in order to study. Went to a tutor and even she was confused about his way of teaching, so that's helpful... Didn't really offer help just kind of left it to his TAs.

Besson is a nice guy, but if you aren't perfect in math you will struggle. Problems in class aren't fully explained step-by-step, you are just given the logistics. Tests are totally unrecognizable and no partial credit is given.

Besson has a bad reputation because the class is difficult, & he sometimes struggles to explain concepts in ways that students understand. BUT he will re-explain a million times if you ask him to; he really cares about his students. Ignore the practice exams. Instead, re-watch the lecture videos & redo the lecture problems & you will be set.
Students that don't do well in his class are not even trying to understand the content. He cares about his students, and will explain concepts to anyone who asks. Also hilarious.

Has a policy to never give more than 5% A's in any class. He gives unrecognizable in-class paper essay exams, offers no help to students, and never answers questions in class (and just monotonically reads his slides aloud in class, anyway). If you're pre-med, you can say goodbye to your career by taking this course. Definitely wait a semester!!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: So two faculty teach this class at KU - one (Wu) is an easy A, you plug-and-chug equations, get tons of extra credit and don't have to work! Besson requires that you understand the material and emphasizes concept; moreover, you get absolutely no help, there's no textbook and he ignores students! Definitely avoid him and go with Wu!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great teacher. Heads up: tests are open note, open book, and follow homework almost exactly. No partial credit on exams though. You can make it through the class if you make sure you understand the CAPS and the underlying concepts prior to exams. TA's are also a great help. Use your resources wisely, and you can easily do good in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I highly recommend Besson. I was nervous going into his class this fall, but he has completely changed how he's teaching the class compared to past years. The exams are online, open-book, multiple choice, and very similar to the homework problems. He also walks through the homework every morning before lecture.

Honestly if you go to class and take notes, you're gonna pass. In lecture he gives you the equations & you go through example problems. During discussions (which are recorded) he goes through examples of hw problems which are basically what's on exams. Exams online & multiple choice. idk if something changed since previous reviews but its not bad.

Don't bother reading older ratings, he's not like that anymore. I feared physics and he made the class do-able. He actually tries to improve the class and he's woke. Exams are online, and if you go to the discussion he tells you how to do the homework. He actually cares about students understanding. Favorite prof so far at KU. Take him for 114.

Amazing professor! So so funny and gives clear guideline for homework and exams. Exams are pretty similar to practice exams and homework. He explains everything if you have a question and is very easy to talk to. The structure of the class is perfect (homework problem due every day of lecture and 10 question exams every couple weeks).

I thought Professor Besson was great. He keeps class entertaining and before each of his lectures, he has an optional discussion in which he explains in great detail how to do the assignment that is due that day. All of the assignments follow the exam structure perfectly. All lectures are recorded and posted so that you can use them for the exam.

Besson's teaching style is horrible. He gives you a book to read and expects you to learn on your own (no actual teaching).  He uses lecture time to clarify what he wants on the homework and as Q&A sessions. I knew my experience with this class was going to be bad when he said, "I was previously banned from teaching this class".
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Guy has a bad wrap. He learned from student comments and created an esoteric free physics course. I was extremely disappointed that he would not be teaching my PHSX 115 course. He had explicit goals and instructions for each assignment. Each assignment was an instructional guide for the exams. Best physics professor at KU.

Overall a funny person, and his anecdotes make the class more bearable. The teaching style, however, is atrocious as its very heavily math based with focus on concepts on exams that were not discussed in any depth. There is also little guidance on what needs to be focused on, which is rough in a course with such heavy material

David besson is the worst professor I've ever had. I've never failed a class and I will this one. Tests are ridiculous, everything is extremely overly complicated. I went into every assignment and test dreading it because I knew I'd do terribly. Doesn't provide you with the materials needed to do well on exams
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Besson is easily the worst professor I have had in 3 years at KU. He does not care about teaching and has no interest in improving his class.

David Besson gets a bad reputation as a professor from students however he is not bad at all. He literally gives students the tools needed to learn the material and the tests are pretty much the homework. There is a lot of homework and practice problems so most students should be doing well in the class. He is a pretty chill dude

Don't study for the exams. I got the same grade on an exam I studied 10 minutes for as one I studied 8-10 hours for. It's a waste of your time. Nothing in lecture is on the exam, also, so watching/attending lecture is pointless. Nothing in the homework is on the exam either, so only do that for the (completion) points.

This man knows 100% that hes a terrible teacher and that his methods dont work, but wont actually do anything to remedy those issues. Thinks his sole purpose is research so he cant be bothered to put in the effort.

Worst prof ever. Steer clear. Im a 4.0 student, and theres a slim chance Ill even pass this class. Hes very disrespectful and relies on TAs. Even if you ask for help, you arent getting any. Get ready to watch khan academy videos he sends out - theyre more helpful than lectures. Hes more focused on a $6 million research grant than teaching.

I've never been so lost in my life, pretty sure I know just as much about physics leaving as I did going in. Recycled exams as practice exams that didn't line up with the material for our class so not helpful. Exams were designed purposefully to be way harder than anything in class. Run away, just run.

If you can avoid taking physics with this professor do it by any and all means possible. He would provide confusing/disorganized lecture materials. The homework assignments had nothing to do with what was on the exams. There was also information on my MCAT that was not taught in this class. Also, when I asked for help none was given to me.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: For a 100 level college "introductory physics" course, the expectations held by dave were unbelievable. They were more than unclear throughout the entire semester, and right at the end of the semester, many students grades took a massive hit. Do not email him, you will likely get a narcissistic response that answers none of your questions. Goodluck
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Quiz was nothing like the homework. Gave us one example for each topic and didn't cover the material. The TA did everything, the grading, teaching, and helping students - Besson just posted a short, nonsensical video like once a week that didn't help.

The worst professor I have ever had in my life. Decided he didn't want to teach since it was online and we never heard from him unless he was sending out hostile emails/announcements. Learned nothing to help me with the MCAT. KU physics department did nothing when students asked for help. Nobody cared besides the TAs.
David didnt teach anything . He was snobby and made online learning a lot harder than it had to be. Stick to research . Retreat from education

He is easily the worst professor I have ever had in my entire life. He never taught a single thing and expected us to know everything. Tests were incredibly hard and there was no partial credit for all the math you had to do. I could write a book on how bad of a professor he was this year. Im praying for everyone who takes this class with him.

I had no interaction with him at all; only the TAs. The ONLY reason I passed is because of the TA's Zoom sessions before the tests. He taught us the basics for each unit through 10-min videos for each homework & then expected way more out of us during the test. Don't take the final unless absolutely necessary; it's notorious for being impossible.

Prof Besson didn't lecture at all, I'm not really sure what he did other then respond to emails in an unprofessional and hostile manner. Before taking the final Prof Besson sent out an announcment saying "too many people have A's". So he made the final so much harder then the other test, even included some stuff we didn't learn!
Honestly one of the most disorganized, worst classes I have ever taken in my four years at Kansas.

Besson is undoubtedly a wicked smart guy with decent intentions, but oh boy... It could not be more clear that this guy does NOT want to be teaching. Lectures aren't in person (thanks, Covid), so he has opted to simply not teach at all. The TA review sessions have been my only saving grace in prepping for exams. I almost WISH he were lecture heavy.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I'm currently in Besson's class. He has chosen not to use an online format that he has admitted works for other teachers in favor of a form of not teaching at all. He has the TAs go over the homework, all the tests are online and graded through the system, and he doesn't lecture at all, so what exactly is he getting paid for?
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Besson gets a lot of shade but he does care about his students and actively tries to improve. His exams are literally copies of the homework and examples in class. If you're stuck, go to the recitation after class, office hours, or TA's. It's not that hard if you put in the work and stop blaming him for everything! Watch recordings of lectures!!

Besson isn't the clearest on some concepts, but he is still effective at teaching the concepts so long as you put the effort in. He is really funny, which makes his lectures pretty entertaining. His tests are fairly easy, multiple-choice, and based on the homework problems. So long as you pay attention and make an effort, this is an easy class.

I had Prof. Besson for both semesters. There is really not a whole lot you can do to prepare for the tests. They are quite difficult even though I went to every review session. HOWEVER, if you are pre-med then TAKE HIM. Everything we learned was from the MCAT and super helpful. Also, very funny guy.

In four years at KU, Dave Besson is by far the worst professor I ever had. Most of his teaching is unclear, his slides don't make sense, and the homework is only partially helpful for test preparation. I got an A in 114 without any issue, and I've never had issues understanding the material until I got stuck with Besson for 115. Avoid if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I've never struggled with a class before, but this class gave me PTSD. If you've never taken physics before expect to be lost. Doesn't teach concepts in class, just goes straight to practice problems that don't make sense. I even had a tutor and barely passed the class. He knows students are lost but doesn't change teaching method to compensate
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: A lot of people give Besson a bad wrap, but he is honestly a good professor. I didn't take physics until my Junior year due to my schedule, and honestly, it was the easiest class I had all semester. The tests were easy if you understood the formulas and each test had extra credit, so I never scored below 90%. He's also really hilarious :)

I was nervous about this class given all of the reviews, but they're not accurate. Yes, the class is test heavy (every other week), but they do reflect the lectures and in-class problems. There's even extra credit on each test that is from old material. He's also willing to help, so go to office hours. Most of the test averages were above 75%.

In fall 2019 he completely changed the structure of his class. Test are weighted very heavily and they are not easy. I love him as a person though. He really is the funniest professor I have had and cares but his test just didnt reflect what was went over in class. There are 3 homework assignments due a week and lab is a drag.
this person should not be teaching, period. Totally insensitive to the students. Disorganized and rambling. Everybody is totally lost...
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I agree with everything that's been written about this professor. He expects us to prepare for class by reading his slides, but who has time? Students learn in-class, not by doing work outside of class! He also assumes everyone is good at algebra, which isn't true. He never gives any second chances, either...
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: Besson is an extremely knowledgeable man and scientist. However, he makes it difficult to understand the subject matter in physics 114 if one has never taken a physics class before. For most people, this is the first college physics class that they take, so this is unacceptable. He could improve on explaining the math at a more simplistic level.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: We get zero information - no pre-class slides, no textbook, no accessibility to the instructor outside of class, no office hours. He comes in at 3 pm, leaves at 3:50 and the entire class is left scratching their heads. Never answers emails, or gives any second chances. Awful instructor, everybody is lost...

Dr. Besson's lectures are filled with him rambling about things completely unrelated to the material. I think he tries to make it "fun" but it makes it more confusing. I basically taught the material to myself, but it's not impossible to well in this class. I learned a lot from my lab GTA, so take advantage of them. Very odd guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The semester I took this class, so many people complained that he resigned from teaching phsx 115, so we had an even worse teacher the next semester. It is not his job to reteach you trig and algebra. He actually explains concepts really well for a physics professor, as long as you can remember how to do math. His class is not hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Besson is one of the best teachers that I have ever had! He is really funny, humble, and obviously very intelligent. He clearly has a passion for physics, and if you go to his office hours he will be very kind and understanding with you and explain things in depth over and over if you need it. Just be ready to complete a lot of homework!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I do the homework. I read the textbook. I attend class, pay attention, and take notes. Then why do I understand nothing?! The quiz questions he gives us during class are wayyy harder than anything the textbook has. We have to work these quiz problems while the rest of the lecture is still going on :( If I didn't need this class to grad I'd drop it
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: So many people complained about this class and that is so frustrating, but that's just the people who don't know how to do simple algebra or trig. Show up to class and pay attention and you will do just fine. Theres also so much extra credit. Please, just learn how to do algebra and don't be dumb. Dave is funny and an on/above avg prof
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Physics is hard, but Dave made physics easier than I have ever had it before. You have to work to get the grade you want, but you are given the tools to succeed. Get help early and you will get the grade you deserve. The TAs are also very helpful and super nice so don't be afraid to reach out! I hated physics until this class and Dave!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Many people complain about Besson's classes but that is typically because he expects students to do homework and test prep outside of class and many students fail to pt in any effort and do poorly and blame Besson as a scapegoat. He explains things thoroughly in lecture and works through problems, Overall he is a great professor!

He is a phenomenal guy, very intelligent and bright. But he is definitely someone that not everyone understands. He expects you to know the materials, even though it intro-level course. On the first day of class, we jumped into doing problems and I didn't even know what any of the terms meant. Get ready to do a lot of self-teaching!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He is very smart and will think that the students are smart and are understanding the material unless told otherwise. So, if you dont understand something during class, ask him and he will break it down for you. As long as you let him know youre not getting it, he will be very accommodating! Also hes super funny!

Worst class I have ever taken. So unprepared and very all over the place. Only talks about a topic for 5 mins or less and moves on. He does NOT explain anything and expects us to know how to do the homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dave is a great guy. The exam is just like the homework, and he gives 2 questions of extra credit which constitutes to +20%.
expectations far exceed what is the norm for a 100-level introductory course. Instructor assumes math preparation that biology majors simple don't have.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: provides us with almost no pre-exam preparation, but expects us to do well. Inaccessible and unapproachable. Clearly feels he has better things to do than spend time on undergraduates. Be prepared to learn very little and hope for a favorable curve.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Besson is the most humble, and amazing professor I've ever had. He taught in a great way and his examples are hilarious. He is caring and always there for you, even during his free time. He is an extremely successful man that keeps busy, and students assume the world revolves around them. If you are struggling, you need seek help from him.

Besson is honestly an incredible professor, yes you have to study ahead for the "exam" every other week but he has made his expectations clear with lots of offered extra credit. The people who heavily complained are ones who never put effort and needed a scapegoat to blame. He's one of the best professors I had and deserves more respect!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Enjoyable professor. Fun personality. All lectures are based around doing actual problems rather than teaching theory. Exams are exactly like the homework he gives you so you know what to expect. A few complain about exams but the average is an 80% and there's extra credit on each exam. Physics can be hard no matter who your professor is.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor is absolutely unfair to students! Exams bear no resemblance whatsoever to lecture material or homeworks. Nobody understands what's going on; 300 out of 300 students complain that they're totally confused, and nothing happens!

absolutely nothing good about this professor. I emailed him, like, 50 times in one day with a simple question and he was too busy to write back once. I've heard the same story from lots of friends of mine. Avoid at all costs. Definitely avoid for phsx115.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Worst professor I've ever had. Period. Fortunately, enough people protested so he won't be teaching phsx 115 in the fall. Yay! Win for the students!

One of the best teachers I've ever had. There's homework after every class, but it's just 1 problem and it's just like what's done in class and what will be on the exam. The exams are 10 multiple choice +2 extra credit, and if you get a score you don't like he let's you do super easy retakes for full credit. Hilarious guy and really caring, too.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He is the worst professor I've ever hard. Cool guy and a good teacher but doesn't provide with any resources (not even a textbook) no powerpoint slides, no lecture video and bases off his exams on one problem from one lecture that is a cumulative problem (multiple choice, no partial crdt). Too caught up for his research to care about his students.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Besson was awesome, we had "exams" every other Friday morning but they were only ten questions (plus extra credit questions) and his lectures prepared us very well for them. Of course labs aren't fun, and reading the book isn't either, but I looked forward to going to lecture because he knows how to teach and always has cool stories.

Professor Besson is the man! Exams are very fair! In class, he guides us through difficult concepts expertly without any slides, then we solve problems after he gives us the ingredients to understand. He's great in office hours and so down-to-Earth. He really understands his students and loves his teaching! I'll miss him so much! A gift to KU!

Dr. Besson has been my favorite professor so far. He connected all of his lectures to real life (hilarious) occurrences, and they were always very interesting. The lectures consist of clicker questions that he walks around and goes over. The test  questions almost always are based on these along with some conceptual info.

Attend lecture and pay attention to in class problems. It's likely they will by on the test for that unit. Know how to do the problems he calls ZCD's as they will be on the test for that unit too. Read the chapters and do the homework. 13 of the homework is extra credit and an additional 5 % on your overall grade!
BEST PROFESSOR EVER. SO KIND. BIG ANIMAL LOVER. FAIR. EXTRA CREDIT. LOVES TO TEACH. INTERESTED. ENGAGED. BRILLIANT. UNDERSTANDING. MOTIVATING.

Dr. Besson is always willing to help students outside of class and is quick to respond to emails. Physics is a difficult subject but the examples done in class are always very similar to what's on the exam. The main part of doing well in his class is attending, asking questions, and practicing the material. Physics can't be learned by osmosis.
David Besson rocks so much he should've been a geology teacher. Enough said.

we've had one exam so far (mean was a 28%!) and I can tell this class is going to be torture. He expects us to know things about physics that are only taught in graduate school. Studied for three days for the exam and it didn't help at all. Avoid at all costs!

Absolutely horrible professor. Uses online homework system, and when asked nicely to create his own system, says he doesn't have time. Obviously has no concern for the students he's supposed to care about.

Dr. Besson may not be the clearest professor, but what is expected is clear. Go to class and copy/study from the examples. There are also 3 hw sessions a week to guarantee you get an A on each assignment. 20% of each test is E.C. and 30% of the hw is E.C. Besson's class was the easiest science class i've taken.

This class was really hard because you had to learn how to do the problems before you come to class (Fall 2013). There is no lecture, just problem solving. The tests are often identical to the in-class, but the homework is completely useless. Besson is nice though and completely hilarious.

If you attend class and work through all the problems the class is really not that difficult.  Test problems came solely from problems covered in class.  Those claiming the class was a disaster must not have attended class regularly.  I am not a natural at math or physics, but was successful in the class and he speaks fluent English.

Class was a total disaster. I learned more in the last two days of the course when we had a sub than in the rest of the semester combined. We get no information about our grades and have no idea where we stand. Surely we should be able to get a better quality instructor for the money we're paying.

Doesnt teach the material.  I have not learned much at all. Test are very unlike his lecture.  Claims average is 75% but from what I hear it's more like 50%. Homework is up weeks before it's due so that's not a problem,  but we don't know how to  do it because the text book and professor are worth less. Also talks about his "misspent youth" a lot.

very disorganized - we get (if lucky) 12 hours notice for homework assignments, and two days notice before exams are announced. No powerpoint, no notes. Way too much conceptual thinking. Good news is that the physics department has found someone else to teach physics 115!

The class is impossible. Yes, there's extra credit on homework but it barely contributes to your overall grade and there are 30 assignments. The tests are way harder than lecture and he doesn't care that his students have no idea what's going on.

Ok, people aren't giving Besson enough credit. He does teach  a very tough class, but it is possible to do well if you go to class every day and take great notes (his tests are based off his notes). Plus, the clicker questions in class are for extra credit. I would recommend taking this class with some friends so you can do the [many] HWs together.

all I can say is that I am a senior with a 4.0 GPA and I have no idea what's going on in this course, and, as far as I can tell, am flunking. My biggest mistake was not reading the recommendations on this website before signing up for this course!!!

Pretty useless, I'm afraid. We come in, he shows a youtube video then lectures from incomprehensible powerpoint slides for 55 minutes (always 5 minutes too long). Never available for questions. I'm basically paying this University to teach myself physics.

It's amazing how this guy can take an entry-level course and make it way harder than it should be. If you want to learn how to plug arbitrary numbers into a calculator to get an answer, by all means you should take his class. If you want to increase your understanding of physics, save your money and take it elsewhere.

Readings are pointless; in-class questions bear no resemblance to exam material whatsoever (not to mention the MCATs). Besson is never willing to help and condescending to students. Definitely wait a semester to take 114. BEWARE!!!!

To succeed in PHSX 114 you MUST do the readings prior to e/a class! Lectures include many i-clicker questions over the material that was to be read and each lecture is delivered assuming you have read and have a basis for the info. Besson is ALWAYS willing to help, just read and ask questions!
Dr. Besson is so great! He is entertaining and he gives so many bonus points, on exams and in homework, that it is near impossible to do bad if you put in the effort.

Simply put, the absolutely worst course I've taken in my four years at KU. Went to every class, did all the homeworks, scored above the mean on the exams, and still ended up with a C. That would have been okay, if I had felt like I learned something, which, I'm sorry to say, is not the case. Don't let this Besson get in front of a class again!

VERY DISAPPOINTING CLASS! Lectures were delivered monotonically, instructor never worked problems, and the exams looked totally foreign. I spent ALL my time on this class at the expense of other courses, and at the end of the semester, found that my score of 95.6 was curved down to a B!! It's obvious Besson can't teach, but don't penalize pre-meds!

Unfortunately, I learned basically nothing from Besson's lectures. Inaccessible outside of class; arrogant to students, he provided no clue as to what would be on the exam and never offered review. If you're pre-med, and need this material for the MCAT's, definitely take it with someone else. Besson also gave very few A's, as I understand.

Warning to anyone who might get stuck taking this course with Besson - DEFINITELY WAIT A SEMESTER! I was relieved to find out that Dr. Shi is teaching the follow-up in the spring, since I learned essentially nothing Besson's lectures this fall and exams had zero resemblance to the lecture material.  Impersonal and unhelpful when approached.

I'm sorry to say that Prof. Besson is at the bottom of the list of professors I've had here at KU. Clearly, he put very little time into the class, and, I felt, had very little respect for the wishes of the students. I understand that he was scheduled to teach the follow-up course; kudos to whoever realized he doesn't belong in a classroom.

This guy is so awesome. He offered an incredible amount of extra credit, and the test questions are EXACTLY like the problems he goes over in class every single day. When a professor tells you what will be on the test and then gives you all of the formulas/constants there's no way to fail. Plus he wears gym shorts and Tshirts to class. Super chill.

This class was fine up until the last few weeks. As soon as the students evaluated Dr. Besson (suspiciously early, I might add), the once quirky, funny guy turned into a total nightmare. He changed all of his grading policies last minute, and was very inconsistent. Material not too difficult overall but the way in which it was taught was horrible.
Dr. Besson is my hero. He is the absolute best physics professor at KU, and his grading system is beyond compare.

First time taking physics? Do not take it with him.  He offers a lot of extra credit opportunities, but tests are way harder than the homeworks and reviews.  Class is not mandatory at all and he talks way over intro to physics material.

Overall great teacher. He is hilarious, doesn't take himself too seriously, and effective at explaining concepts. I loved the class so I only missed one the whole semester. Don't be fooled you will have to read the book and study for the tests but you will love this class if you love physics.

Let me start by saying I like Dave Besson.  He's very entertaining.  He always made me laugh during his lectures.  With that said, he simply does not know how to teach.  He cannot explain certain concepts in plain English.  If you have no experience with physics courses, avoid him like the plague.  Also, the final grade is weighted...beware.

This is the first time Dave has taught this class--no book is required, which sucks since his teachings make no sense at all. His homework questions have hardly anything to do with test questions, and he rambles on in class. He simply starts lecture by jumping into the middle of something without explaining it. I'd recommend a different teacher!

Dave is great, physics 111 is extremely easy and you don't need the book,which is nice. He's very understanding and teaches the course according to the skill level of the class, which is nice. He's also pretty funny and informative.

He's hilarious. Definitely the most laid back professor I've had. He tends to go through things fairly quickly, but will regularly stop and ask if everything is making sense. Every time that I have contacted him, he's been able to quickly and reliably answer my questions. I don't see why he has gotten bad reviews. He knows his stuff and he cares.

DAVE IS THE MAN! I HATED physics before I had 313 with him. Dude... he's awesome. He's excellent at explaining, and has an awesome sense of humor. FABULOUS dresser. He is the best lecturer I have heard at KU. Awesome class.
He's great !

Horrible professor! He makes mistakes in class all of the time which confuses everybody. The online homework does not even correspond to what he teaches! His tests are horrible  and sometimes if its so terrible that he makes retake tests, which are still ungodly hard. He must be awesome at research since I see no point in him teaching.
This teacher is basically worthless!!!!
Doesn't teach, doesn't help, doesn't care

i recommend to NOT TAKE this CLASS WITH HIM. he would get you confused like never before. he just come to class and look at how student solve problems and do not write anything on the board except from asking "what do you think" or if not :"I DON'T KNOW". he's making me hate this class

Homework was relatively easy, however tests were much harder and did not relate to the level of material on the homework.  Appeared helpful in class but was not so much when meeting him outside of class.  I would not recommend taking him for this class, and he himself also told me the othe prof. that teaches 115 would be easier

I took his class a couple of years ago. His style could have changed. He appears to be an easy going teacher. He explains more or less well. I liked having a lot of quizzes and tests - it kept me on my toes. Tests were hard though. Outside of class he was not helpful at all, he told me to look it up whn I came to ask him ?s before the final.
when i asked for help his response was 'all i can do is sign a drop slip'.  i would NOT suggest taking anything from him!!!!
He's a very humorous, laid-back guy. (He's so laid back that it shows in his attire.) In this class, it seems as if there's too much material there to learn and not enough time to learn it.
Dude, he is sooo hot! The method by which he relays significant information is tremendous.
DUDE HE IS THE BEST NO DOUBT ABOUT IT TRY HIM AS MUCH AS POSSIBLE
Dave is awesome.  He is very helpful and funny.  I recommend taking his class if you can, he rocks.

Lectures were fun and entertaining, and he's amazing at explaining hard topics. Very approachable and likes answering questions. Class was flipped, but not in an obnoxious way because attending lecture still felt useful. Tests were very challenging, but he provides good study material to prepare. Uses expensive software for homework/textbook.
The most boring person to listen to. The class had 25% participation so you had to be in class. I pretty much just used the class as a study hall.

Dr. Blumenstiel is a wonderful professor and I learned a lot in this class, but it was also my hardest class this semester. Be prepared to watch a 45-60 min online lecture before each in-person lecture. A lot of information is covered in this class, but I would suggest paying special attention to practice problems in-class and in the homework.
Awesome Teacher
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This is the best class I have had in KU so far. There is a lot of material to cover throughout the semester, but as long as you stay on top of the online lectures and pay attention during in-class problem solving sessions you should be fine. Dr. Blumenstiel is a really funny guy and is amazing to talk to outside of class if you are into genetics.

Dr. Blumenstiel provided one of the most enjoyable experiences I've ever had at KU. He is hilarious, a very kind man, and reignited my passion for learning after a very difficult time in my life. The lectures can get rather heavy with information, but he is very willing to meet outside of class, even if it's not during office hours.

Really liked his lecture style - flipped classroom, most class time was spent doing practice problems and discussing questions. As long as you really, truly understand the practice problems the tests should be fine.

A really hard class, but Dr. Blumenstiel is very helpful if you have questions about the material. Attendence isn't mandatory, but it would be very difficult to do well in the class without going to the lectures. He flips the class so that you watch the lectures before and he does problems during class, which helps so much when studying for tests.
A lot of material is covered in this class, but Dr. Blumenstiel makes it doable and fun. He does not give too much partial credit, though he makes up for it with extra credit.

Dr. Blumenstiel is a super smart and funny guy, but this class was the toughest thing Ive ever done. He only had 2 hours of office hours a week and tends to ramble a lot in lectures. It was hard to talk to him without him cutting me off at times or letting me explain my thoughts. The tests in this class were so difficult coming from a 4.0 student.

I took Honors Genetics with Blumenstiel and it was probably the hardest class I've ever taken. It was a really interesting class though and Dr. Blumenstiel is a good professor. Class isn't mandatory but if you want to pass you need to go to lecture and take GOOD notes!!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Blumenstiel was amazing. He's funny, extremely smart and wants his class to do well. I had him for a seminar class so we read A LOT, but don't let that scare you off. He does a wonderful job explaining and making sure everyone is on the same page. The final paper may seem daunting but Dr. Blumenstiel is happy to help and easy to reach.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: I took Evolution of Sex w Dr. Blumenstiel & he is one of the best professors Ive had, even though I didn't LOVE the subject. He is so insanely smart but still totally chill & easy to talk to. He is so funny & relates his lectures back to really interesting stuff. This was a seminar class so there is a lot of scientific paper readings.

I'm the type of guy who will work his butt off to get an A in every class possible. No matter how much work I put into his class, I just don't seem to do well. But this man is one of the most caring professors I have ever encountered. Even though his class was a nightmare for me, I don't regret taking his class. AMAZING PROFESSOR! Just hard...

Amazing teacher. Class is definitely tough but you'll leave with a good grasp of the information. The textbook kind of sucks (except for practice problems) so pay more attention to taking GOOD lecture notes (don't fall back on the posted slides, they wont help). Highly recommend going to office hours, he's down to earth and overall a cool guy.

Great guy. Really interesting class, and he teaches it very well. Will always stop lecturing to answer any questions anyone may have, which clears up more difficult topics. Provides everything you need to learn the material, you just have to take the time to do it.

Best prof I've had so far. You can tell he really cares about both the subject and his students. Always willing to slow down explanations or stick around after class to help, gave great feedback. If you show interest he'll always be willing to help you, and doing book practice problems/watching his youtube videos is a great easy way to study.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Hilarious

reviews.comment: I love this guy. He's easily one of the best teachers I've ever had. His classes are tough, but if you put in the work, you will get a good grade.

Very challenging class.  Not as much human genetics as I would have liked.  One can only enjoy learning about fruit flies so much.  Dr. Blumenstiel is a great guy and a brilliant geneticist. His tests are very difficult, especially if the goal is an A.  He curved the final grade to an 87%, but the vast majority of the class was in the B range.

Great teacher! He makes a difficult subject easy to understand, and he'll stay VERY late at review sessions to help. He gives one-question quizzes which are pretty easy. Midterms are kind of difficult but he's great about giving you points just for trying. The class is curved to avg. B+ because he "doesn't want to punish you for taking honors".
Dr. Blumenstiel is very passionate about genetics and wants his class to learn everything. He will do anything to help you and curves tests very fairly. Great teacher.

I had him for GEOG 272 at the University of Washington and he was a seriously incredible professor. He is so passionate about the subject matter and about his students I would take literally any class he offered. It's very much a get out what you put in kind of class so you could coast but he inspired me to work super hard.
Blake was awesome. I learned a lot in the class and his lectures were really chill. He made me want to come to class. The tests and assignmenrs were all really easy.

Great teacher! He is fun and he really wants you to learn his material. He is witty and his jokes make me laugh. He incorporates programs like Google Earth and also uses a lot of videos from You Tube. I hate all sciences, but I enjoyed this class. Very interesting and useful information about the world. I highly reccommend taking this class.

Blake is a nice guy. His class is very interesting, you can learn many knowledge about the world you didn't know before. If you finish reading the textbook, you will get A in the tests. And if you finish you homework on time, you will get full grade.

In GEOG 365 Mayberry gave very informal  , easy to follow, laid-back lectures. If you need help in the class there is no need to worry, because he's very approachable and wants you to understand the material. He also mentioned some pretty amusing stories from his days as an undergrad. Highly Recommended.
Best Geography teacher at KU

Blake is an articulate, lucid teacher whose sense of humor is subtle, but clever.  He incorporates personal stories from his youth in Iowa as well as music and numerous pop culture references into his lectures.  Also, he is very knowledgeable of his topic and can relate well with students.

Blake Mayberry is a god among mere mortals. He is a young dude that really relates to students. He loves music and incorporates it into his lesson plans, and makes it totally relevant. I, personally, would drink a beer and smoke a fine cigar with this man. He should grow his beard, it would come in thick.

Blackburn was a good instructor, But if you need to keep organized in order to get a good grade. I learned a lot from her though and gave us a lot of free range and creativity to our speeches. I'm glad I took the class but it taught me to be more organized. For those who hate tests she gives none!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Rachel is such a good teacher. Never thought I would like theater, so I took this as an easy way to get my speech credit out of the way (keep that in mind). Charming is the best way to describe her. The classes are fun. Sometimes we went outside. Sometimes we left early. She just generally was a good person and wanted you to succeed.

Blackburn is great. I took her class as an alternative to COMS. THR 120, public speaking as a performance, gives you the same information as COMS, however it is more fun. The speech ideas give you a lot of room for creativity. Rachel really pushes you to be creative, alive, funny, and a better speaker. Also, she is super chill and always excited.

Never met the person but I have been subjected to their TAs, they are awful, they don't teach things clearly, outpace lecture,  do labs not covered in lecture or text book without attempting explain the contents and the TA is Very condescending. Worse course I have ever taken, but its a requirement. Good luck passing if you cant teach yourself 100%
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He designs the Chem 130 Labs. I never met him, but the TA's do a great job conducting the class. The labs can get dreadfully long.
Nicest guy ever
No Comments
Genius. Hot. Informative. Fun. NUFF SAID.
Really helpful, but the class is difficult. He will definitely push you.

One of the worst teachers I have ever had. I got an A in English 101 and really liked English, so going into this class I thought it would be easy. He grades incredibly hard and the expectations are extremely unclear. He is a very helpful, nice guy but an absolutely TERRIBLE teacher.
Really nice and helpful person. Feedback on papers he grades is AMAZING, you can tell Blayze really enjoys teaching. Show up to class and write the papers and you'll get a great grade.

he is a super nice guy, wants you to understand but is such a genius that sometimes its unclear. If you ask specific questions he will be glad to help. He assigns homework almost every single class but its not loads of work. He's definitely not hard to look at if ya know what i mean..

I graduated from KU 23+ years ago and Professor Blue changed my college direction. I was a Freshman in English 101 and struggling with college. She spent time talking with me about what was going on and even helped me find ways to make KU work. Needless to say I graduated four years later and will always remember Professor Blue.

Best English professor I had.  It's been nearly 45 years and I still remember things she told us and me, especially with respect to writing more clearly and concisely.  Also grateful she exposed us to works such as "A Shropshire Lad" (Terence, This is Stupid Stuff) and "Ozymandias."

Tina Blue is the best English teacher I have ever had. She failed me on almost every paper I wrote, but she gives you the opportunity to rewrite every paper. This means if youre willing to put in the work you can get whatever grade you want. I ended up spending a lot of time in her office hours. As frustrated as I was, I leaned so much. 10/10 rec
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She told us at the beginning of the year that we better be prepared now, because we won't pass her class. She told us that we were bad writers and that our English teachers in high school were wring with everything they taught us. I was an A writer in high school, published work to college articles, and many more and I got almost a C in the class.

Intimidating at first, but after a few conferences I got to know her better and I really enjoyed our conversations. She gives a LOT of feedback on your papers. She is a tough grader but definitely acknowledges your improvements. Only complaint is that she takes forever to put in grades/grade your papers, that put so much stress on me during finals.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: At first I didn't like her and she scared me. After awhile she softens up a bit especially if you try hard and meet with her out of class. I've had many good conversations with her and while she was a tough grader, I still learned a lot from her.

Attendance is mandatory. The class basically consists of 5 essays one of which is the final but she will mark your paper up until you literally can hardly see your text anymore. Go into her office hours and have her help you, I did weekly and its the only reason I got an A. On the bright side she doesn't use any textbooks.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She has a good heart, but is very unorganized and confusing. Most of what she teaches turns into long, extended rants that leave you even more confused about what she is saying. Her articles online are almost like a religion to her. Her grading is harsh considering she is wanting you to completely change all you've learned in writing to her method.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Tina Blue is an intimidating teacher to learn from.  She's invested in her work, which amplifies her focus to help those who truly care about the course.   That being said, it's no easy A.  She will push you to go the extra mile, but by the end, you will benefit from it.  Don't take her if you plan to slide past classes.  Shes firm, but fair.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Tina is one of the best teachers I've had at KU. Yeah she's a tough grader but she only grades so tough to make her students better writers. If you work hard and see her outside of class, you will do good in her class.
Tina can be a bit frazzled at times, but she is a really kind professor who truly has your best interest at heart. You won't get below a C+ in the class. Really easy and I recommend it.
Tina's writing tips helped me pass 3 classes last semester. I would strongly recommend her to anyone taking English 101 or 102.

A lot of people didn't like her as a teacher, but really she is one of the most understanding professors I've ever had. She's very clear about what she wants in a paper, and she doesn't grade hard. It's impossible to fail a paper, because she will at least give you "credit." Great teacher, almost impossible to get lower than C+ if you do your work.
Very good professor so far, she means well, and I believe she genuinely wants everyone in her class to do well.

She's the best. You don't have to sweat to get a B in the course. Just attend class regularly and pay attention. You should also take advantage of her out-of-class conferences to show interest. You'll get nothing less than a C+ if you at least show interest in her class. She is really easy to get by!

She is a very helpful teacher and for English 101, she is the best professor to get. I got a C+ in the class, but I most definitely did not deserve that grade, she is pretty easy on grades, just make sure to attend class and pay attention.

She is a little rough around the edges, but what makes her truly one of the best teachers I have had a KU is indeed her ability to be different than the others. She will go out of her way to actually improve your skills as a writer. Which sadly is hard to find anymore.
if you want to learn I would suggest her. and her class is not easy.

Tina is very opinionated. She thinks what she thinks is the only right way. She humliates people in front of the whole class. If you're trying to get a good GPA do NOT take her class. You'll be lucky to get a C+! Make sure to go to class. She expects you to meet with her office hours.. no matter how busy you are outside of class. WORST TEACHER

If you find out you have this teacher, you need to drop it immediately. You never learn anything,class is pointless. she grades everything with "credit" which means D/F. She has no time to meet with you and doesn't know who you are. She thinks everyone is a bad writer. She wants you to improve but doesn't do anything to help you.
She is awesome! Super helpful and strives to see her students exceed. She definitely knows what she is talking about!

Very harsh grader! No matter how low your papers are everyone gets a C min. if they show up to class and turn in the assigned papers. If you want a higher grade you need to go to her office hours many times for help and work hard to learn the writing style she prefers to get a higher grade. Though, you will become a better writer if you work at it.

She is not the kind of person who will easilly tell you if you are doing well. However if you are willing to put in the time, so is she. I probably spent 50 hours outside of class getting help from her. She is an invaluable resource full of knowledge, if you want to really learn she is the perfect professor!

The best teacher ever! very energetic, enthusiastic, helpful and funny! Tough grader but if you work hard enough and show her (by going to as many of her office hours as possible and attending class) she will give you the grade you deserve (hopefully a good one). Definitively take this class with this teacher!

Tina thinks that every freshman that takes 101 should be able to write at a grad. level in order to receive an A or B. She only sees things from her point of view and if you don't see eye to eye, you're automatically wrong. do not take this class if you want anything higher then a C in the class.

Tina Blue thinks that a good grade is a C. She values the students that write really well. The class is about analyzing poetry and writing papers about the subject. It is a very difficult course because of her expectations and she only sees things from one point of view, her own. I do not recommend the course.

I have never received a grade lower than a B on an english paper. My very first paper I turned in to Tina got a C and she told me to be proud of that, because in her class a C is good. I'm not that sensitive of a person, but after talking to her about my first paper she made me CRY. Not an easy grader, and not very compassionate. Don't take.

I owe my success as an effective writer to Tina Blue. She challenged me and at the time I was frustrated with the class. But I realized she really knew what she was talking about and my writing improved so much. I encourage anyone taking her class to stay open minded and listen to her suggestions. If you do, you will achieve success in your writing
Worst teacher ever, expects freshman to write at grad level with no help at all. Do not take this class from her.

She is craziest person I have ever met. She means well, but when it comes down to it there is a reason that a 60 years old woman is still teaching english 101. her grading is completly arbitrary and based on her own personal opinion. I suggest you avoid this class if possible.

Shes quite a funny little old lady. She comes off as mean at first, but that is just her personality. Shes nice if you go to her office hours! I put in ALOT of work and got a B-, but she helped my writing develop a lot!

You need to go to class and conferences! if you do she will like you! Be nice to her and re-do all of your essays! I think shes entertaining, I was horrified at first and thought she hated me, dont worry!

Do not take this class. She spends many class periods ranting instead of teaching. She expects english 101 students to write at grad student level in order to earn an 'A. She is irritable and hard to work with. She is full of her self because of her website. I guess no one told her that anyone can publish writing online. I got an a but it sucked.
never stays on topic. extreme delusions of grandeur.
One of the best professors I had at KU.

I could go on all day about how great of a teacher Tina is. Dedicate yourself to learning and she will dedicate herself to teaching you. I can understand why some people wouldn't like her as much.. she is very opinionated. She hates it when people dont follow directions. You've been warned.

mrs. blue is so compassionate and went out of her way to help me through the semester. i have such a hard time with school and she helped me so much to get the grade i needed. she is very intelligent and i would love to take a class with her again

I don't understand how people rate Tina so high. She is a horrible teacher. Enough said. Don't make the same mistake that I did...switch to another English teacher right away. Whatever you do, DO NOT take this class from Tina Blue. Expect to learn nothing and write around 7-8 essays compared to other English classes who write 3.
she changed my life and is the best teacher I've ever had

Do not take this class! Tina Blue is an insane and rude woman. Do not expect to learn anything from this class but DO expect to write four times as many essays as the other classes. The only thing she talks about is how great of a writer she is and how she is famous on the internet. Grades very hard, but you do get to revise your first two essays.
Amazing teacher!  Very qualified and knowledgable.  She is compassionate and goes out of her way to help her students.  Very memorable teacher.
She is an awesome professor. EXTREMELY scary at first but she's really helpful and you will DEFINITELY improve your writing style with her
Tina is very interesting. Scary at first but very honest and helpful. I actually improved my writing. I would recommend her to anyone
she's full of passion.Kind of crazy sometime...
Scared me at first, but she's a great teacher and you will come out of her class know how to write a good paper.

I was a little scared of her the first few classes and she used akward ways to explain things but, will actually teach you english. You are guarenteed a C even if you do crap work. You have to work hard in her class but if you pay attention then it's actually pretty easy I got a B and my writing is much better.
She is an amazing teacher. She is crazy but interesting. I absolutely hate writing, but I loved her class. She grades hard so put a lot of effort and time into her papers.

She'll actually teach you how to write.  She explains things very clearly and completely.  The only work for the whole semester is writing 4 essays, 3 of which are revised before getting final grade.  Great class for freshman making the transition to a big school.  Tina teaches students how to think.  Great class.
GREAT TEACHER, kind of crazy but I like that about her. KNOWS HER STUFF!!!!!

She is an awesome teacher for first semester freshman students--really any students, actually. I loved her class, and after going through four years of English courses, she was still one of my favorite instructors ever.
She is a crazy hippie! But she is probably one of the best English teachers at KU. She grades really strictly, but is fair. You are guaranteed to learn a lot if you take her class.
She is seriously crazy.  I didn't like this class at all.

She is crazy! But that makes the class so fun. I was not excited with being stuck in a poetry class, but she makes it interesting. I love poetry now. GO TO CLASS! If you don't, the class will be hard. She is very willing to help on papers and even gives you notes for poems to help you with your essay.
No Comments
Great teacher, I like her alot, She knows what she's talking about. Even if she grades hard at least someone in your life is teaching you how to write better.
No Comments
No Comments

Very weird teacher. She talks about how she hates the grading system, but at the same time she is obsessed with giving the correct number of Ds, Cs, Bs, and As. On the other hand, the class isn't difficult. This can be a good class for people who have not been around people like her before, but for others it can be brutally boring.
Looks like someone got a grade they didn't like.  This is a great teacher!
She is the best teacher at KU.  Her lectures are really interesting and fun!!  I took this class last year and I really miss it.
Fantastic!
No Comments
Horrible.
without a doubt the smartest, spaciest, craziest and best teacher i have ever had.
Fast paced learning.

very very hard class I struggled during the midterm and final. Homework is nothing like the exams. Start group project early and ask a lot of questions. She does a good job of explaining things if asked. Exams and class is curved so make sure you go to class and she knows your name. TA's were basically useless I would go to her directly.
I love her willingness to make others better. She is flexible and will walk you through every step of the process. She is patient and caring about others' learning.

START YOUR GROUP PROJECT EARLY. The class is quite hard to grasp if you don't learn well from slides. She does try to help with in-class practice and homework. Some of the hardest tests I have taken but she curves them and the class as a whole is curved. If you keep showing up odds are you will get at least a B.

DO NOT TAKE!! She speaks at 100000mph and is difficult to understand (not her fault). Definitely the hardest class I have taken at KU. She gets frustrated if you do not pick up on the material right away. No partial credit, tests are nothing like the homework, quizzes, in class assignments. Once again, I urge you do not take her.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Bindal is an amazing teacher who has real world experience as well and a dedicated interest in the success of her students. The class is by no means easy, but it is not hard if you show up and do the work. She will bend over backwards to help you outside of class if you still are struggling. A class that you get out what you put in.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I enjoyed Shradha's class throughout and it deepened my knowledge of corporate finance greatly. She helped me understand the hows and whys of the subject matter, making me confident to face technical interviews. Her discussion method of teaching and open dialogue is extremely effective. Although her tests are hard you definitely get to learn.

Professor Bindal teaches a very hard class.  Definitely the hardest class that I've taken so far.  The topic was interesting though.  I thought the tests were pretty difficult.  I could tell the professor was really trying to make everything make sense.

Professor Bindal is a good but hard professor. The material in the class was interesting and useful for the Finance World. There is a lot of effort needed to be successful in the class but it will pay off in the end. Take professor Bindal if you want to learn. Her lectures are fast and they can be confusing sometimes.

Dr. Bindal was pretty good.  I think the subject matter is just too hard.  Maybe there's just too much of it.  I don't know.  I wish KU didn't require this class or maybe made it two classes worth of material instead of cramming it all into one.  Dr. Bindal did help me a lot at office hours and so yay for her for doing that.  HARD class though.

I mean, damn, lots to learn in this class.  Worth it though.  When I was interviewing for jobs and they asked me anything detailed about finance, I felt like this was the class that prepared me for those types of questions.  Could be just the type of companies I applied to.  Dr. Bindal was always helpful by email for the (many) times I got lost.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Avoid taking this class with Professor Bindal! One of the hardest classes I have taken at KU and I have not even learned that much to compensate the toughness. Take with another Professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: So far this class has been one of the hardest & confusing classes at KU. I had to teach myself all the material for the exam since she rushes through the slides & does not clearly explain anything. She writes random stuff on the board & half the time it is different from her slides. She randomly calls on people and gets mad when no one understands.

Love him down. Every now and then he can be difficult to reach but he is very open and communicative about this from the start of the class. It's clear he truly cares about his students and their success, and wants to be a good/helpful teacher. Very understanding of your circumstances and a good listener. Favorite art professor I've had in college.

Okay... yes, he's very hard to reach online and also lowkey in person, but Shawn is a great guy and treats his students like his peers which I like. He's eager to help as long as you get his attention at the right time and his demos were very helpful, but a bit short. He's nice and encouraging in critiques while also giving constructive criticism.

Took class during recent college experience. Wanted to wrap up my time at KU by giving honest feedback for others. Does not spend enough time w/ students to teach technical skills but expects technical prowess in projects. Hard to reach, get answers from. Does not consider all students situations, efforts or interests, unless they align with his.

Better get used to chasing this guy in circles because he will not answer your emails for ANYTHING. And if you email more than once to clarify, hell ignore you and be petty by sending an email to the entire class instead. Its fine to not like your students but I shouldnt have to chase just to ask if you got the project I turned in.

His screenprinting class was extremely stressful and difficult due to his high expectations coupled with a lack of guidance. Be prepared to learn and do everything by yourself. He was very unapproachable, even during class time. He also has a tendency to disrespect students' artistic choices and ideas.
I question his grading process and he is hard to get a hold of when out of class, which really bothered me. But when you get a hold of him and he is mentally engaged, his feedback is very good.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Shawn is a good teacher and he means well, but as a Drawing I teacher he is not the best. Taking Drawing II is a bit different because it's becoming more obvious as to how much we DIDN'T do/learn from him.  I'm not sure if that's just how Drawing I is at KU or what... Also it's pretty difficult to get an A. Attendance is really important to him too

I love Shawn.  We are going to get married.  He is the best teacher I've had in the art building.  Super easy to talk to and actually understands what you are doing.  As long as you try, he knows you care.  HIGHLY recommended.
Shawn is a really fun teacher to work with.  And the screenprinting class is awesome.
Shawn is really cool and he assigns pretty easy assignments.  Every Friday we had a free draw which was kinda cool because it was laid back.  I definitely recommend Bitters to anyone!

I had drawing I with shaun.  He is very helpful and he is very easy to get along with.  But, if you have the 4 hour drawing class odds are are going to stay the whole time almost every day. If you come every day though and do what he says than you will have a good chance at an A (and if you are talented artist). And yes, all the girls in my class d
He is an amazing artist. He really helped my improve my drawing skills and he really knows what he's teaching. He talks to his students like real people instead of just students.
he's hot...yeah, yeah, and he's a good teacher, too...he's really easy to talk to

For clarification, I'm at SHSU where she teaches currently. Lectures are redundant, she reads off the slides verbatim and occasionally writes an example on the board. Prepare to teach yourself the material based on what she gives you, and expect in-class assignments weekly. Very disorganized but understanding, not too difficult if you work for it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is very slow in lectures, hardly answered emails, didn't tell you about assignments, got work wrong on multiple occasions, and didn't explain problems well.

Ms. Bius is okay. Shes extremely quite and her lectures are just her reading the slides verbatim. Definitely not an engaging class but there are extra credit opportunities and the tests are very straight forward and she is sweet and willing to help if you ask.
Nice lady who invokes your pity until you check your tuition costs. As far as being unclear and incomprehensible, Bingo. Janet Bius.

Ms. Bius is a super nice woman, she's very helpful in her office hours and definitely answers her best. But I agree with the rest that her lectures are disorganized but, you don't have to teach yourself. Just listen to what she's saying and read the powerpoints and book and you'll do fine.

VERY nice; down to earth person, however not a great instructor. Her lectures can be confusing, and lack organization. I have learned almost everything from my tutor and self-teaching. She is helpful one-on-one in her office hours. The tests are generously curved. If you know high-school Chem, you'll do fine in the class. Otherwise, get a tutor!

Good person, but very difficult to learn from. The course can be self-taught, though, with the book and online notes. The test curves are fairly generous and the assignments given throughout the semester provide some easy points.

Ms buis is very nice but her class is ridiculous. She may know Chemistry but she doesn't have the ability to teach it to anyone. She could possibly be the most scatter brained professor I've ever had. Everything Ive learned this year has been self taught. Nice lady. Not the greatest teacher.

Ms. Bius is an extremely nice person. Easy to get along with, however her lectures are not beneficial to me whatsoever. Everything I have learned this semester has been from my tutor.I honestly think I could teach this class better than she can.However she does curve her tests very generously, but makes easy mistakes in lecture examples and grading

Professor Bius is a nice person but when it comes to teaching she is not cut out for the job. The lack of confidence the inability to explain problems in class makes it impossible to learn. The class has to be self taught using the textbook and a couple of pages of notes she provides online.

Such an amazing professor! Very kind, extremely prepared, and very knowledgable about what she is teaching. There is a lot of material covered but she makes it very digestible, and all the students respect her and are very engaged in class. Her outfits are really fire as well. She is everything you could ask for in a professor honestly
PSYCH 200 with her was pretty easy. Sometimes I was a little confused on how to prepare for the exams. I would still recommend her though.
she doesn't always let us out on time
the goat!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She was very sweet! Her syllabus was clear, and usually everything talked about in class was on the test. Easy class.

Dr. Biernat is a great professor. The content she teaches is kind of boring but pretty easy to grasp. Your grade is heavily dependent on exams, and there's multiple choice + short answer. BE THOROUGH! She is nice but a VERY tough grader, as is her TA.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Biernat is an amazing professor and a wonderful person to talk to. She teaches her lessons effectively and ensures that students have a well-rounded understanding. It is easy to ask her questions and for clarification when needed.
Content can get boring, but as long as you continue to put in effort and show up, everything should go great!

Not too difficult of a class. Easy weekly quizzes and every other week simple homework assignments. Exams are not too difficult, but cover a lot. All slides and notes posted online after class. Lectures were extremely boring, but really just boring material, but other than that pretty decent.

I loved Prof. Biernat! If you go to lectures and do the homework you won't even have to study for the exams. She does great exam review the class before, as well. In-person exams, but they're multiple choice and a few short answers. She gives several short answer questions, but you get to pick one that you can skip. Great at giving lectures!
She was very sweet and always willing to help. However exams weigh very heavily on the overall grade, and she grades very tough.
She was so sweet but her class was kinda boring just kinda her talking at us but yk thats not the worst.

I liked Professor Biernat a lot, but I found her lectures somewhat boring. I don't think that was her fault though, probably just more of the material she had to teach. Her exams were difficult even though they were mostly multiple choice. I would tell anyone who is going to take this class to make sure they have good study habits going into it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This class is pretty focused on participation and iclicker. The class is mainly just lecture and then minimum one homework per week. I would say homework wise, this class is on the easier side. the assignments were not time consuming and the papers were short. It does use the +/- system, so it makes getting an A+ a little more difficult.

Professor Biernat was kind and funny but her lectures were just very boring. Not her fault, just what she teaches in this course. Her exams are all in person, mostly multiple choice but usually with a few short answers. They were difficult.

Although she is a very nice person, she doesn't make it clear what needs to be studied for the exams. She talks so much in her lectures that it gets impossible to follow along. She has multiple iclickers a day so make sure to go to class. I would not recommend taking this class with her if you want to actually learn something.

Friendly, has great lectures (slides posted online too) and explains any and all questions without judgement. Homework is minimal, but all of it helps with understanding of course material and she makes sure everyone knows the expectations. Is great about reminding class about upcoming assignments/quizzes/exams. Loved her, def would take again

I took this class as an online course. It's fast paced and she literally does not even teach it (no lecture videos at all). She is an extremely tough grader and gives little to no feedback on the assignments. This professor nearly made me want to change majors. Let's try and actually teach ma'am. Try to take this class with someone else.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Extremely tough grader. Gives zero feedback on assignments. Class material is set up very poorly. Overall bad teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: This course was one of my easier ones. Dr. Biernat did not over-assign any work

Her class was a saving grace for me during COVID. She recognized that it was realistic to have open note quizzes. Her schedule of lectures, assignments and quizzes was so realiable it was a breath of fresh air. Her lectures were helpful and made the chapter reading easier to comprehend. The content is slightly boring, but she makes it bearable.

emailed her about getting into her research lab. she was quick to reply with saying it was full but i can look at it for next semester and i responded with saying there still showed openings and ill look into applying for the spring and thank you for responding. her response was just rude, "Do reach out to me about the spring! MB".

Lectures were painful, took forever on each slide and repeated everything we learned in the previous class for half of the following class. When I emailed her, "Mrs. Biernat" she always corrected me by replying "Dr. Biernat", which was really arrogant. Class was so painful I took the C instead of going to class. Try to take with someone else.

Not the most exciting class and she is pretty monotone, but she is a good teacher and a nice person. All you do is listen to a lecture and answer the occasional clicker question, do a few online quizzes, homework assignments and one group project. It was easy and I learned a lot.

I liked this class a lot! The lectures can be very boring but she is very passionate about her lectures. Make sure you know every single piece of information for short answers on tests or else she will flunk your grade, that is the only negative of this class. Weekly quizzes and homework were easy and not time consuming.

Textbooks aren't 100% a must for a good grade. Do the quizzes and homework, they're easy points and you don't want to lose them. Lectures are a bit boring because it's pretty basic common knowledge kinda stuff, so showing up to class for clicker points is good, but not necessarily for paying attention. Skim the textbook before an exam for an A.

Not the most exciting class I've ever taken, my Dr. Biernat was pretty good. Her lectures weren't super engaging at times, but that was more due to the topic. She does clicker questions for points, and there is one group project (TA's grade it). Test were easy multiple choice/short answer. She was really sweet and pretty laid back overall.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Biernat is one of the most understanding professors I have had. She works with you and is very flexible. If you attend lectures and pay attention, you will do well on the tests. There is a homework assignment every other week and a quiz once a week that are all online. The only outside big project is a group project, SUPER easy.

She does a really great job with lectures. They are very informative and in-depth. Clickers are used to answer questions during the lecture, and it is very helpful. She explains why the incorrect answers are incorrect. There are lots of quizzes and homework, but they aren't heavy scores. They are designed to help balance out bad exam scores.

I loved this class. Some people find it boring. The test reviews were a little dry. Show up to class, take notes, and the tests will be pretty easy. They're straight forward. And Dr. Biernat is great! She is really easy to approach and very interested in helping students. You do have to do a group project which isn't always the best.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Literally the most boring class I have ever taken in my life. If it wasn't for clicker points in class, I would never show up to lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Biernat was one of my favorite professors! If you go to lecture and study your notes, you will do well on the exams! She emails back fast so getting help from her on topics you find difficult is very easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Really enjoyed taking Research Methods with Dr. Biernat! Very sweet professor, and always made it clear of what was to be expected concerning projects and exams. Lecture material was very dry, but she tries her very best to engage students! Very enthusiastic and makes material easy to understand. Would definitely take another class with her again!
