Class is dull, not Bill's fault. He stops himself during lecture and will tell you if you need to know something for a test. Get full credit on attendance, homework, and quizzes, which is so easy, and actually study for exams and its a lay up A. It's not demanding and i think he tries to stay out of the way acct/dsci courses, which are demanding.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Fall 2017 Fuerst started making attendance mandatory so don't skip because the TAs will notice and it will affect your grade! Study for all of the tests because that's pretty much your whole grade. Overall,  Fuerst tries to make class fun, but everyone ends up on their phone because it's so boring.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Lectures are extremely boring and also mandatory, but the material is super easy. Grade really relies on the four tests but you can drop one so it's not as demanding. Seems like a nice man, but all communication is with your assigned TA's.

Professor Fuerst was by far the most boring professor I've ever had. I almost fell asleep a few times. There are pop quizzes so make sure you pay attention during lecture and you'll be fine. Tests are mostly based on his powerpoints and a little on textbook vocab. He also needs to button his shirt a little more...

Overall, the class was easy. Make sure that you read the book because obscure questions show up on tests all the time. You'll have 2 homework assignments throughout the whole semester. The lectures are pretty boring; he tries to make them interesting, but sometimes it doesn't work. He does bring in some good guest speakers.

Fuesrt is annoying on his tests, because some questions will make you question if the class has ever taught that material. If you want an A you have to cram the textbook. If you want a B or a C just show up and pass his quizzes. I slept almost every lecture. Warning: Final is insanely tough.

Kind of an easy class, but most of your grade is taken from five tests. There's a few homework assignments and grades, but the bulk of it will be from the test. If you go to class and/or read the textbook, the tests shouldn't be too hard. He's a little boring but he's actually pretty funny if you're paying attention.

He tries to make it interesting, but it just does not work. He's a nice guy, just boring and doesn't seem that educated on technology (which is weird, since he teaches IST). He lectures directly from slides which comes directly from the book. Just read the book and go to class for the occasional quiz, it should be easy to get an A or B.

What even is IST? Without test files I would have not passed this class because the slides are basically the textbook with less words and neither of them will help you on the tests. Take it online if you can

Ok, straight up, he is a boring, boring man. The material is very common knowledge. If I were to give advice on how to easily get an A, I'd say go to lecture for pop quizzes. (Just show up the last 20 minutes). Also, to ace the tests, all you have to do is memorize his BlackBoard slides. The book was obsolete.

Feurst is not a terrible teacher,  just very boring. The subject is also a bore and almost useless to know. What you learn in lecture is irrelevant to the tests, but you must go for the pop quizzes. To pass the tests, you must read the textbook and memorize random terms.

Lectures are a snooze. if it wasn't for the quizzes, i would have never attended class.  Read the pages in the book he assigns, look over the powerpoint slides he posts to blackboard and you'll be fine. easy class just material and Fuerst are boring.

Several awesome guest speakers throughout class.  He is fairly dull, but gets the job done.  Only two or three assignments all semester, but they were a little more involved.  Easy class if you're in Gen Y or Gen X.  If you are technology deficient then this class may be a little tougher.

lectures are boring. He literally read everything from the online material which you can find on the blackboard, but you have to go to class to take the quiz, which will be provided at the end of class. Personally i don't think the lectures are necessary.

Drop class immediately. It is impossible to know what she wants, quizes are impossible. She claims that she doesn't mean to be rude, but she lies. I am certain that deep in her heart she is a decent person but as a teacher, just no.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: This is a tough teacher however, pulled the best out of me as a student. What she says is what she says, no if or buts. If you want to get your act together and know how higher classes teach she is a good starter to take to get the idea. You have to WORK for your grade.
Meh is all I have to say.
make the class credit/non-credit for your convince

Paper's are tough, and she's the same. Quizzes are almost impossible. She is a decent person who will respect you if you show the same mutually. Stick it out and put forth the effort to get a B in the class. Go to her office hours and LISTEN to what she wants in a paper. Interesting teacher and cares about students, have to fight for it though.
Very hard grader, doesn't know how she wants work done, and couldn't tell how to get a good grade in the class

She was really unclear on how she wanted things.  I suggest finding a new teacher because she is a tough grader.  This is English 101 and it shouldn't be that difficult, but she makes it difficult to get an A.  I'm pretty sure no one in our class has an A and probably only 3 of us have Bs.

Worst teacher I've had. English is my strongest subject, and this has been my hardest class this semester. Very unclear on what she wants. Shows up late to class. Make sure you participate everyday or you will get an awful grade on that. Just drop the class and try and find a new english teacher if possible.

She likes a lot of in class participation so if you have her as your teacher make sure you talk a lot.  She grades extremely hard.  Her pop quizzes are nearly impossible. I am used to getting A's and B's on my papers and all i could get was C's. She is horrible at answering questions. Don't keep her as your professor if you get her.

Took her class 1.5 years ago. I got a B. Not hard work-wise,but very unclear on what she wanted. Make sure you speak up A LOT for participation points. Annoyed, I wrote my next paper assignment about how teachers discriminate against introverts (with RESEARCH). She ddn't find t as funny as I did. Talk to her during office hours. That helps a lot.

I have no idea what this lady expects from her students. I had an A in the class at the end of the semester (after working my BUTT off) and when I met with her to review my final paper she said "this is really good!" Well, somehow I ended up with a B in the class.

I found her to be hard and a bit odd. She is more of a student and not a teacher. She often came in late.My advice is if your looking to have a good learning experience drop this English and look for another teacher.

Knows a lot about her subject matter but has no teaching skills.  I went to her office hours multiple times to get help and she warmed up to me.  She is in school and refuses to help outside of class when she doesn't have time.  I don't recommend this for anyone without high interest in extra work and prior writing experience.

I can see why people would rate her the way they did, but I bet none of them went out of their way to know Kendra. I struggled with her and after speaking with her understood her and got a B in the class. She is not only an amazing teacher, but she is an outstanding woman who lives for what she believes in! GREAT TEACHER

Iam used to getting solid A's and B's on my papers and have gotten nothing but Cs in this class. WAY to much reading over stuff that does not matter, and her papers are the biggest pain in the butt ever. Be preparred to really work in her class if you want to pass.
She grades way too hard, and she's mean. I liked English before I took this class, but now I can't stand it.

I only know of one person to get an A on any of the bajillion assignments we've had. I'll receive a paper back but and it will have one comment saying "good job" but i will still receive a B. Also, she expects you to answer all your own questions, annoying! And she'll always say, "Yeah, but anyway" after EVERYTHING.
Worst class of my life, never gotten anything less than a "B" in my life...Failed her class with a 51%- my grade was the second HIGHEST IN THE CLASS!!!!

Although Ms. Fullwood seems like a very nice person, she turned a subject that I loved in to the class from Hell! There were TONS of reading and writing assignments- at least 3 of each per week, and she was incredible unclear about her expectations on anything. I barely escaped with a B, I think most other students weren't so lucky.
SO many papers....over 20 over the semester!
She was very unclear about what she expected in my papers. She's not very understanding at all either.
No Comments
she is nice enough but doesnt explain things well at all. i found we spent half the class talking ab completely irrelevant things like how we could change the schedule/whatever was on her mind.
No Comments
No Comments
No Comments

Out of the four papers that she assigned, the only one that had a pretty clear criteria was the research paper. A no brainer, everything else was a travesty! And the thing was, if you asked her a question you'd get an ambiguous answer! Just bad teaching and a real pain in the neck.
She's kind of a hater... likes to use the word "meticulous"... not much for a teacher. grad student.
Good professor, I'll take another class with her. she knows a lot about the Hispanic countries and Spanish language. Very helpful.

Professor Fung wasn't the greatest teacher of all time, but she definitely wasn't as awful as people make her seem! She's very friendly and understanding with her students, even though her constant Spanish makes it easy to miss things. She graded our assignments VERY easily, marking mistakes but not docking points. Just make sure she likes you!

By far the worst teacher I've had at KU. I missed 6 classes and got a D, even though I got A's on all of my tests and homework. Grades extremely harshly, and doesn't explain why you are receiving such a low grade. When you ask her questions she will either stare at you blankly, or vaguely answer you. No doubt, switch professors.

WORST CLASS!!! She is terrible! She is rude, awful, unhelpful, and impossible to understand. She grades your work hard but doesn't tell you why she docked points. She is a scatter brain and she never lets you out of class on time! DON'T TAKE HER CLASS!!!
i'm learning spanish with her because she grades my work, not like others who let me do whatever i wanted. i appreciate her work.
good professor,always prepared for class. she knows what she is talking about and always give you more information about any topic. you have to be prepared for her class, it means read a lot.
Really good explanations about the hispanic cultures, and grammar

Worst teacher I have ever had in any subject. Played favorites with whoever acted like they actually like spanish. EVERY class period ran over time never covered all that was planned for the day, whioh sucked because grammar was the last thing for every class so I was always so confused about all the different tenses.

WORST TEACHER I'VE HAD AT KU!!! I have never had a teacher as bad as Anny Fung. SHe has no time managemnet skills in the classroom. She would spend all her time writing incomprehensible writing on the white board and then we would always run out of time for grammer. She does not explain important due dates and she is very rude and condescending.
Not at all helpful, difficult grader, class participation is required.

She was honestly the WORST teacher I have ever had. Very rude and condescending to her students. Does not explain things that are expected of the student, then takes points away when the student doesn't do these "expected things." She should not be allowed to teach at ANY university. Also, she grades very hard compared to other SPAN 111 teachers.

I hate to be mean, but she's really not a good teacher. I only did well because i had a lot of spanish previous to 111. she doesn't like explaining things in english, and has a very poor conception of time. she usually doesn't cover what she's supposed to, and doesn't really seem to know how to teach. sorry :(
She refuses to explain anything in English so if you haven't recently taken Spanish and you have her as a teacher transfer. Concepts will go in one ear and out the other because of lack of teaching.
Such a caring professor. He grades very nicely and is very understanding. Is willing to do things such as change deadlines as long as you communicate with him.

Very great prof. You do not need the textbook as all of the answers for module quizzes you can find on quizlet. Gives you the whole sem to work on final project (i reccomend starting as early as possible so you can have enough things to write about). attendance is required but very easy class.

Awesome professor, genuinely cares about students. Attendance and participation is important. Pretty lenient. A lot of guest speakers. Lectures were interesting and enjoyable. One long paper for the final but you get all semester to work on it. Weekly quizzes based on readings but answers are online so you don't really need the textbook.

Spanish 261 is a lot of work but Dr. Garibotto does everything she can to help her students succeed. She is so gracious and does not grade harshly. The class environment helps you to prepare for each exam and practice your Spanish. I don't think she will be teaching 261 again but I'm sure that any class with Profe Garibotto would be amazing.

I LOVED this class. The assigned readings were genuinely interesting and Dr. Garibotto really cares about her students and wants them to succeed. I also appreciated how at the 300 level there weren't grammar assignments and we could just focus on understanding and analyzing the material.

Veronica is amazing and every review on here is very true, but the only thing I'll add is that if you have a lot of anxiety around group activities, video projects, etc., this may not be the class for you. Otherwise she's an incredible professor :)

Veronica Garibotto is an excellent professor! I took SPAN 462 which is a film analysis class on Latin American Road Movies. She helped me improve my Spanish (grammar & confidence), and made it a non stressful class because I felt so comfortable talking and going out of my comfort zone. She's awesome! Just watch the movies and participate in class!

Profe Garibotto was amazing. I took Span 346 and it was a half semester class. It was very reading heavy. All we did was read and answer questions. On days we had class, we discussed our answers. The class was full of information and some essays, but they were easy. I will say though I am a native speakers of Spanish.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I had Veronica for Span 463 and she was absolutely fantastic. I've never had a professor that was so invested in student success and engaging with the material. She was always easy to get a hold of and replies to emails quickly. Her feedback on essays is quite helpful too. If you have a chance, take her!

I really disliked the class because I wasn't interested in the content (I just wanted to practice speaking Spanish), but Veronica was absolutely amazing. She really cares about her students and she's very helpful and just really sweet as a person in general
Incredible professor. Truly cares about her students and wants you to succeed. This class more than anything improved my writing skills in Spanish. Highly recommend taking a class from her.
She is very engaging and passionate about teaching the language and does a great job making the class fun. Definitely a great teacher.

She's the BEST! She is a really great teacher and she has a great heart. Everybody wanted class to go on longer than it was supposed to, because she made everyone care about the things we read. She also was responsive to the needs of the class. I would highly, highly recommend her classes to Spanish majors.

Great teacher, very interesting and cares about how you do in the class.  She will want you to do the work, but it's usually worth it.  She's really accepting and awesome.  Highly suggest taking classes from her.

Dr. GN is the best. Not only is he an incredible conductor and choral leader, respected around the world, but he is a kind guy and cares about people. He is demanding and holds his choirs to a high level, but he does so in a way that encourages you to reach that high level. He pushes you beyond what you could have thought was possible.
He is truly AMAZING! The best choir director I have ever had! Our KMEA performance last February was incredible! Love him!
Very funny, esteemed choral director. The best I've ever had. Demands perfection but in an inspiring way.

i was also in treble choir, yet i have a very different experience with dr. garcia-novelli. while he reiterated that treble choir is high level, he treats us as second best in comparison to chamber choir in my personal opinion. he expects everything of us yet gives us little to nothing in return. he has made choir very difficult for me.
I was in Treble Choir with him and loved it! He can be a little passive aggressive at times and expects a lot out of us, but definitely understandable given that Treble Choir is a higher-up choir.

Jen is super funny, kind, and patient. She makes a wonderful instructor! To do well, go to class because attendance really affects your grade. Also, class is structured so that nothing is dropped, so do the assignments before every class. Honestly, this class was a ton of fun, and I learned a lot! I wish I could have her for SPAN216.

I really enjoyed Prof. Gabriele's class. There were preparation assignments before every class period as well as LingroHub assignments a couple times a week, but nothing was hard and Prof. Gabriele was clear on what would be due when. She was always really patient and lenient, and facilitated discussions even on quiet days.

A truly lovely professor. She really cares about her students' success and mental wellbeing. Very receptive, responsive, and open to questions. Willing to take feedback and change aspects of her future classes to better suit students. I always felt heard and comfortable in her classroom.

The class was all online and very easy. Do all of the homework on LingroHub ahead of time and it'll save you! They are so quick to do, and you have multiple attempts if you want to increase your score. The only difficult part of this class was using Lingua Meeting to talk to a native speaker but mine was so nice and understanding. Highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Participation in class is worth 25% of your grade. No late work is accepted, but I missed a very important assignment in the beginning of the year, and she accepted it for partial credit. There isn't too much homework in the first quarter, but there's a lot in the second quarter. Jen is really nice, and the class isn't very hard.

She is a pretty good teacher, but this class definitely takes work outside of class. She is helpful if you have questions and clearly lays out what will be on tests and what you need to study. Do homework and participate in class and DO NOT miss class and you will get a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She's pretty short-fused. On several occasions she was disrespectful, judgmental, and condescending, which made for a pretty uncomfortable learning environment. While my Spanish did improve, I think I would have been more successful had she had a better attitude. All in all, this class was discouraging.

Jen was a great teacher and would totally advise taking her class if possible. She always reminded us when something was due, and also spoke Spanish well enough that we could understand what she was saying! I loved her class!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Jen was a fantastic instructor and I loved going to class. She was super helpful if you needed it and actually listened if students were struggling or had questions.

One of my top favorite engineering professors. His homework assignments make you learn a lot about him, which I thought was fun. He's lecture heavy, but he does lots of demonstrations and his office hours are great. His homework assignments do require some thought, and the exams are hard, but he goes through everything that is on it in class.

He was nice and genuine. His labs were very detailed and followed the coursework. None of the things he taught were on the FE Exam and did not prepare me for the real world. He was leaps and bounds ahead of Professor DeKosky when they taught in tandem and I'm sure the student's reviews made sure that he taught both heat and mass in the future.
Dr Gerhke is nice lecturer..he used a research paper to share knowledge. He also has a wide perspective on bioprocess

Prof. Gehrke gave the most dull and monotonous lectures I have experienced at KU. He was teaching quality material but could not present it in an intriguing manner. Do not go to him for help on homework, go to GTA's office hours. He gives lots of partial credit points in homework/exams. Routinely goes over scheduled lecture time.

I had Dr. G for CPE 525. Dr. G is the best professor I've had at KU. Why? Dr. G absolutely loves what he does, excited to teach every lecture. He is the nicest man and cares about all his students. He goes through an example problem everyday in class which is so helpful for exams (which are long/hard, but manageable) Great professor, better guy.

Dr Gehrke clearly enjoys what he does and it shows in his lectures. He seems excited to teach every day and it definitely makes the class pass by quickly. Gives lots of good examples and practice problems. I would not hesitate to take another class with Dr G.

Dr. Gehrke is not the most entertaining lecturer, but he is the nicest guy around. Would 10/10 take his class again. Tests are long, but not hard as long as you have studied. Gives tests back individually so you have time to ask for feedback. Also, he is a gifted researcher, so hearing him talk about his work is truly amazing.

I took Advanced Transport Phenomena II with Dr. Gehrke.  He is a very thorough professor, and covers the material in detail.  Very well-prepared lectures.  Exams can be a little long and hard but doable if you understand all the material in class, and do all the homework.  Very fair in grading.  Office hours are very valuable, don't miss them.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I had so much fun in his class and really understood the material. His tests were challenging but very doable. He is caring and will listen to what you have to say. Would retake this professor again.
Boring professor! And one of the worst teacher I've had in KU. He doesn't know how to teach!! His Tests are hard, especially the conceptional part.

Tests were just really long, but very manageable. Recommend lectures, although 90% is boring and off-topic, the other 10% will probably wind up on your next test. Go to lecture, go to discussion (mandatory for participation points), read the book, do the homework, you'll do fine. But he really struggles greatly in getting his point across at times.
Fantastic professor. Lectures can be boring but he genuinely cares and isn't a tough grader. Would definitely take again.

This class has been and will likely continue to be the laziest put together class I have ever taken in my academic record. There has yet to be any original material. "Learning" in this class has been hours of me looking up information about disasters with no guidance or provided material by the professor. I can get the same education from FEMA.

I enrolled in this class thinking it would be fun and an easy class to fulfill my general elective but I was completely wrong. This class has more unneccessary busy work than any of the courses I've taken for my major. The deadlines are very unclear and a 20 page research project was due the second week of class. I highly recommend against it.

Do not take GEOL 171 if you don't have to. Deadlines are insanely confusing, professors/GTAs don't respond to emails, and everything feels pointless. You learn nothing, and also have a semester long group project (for an ONLINE class) in which you basically do nothing. This class has nothing at all to take away from it, except for frustration.

Earthquakes and Natural disasters is a great class, good easy course and if you try a little you will learn.  No need to buy the book, the tests are all online and they do not vary much.  This does not mean you have to study though, expect to study about 8 hours a week for his tests.  Good teacher, just too large of a class to show much interest.
He is REALLY REALLY BORING. He mumbles in his mouth. I wish professor Roberts teaches more than him. do NOT like him

Easiest class ever. If you can memorize the test questions posted on blackboard then you will get an A. He even drops one test grade! Attendance gets you points. Easy and surprisingly interesting. Nice guy.

This class was the easiest I have taken so far.  I got a 99%.  He makes the tests directly from the study questions he posts on blackboard.  These are usually previous exams.  If you can memorize these questions, you're golden!

You have to actually pay attention and study, but it's easy to get an A if you do the work(not hard work, just some work). and the class can be interesting, it's just hard to stay focused when one can so easily disappear into their own world in a class of over 900.
Just go to class and study the old tests.
He is a really nice guy, and knows his stuff. However its hard to pay attention because it gets boring. Study the CPS, and review questions and you will do fine.
He can't speak English!!!!
BORING. Makes you use those stupid clicker things so you have to come to class. His notes are bad and gives you no clue what to study for the test. Not fun at all...
No Comments
Pay attention
Study the chapter reviews and old exams he posts on Blackboard and it's smooth sailin'!

The class itself is difficult to sit through, solely because it is Budig 120, but tsoflias knows his material and since there are so many students, there is virtually no homework. Clicker-attendance is taken through easy quizzes. If you get lower than a B you are pretty lame. His accent is funny, too. Listen for "California" and "explosive".
awsome teacher, very nice, the earthquake and you are guaranteed a B or above in his class that's if you try, he is very easy

Took both PSYCH 407 and 418 online with him. He is very chill and also young, so he always makes pretty hip references lol. I enjoyed his classes a lot! There is one assignment that you have to start a day early before the due date, but it was all easy. He doesn't take attendance either, so you don't really have to hop on Zoom if you want to.
Very knowledgeable about material and would make lectures really fun

Honestly lots of assignments, but you get them done in roughly 30 minutes. Test are online + on lockdown browser so be ready for that. I thought id have an issue but im an average college guy and ended with a 95%. Papers are graded outrageously easily, same with the exam essay question. Just make sure not to go over word limit. Easy Fun class.

Funny guy and wanted people to engage in activities. Lots of weekly assignments but so easy, not hard to get an A, also offers extra credit. If you answer a question wrong he just flat out says "nope" which is kind of embarrassing so not alot of people contribute to discussions. Acts like he hates us and his job us but hes actually a good guy.

Really great professor, super willing to make accommodations and help students out whenever needed. The way he sets up PSYC 104 makes it hard not to get an A. Just do the achieve work (read the textbook, it helps a lot, but if you don't want to, he goes over pretty much everything you should've read in class) and you'll be fine! Super funny guy too
very easy going and fun person would recommend. Works a little repetitive but he is very easy on the grading.
So so easy, I took it on hybrid and never went to a class besides the first one!
Prof. Gerami was good, he taught the class efficiently and kept things interesting. His lectures felt long, but were fun and informative. He has a lot of fun ant facts.
Super fun guy, he loves ants for some reason but manages to make the class a blast. Highly recommend!!

We had a notecard for each exam and they were simple and short exactly from what we learned it class. he is very repetitive so its hard for it to not be permanent in your brain by the time exam comes. great teacher! he definitely knows what hes doing.
he was super chill and funny. its better if you do no electronics and just come to class prepared to learn even if you dont take notes and just pay attention you will probably succeed in the class

I'm confused by the negative reviews. I attend every class, pay attention, and haven't needed to study for exams. He's funny, pushes you fairly, and even hands out candy. Just participate and take quick notes from lectures—there's no reason not to succeed. I wish I could take another class with him.
Not understanding. Would not take any classes again

(JMC320) This is my second time having him as a professor, and all I can say is that he's just boring and unhelpful. His grading scale system sucks and it's messy. Don't bother looking at your Canvas grade. He's nice and means well and emails fairly quickly, but I genuinely feel that I barely gained any knowledge from him both times.

(JMC 320) This class was super disorganized. Professor Geana and his assistant Hanna Kahn had very boring lectures that were unbelievably repetitive and a carbon copy of the readings we were assigned. He seems nice as a professor, but is rude to students when they go up to him. Lastly, his grading scale IS AWFUL. Does not match canvas at all.

(JMC 320) Prof. Geana is the nicest professor I have had at KU. All of these negative ratings have me very confused because he is the complete opposite of what these 1-star ratings are saying. I highly recommend taking a course with him, he is very understanding and knowledgeable. I would take this course with him again if I could!

This (JMC 320) was by far the most enjoyable class I've taken, and it was because of him. I was scared going into it because his rating was so low but he is the chillest professor I've had so far. He tries his best to make class fun for us and he has a great personality! All of our tests were online and open note. 10/10, would take again.
He is really chill, no homework, enjoys teaching, and tries to create an entertaining and fun environment.

He comes off as nice but as the semester progresses he becomes very rude and defensive when you ask him questions. He also interrupts and made a girl in my class cry over something that could have been discussed in private. Do not recommend

Geana was not a good professor. He grading criteria was confusing on multiple assignments and he constantly contradicted what the assignment guidelines said. He told to never look at the syllabus for information on due dates. Gets really defensive when you give feedback (that he asked for). Makes the work unnecessarily harder than it needs to be.

Dr. G is a great person, tough teacher. While his lectures can be entertaining, his grading style is not. He grades tough on papers, you basically have to have a perfect first draft to get a good grade. He is very, very, very slow with grading, which I understand, but we had revisions that haven't been graded for a month. Very draining class.

We have video lectures and occasional Zoom meetings as a chance to ask questions, however when you ask a question he doesn't like he gets defensive and rude. Its like he has never been a student and doesn't understand. If you email him for clarification he doesn't help you at all. If you can switch to another professor do it now!!

Mugur V. Geana is probably one of the worst professors I've ever had. When asking him questions about extensions or in general he is rude & typically won't give you more time. He isn't specific on his instructions, it's difficult to get good grades until you learn what he wants. Turn around times are short & doesn't give any study guides for final.

Mugur is a fantastic doctor, however, he is a terrible teacher. I could not believe the increase in dread I had every time I stepped into the classroom. If you have a hard shell, this is the class for you. You will receive little to no feedback, and forget positivity. He does this to make you work harder as a group, but it comes off ignorant.

Professor Geana is the worst professor I have ever had. He was extremely unhelpful, abrasive, difficult to deal with and likes to humiliate his students. KU let me down by allowing him to teach campaigns. I cannot stress enough how terrible of an experience I had with him as a professor.

He has no interest in teaching, and it's obvious. He's only at KU to do research. He loves to humiliate students in front of the entire class. However...the longer you know him, the cooler he gets. He truly wants the best for his students, he just shouldn't be teaching.
A terrible teacher. shouldn't be teaching

This guy is an awful teacher. Not prepared, and has the students do presentations, which he never likes. In no way prepared me for my thesis work, which is what the class is supposed to be. Actually sends texts during class

oh man. Mugur is a little bit crazy and sometimes really hard to understand, but the tests were really easy. His assignments are meant for you to fail so that you can come back next class and figure out what you did wrong. be prepared to do each assignment a couple of times.

Lectures drag, unrelated to the textbook, and the exams are only 2-3 questions for 10% of your grade. Grading isn't bad but be warned the lectures are dull and you'll do about 500 homework questions per unit on web assign since he doesn't know how to assign less.

Very chill professor and easy class. HW and activities are worth about 650/1000 of the points, meaning the rest would be split into the 3 exams. The HW is harder than the tests, and as long as you participate in the activities and can do the HW easily, the tests will feel like worksheets. Old dude and old style, but a good and nice professor.

Lectures were hard to follow, lots of homework online but all due the very last day of semester, no tests, in class quizzes can use any materials on including the internet. Easy pass and would take again for that reason.

Very laid back. Spent time on very basic concepts that felt underwhelming at the beginning of the course, but I understand it may be important for some. If I had just started my understand of Calculus I would appreicate the way he teaches. One might fall asleep in class but do your best and you'll get the grade you want.

Very nice professor who likes to ensure you do well on any of the tests. Take as many notes as possible but don't get upset if they don't help with the cengage homework. The effectiveness of the notes varies from unit to unit. The tests typically have only 6 questions and are easier than the homework.

Kangas posted every quiz on Canvas and they were due days later. He made it clear that we could use "any means" to do the quiz, which is the reason I passed. If quizzes were in person I would not pass, but I am also bad at math. Super nice tho! Low maintenance class.

I ended up teaching myself most of the content. We spent an entire class going over exponent rules (taught in college algebra/MATH 101) that no student in the class was confused about. If you know the content well beforehand, you'll be okay. If not, don't expect to learn. You also won't know your grade (bc he does not put them in) until the final.

This professor had the worst lectures ever i dont think he knew what he was doing I think he shouldnt be a teacher. I didn't learn one thing from him and had to learn everything off of YouTube or my textbook He doesnt put anything in the grade book until the semester is over so you have to calculate it yourself if you want to know what you grade is
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Great guy seems very nice but lectures are all over the place and very unorganized and had to turn to other sources to teach myself.

I was basically taught this course by My Math Lab and peers who have a good background in courses similar to trig. Kangas was helpful when you asked for help, but his "lectures" were not helpful and did not teach us anything. Only example problems were given. He also never clearly told us when tests were or what the grading scale was.
Professor Kangas is helpful when you need to reach him outside of class. He does whatever he can to clear things up, which is helpful since class is mostly online.

In online format, only told us about exams when they were opening. Everything was due on one day at the end of the semester, and he did not provide really any helpful information throughout the semester to help with assignments. Basically taught by MathLab.

I had George because I was in the time conflict class, but all the homework, quizzes, tests etc. were all made by the big lecture prof, so I felt like we were put at a disadvantage. George was nice, but he didn't teach me anything; I had to teach myself all of Calc I. If you're not familiar with calculus it'll be really hard if you take his class.

George is the best math professor I've ever had, especially at ku. He explains things in a fun way. If you have a question on a test, a quiz or homework he will point you in the right direction. I've never met a prof that wants students to succeed and understand like George, he is one of a kind. All around great guy

No one in class could understand anything he was saying during lectures. He's all over the place and there's no structure to the lesson. Everyone just stopped showing up and read the book to learn the course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: If you like teaching yourself, this guy is the prof. for you. He is very unorganized and does a poor job at explaining everything you need to know. I would leave lectures completely lost and have to figure things out on my own. His class is easy as tests are open notes, but if you need to learn the info (like me), you better take someone else.

He's super easy, but a bad teacher. I would take notes in lecture and have no idea how to do the homework, so I'd have to read the book to figure out. Before each class, he'll go over some of the homework questions, so you should get an A. You can easily just turn in the homework and leave.

His notes are a bit scattered and he doesn't do many examples. The homework isn't bad and he offers a good amount of extra credit throughout the semester. There are 2 tests, both open notes with an open note final that is NOT comprehensive.  I hardly paid attention in his class and walked out with a good grade.

Very good teacher! Was clear about subject matter and course expectations. Available and helpful outside of class. Just take good notes, do the homework and ask questions and you will do fine. Very fair, plenty of extra credit and exams were open note! Also a surprisingly good vocabulary for a math teacher.

Very good teacher. Presented all of the information and course expectations clearly. Surprisingly good vocabulary for a math teacher. Just take good notes, ask questions and do homework and you'll be fine. He is very available and helpful outside of class. Nice guy and very fair. Plenty of extra credit opportunities and exams were open note!!

He is helpful if you go to his office hours, helpful if you miss to do the gateway exam. Extremely generous on the homework grades(provided you don't do it yourself , get the answers from somewhere and get 10/10 and afterwards understand yourself) Not helpful on his review timing, selfstudy--> Better and it is worthwhile to go to his lectures

The best Math teacher I've ever had. He teaches with extreme clarity, lectures are easy to understand and he goes with a slow pace. Homework policy is amazing, no matter how late you turn in the homework, you lose 2 points on 10. Tests are open notes and very straightforward. Extremely Helpful. Loved his class!

This professor is amazing. He teaches with extreme quality, his lectures are easy to understand, goes with a slow pace. Homework policy is amazing, no matter how late you turn in the homework, you lose 2 points on 10. And 85% score on homework is an A. Tests are open notes and very straightforward. Extremely willing to helpful. Loved this class!

Amazing teacher. Explains everything very clearly. Exams are open notes. Pre-exam reviews are VERY helpful. Homework is very easy and can be submitted as late as you want just 2 points are reduced (if you submit everything on the last day of semester you still get an A). Very understanding and helpful.

If you like to teach yourself this is the teacher for you. He cannot explain anything to you and is probably one of the worst teachers I have ever had. I wish I would have dropped his class after the first day and tried to get into a new one. DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASS!

As a Math Major, Mr. Kangas has been THE worst math teacher I have ever had. I would not recommend him to anyone! He does not explain anything to you and while I understand this is college he has a responsibility to his students to help them and teach them. I wish I had better things to say but he is just THAT awful!

Very quirky, but still enthusiastic about the subject. Extremely helpful when I came to his office hours, and cut his students a lot of slack considering the subject matter, yet still challenged us with his own written tests. Had him for both 121 and 122 and HIGHLY recommend.
Awful teacher...does not explain anything at all just expects you to understand. Only take this class with this teacher if you plan on teaching yourself out of the book.
He is the best math teacher I have ever had. Extremely helpful and I would recommend him to anyone.
He is an okay professor. He lets u use your homework as notes during his test. his class is boring though and he sometimes has a hard time trying to explain a point. but overall, he is okay.
Kangas knows his stuff but isn't too clear in portraying it in class. If you go to his office hours, though, he is very helpful.

George is an acquired taste. He takes a little while to get used to, but he is a very smart teacher and is more than willing to go out of his way to help you. I highly recommend him to anyone taking Math 122. P.S. he speaks english

George Kangas is a god amongst math teachers. He is incredibly helpful and will explain any questions you have during class or office hours. I would recommend anyone taking Math 122 to attempt to get George as an instructor.
One of the best math teachers I have ever had. He is very intelligent, and he is always willing to help. I wish I had him teaching my future math classes.

He is a terrible teacher. You can tell that he knows his stuff but he doesnt know how to portray it to the students. I sit in class confused then read the book later on and understand it. He is also creepy and changes shirts once a week. Don't take his class.

This class was very challenging but I'd have to say Kangas was the best out of all the 122 teachers. He is frustrating to understand in class and very disorganized but he accommodates to his students by take home tests, long office hours, and extra credit. He also his pretty funny which helps get through having to take this class.
One funny professor, very clear and very helpful!
One of the best teacher I've ever had. He talks really clear and he has long office hours, if you have questions you can ask him during the office hour.

One of the best math teachers I have ever had. The only reason I didn't get an A was due to my own lack of studying, but he was always around to help, even willing to stay after class most every day. he is really nice and helpful. his test are easy. yes he is a bit slow but so what. deal with life, you are in college. this guy is good at teaching math. he knows it.

He knows his stuff but maybe a little too well, class was pretty much worthless but he was very good in office hours. he is so slow that i wanted to just run up to him and kill him. okay here is the deal.if u think u can stay home and study the whole entire book on your own and still get all your hw done and get watever grade you want in the exam.then take it coz he doesnt care if u are there or not.just turn in hw.if you can do it on ur own,then its time to test ur patient...

A crazy, slow teacher, but he really knows his stuff. He doesn't explain the material very well in class. Hands out a ton of homework. His tests are pretty easy, just know how to do the homework and you'll be fine. A really nice guy, who is always willing to help if you ask him...always at office hours.

Kangas is ALWAYS at his office hours. He is understanding when it comes to grades and while his curves aren't enormous, the tests aren't hard if you study. Good teacher, and pretty much an old hippie, he is a great choice for this course. Homeworks can be as late as you want with only a penalty of 20% no matter how late.
George was a really good teacher.  He is very patient and  is always available for office hours.  He says some really crazy things sometimes, but he's a fantastic teacher.  He also curves his grades.
I guess he's okay. I thought he was a little stuck up and never gives out extra credit. Small curves.
Kangas is the absent minded professor.  The man is only human, but he make a lot mistakes during notes.  Curved pretty high.

He is a great teacher with one of the longest pony tails I've seen on a guy his age. He wears chuck taylors and hawaiian shirts a lot. If you need help, he will do whatever it takes until you understand the material. He stayed after almost every class to help with the homework due that day while I had him in spring 07. I would suggest taking him

this guy will bend over backwards to help you understand the material. but in his lectures he seemed a bit timid and a bit boring. and there was a lot of homework assigned, but he would work out any problem you wanted on the board and then let you turn it in.
The material is hard, but he tries to help everybody understand. He is always willing to answer questions.

Dr. Belmas was a fantastic professor. Her grading criteria were clear. She offered study sessions for her exams and offered extra credit if you attended. Her lectures were very entertaining and educational. SHE IS A HOOT!!!

Genelle is an amazing professor and person! So so kind and really cares about her students. There were only about 5 assignments but they were all at least 20 pages long. Genelle is super understanding if you do need more time or mess something up.
I LOVE GENELLE!!!! This women is a gem. Do not take advantage of her kindness or I will come for you.

Belmas is amazing!The 4 research assignments are really long(10pages avg)but every 302 class has to do them. 10 point quiz every week as well. Responds very quickly to emails and wants you to succeed. Provides amazing examples that help with the assignments. Content isn't v interesting but Belmas is the professor to choose if you have to take it.

Seriously best at KU and in J school by far. She will work with you through anything and truly cares about you. You will learn so much and be able to challenge yourself. If you work hard you will be fine getting a good grade. Show effort and G will reward. Take her for anything she offers!

Gib is truly a gem. She is by far one of the best professors I have had. She is genuinely caring and works with each and every student. She truly invests in you. She gives you all of the resources you need to succeed. I love her! Absolutely fantastic.
Love love love Belmas!!!! Fridays are optional for her too which is great!

Professor Belmas is one of the best professors at KU. She's funny, caring, and a great lecturer. The book isn't as important as in other classes, but be sure to attend lectures. The tests/quizzes are online and she puts the powerpoint slides online so you can have the open while you take the tests. She gives a lot of EC and helps you a lot.
Belmas is the best!!! Im in this class during corona time and shes been so flexible also i was in it MWF and fridays are all extra credit if u show up. Shes dope and its super easy!

One of the best professors in the J school. She's funny, kind and knows what she's talking about. As for 201, the class fosters your creativity and gives you a real chance to get out of your comfort zone in a safe way. I highly recommend Belmas and 201 to anyone planning to be creative in their profession.

I really enjoyed the content of the course and would take it again in a heartbeat. Professor was accessible IRL despite it being an summer online class. Lots of flexibility on the final and extra credit is available. Only qualm was that grades weren't uploaded until after the course ended.
Belmas made 302 so clear! She literally did all the projects too and gave us great examples. Super understanding and sweet. You can tell she loves us and what she does. Take 302 with Belmas 100%

Dr. Belmas is one of the best teachers I've had in college. She makes her Friday classes optional, all tests are online, you don't have to write any papers, and her lectures are truly iconic. That being said, you have to show up to class and pay attention because her texts are very difficult. I think everyone in college should take this class.

Lectures are SO fun. She really knows what she's talking about. The topic matter can be confusing but she makes it really easy to understand and all the tests are open book open note on Blackboard. She cancels Fridays half the time and doesn't take attendance on those days anyways. If you take 618 with any other professor you are making a mistake!
Really knowledgable in the subject of law and is excellent at explaining difficult concepts. Makes the lectures very entertaining and genuinely cares about her students.

Amazing professor. I had her for first amendment. She loves the subject and her passion for it makes it easier to learn. She does a great job at dumbing it down for people like me who know nothing about law. She does it in a way that is entertaining and relatable. The tests are kinda hard, but you can use your notes since they are online.
She is an amazing lady! She is so caring about her students and my favorite professor ever!

She is the best professor I have ever had, so funny, honest, understands when you are busy and won't overload you. She always gives students the opportunity to respond to her ideas and is very down to earth. I had her for the first run of the gaming class in the J-school and even though I have no interest in gaming she made it interesting.
She is seriously the greatest, most kind professor in the J School. I've gotten to become super close to her and I absolutely loved her Law seminar as well. she is a HUGE nerd, but it's so awesome!
Professor Moon was a delight to have. His class will be one of the lowest-stress classes you will take.
He was awesome, and went above and beyond to give great feedback on my papers.

Nice guy, very understanding, easy grader. He does go through his lectures pretty fast, and since he also has an accent and talks kinda quietly it can be a bit difficult to get everything, so it might be good to sit in the front. Overall not a class to stress about (I probably I slept through over half the classes and still managed to get a B-).

Patrick is very nice and likes to hear any students' opinions on subjects without judgement, even changing some of his view points because of new points brought up. I personally didn't have much difficulty understanding his accent except having to pay slightly more attention, which honestly just made me pay attention more to class.

Patrick is a great teacher, and really cares about his students. Hes very understanding about life stuff that comes up, gives lots of extra credit opportunities, and is very accessible if you ever need help with assignments. I loved his class, and would take it again if I could!

Very easy grader, very nice person. It says attendance is mandatory but it's really not and won't affect your grade too much. Exam's are pretty hard as are essays but he grades very easily. Tuesday night class does suck, but aside from occasional papers you really don't have to put in much work for this class.

This teacher does a lot of lectures and he goes way too fast. Also he has a thick accent and most of the class couldn't understand him. He was not a great teacher. you are required to go to a night class every Tuesday to watch a movie and your grade is affected by if you attend or not.

Paola is very funny and makes the class interesting. However, she isn't very organized some classes are repeated or can seem to go on because much wasn't planned. She for the most part is a fair grader but how she grades some things isn't very clear.

Professor Ghezzo is a great person and is always willing to meet and help you. However her lectures don't have a flow and aren't always prepare. Homework and readings for a new chapter are expected to be done before the class which can be challenging when you're learning new material.

Paola is amazing! She is WAY more interested in making sure you enjoy Italian and embrace the culture rather than worrying about a grade. She always gives extra credit when she can while following departmental policy. I learned so much in her class and I learned how to enjoy Italian culture! I hope to take ITAL 230 with her in the fall.

If you are going to take a foreign language, take it with Paola!! I took Italian 110, and she actually had me learning something. Available outside of class for when I inevitably had questions. Very clear on grading and tells you exactly what is going on. She allows corrections and gives out extra credit if you go to class and the Italian club.

Paola was a wonderful professor! As with any language, there was a lot of work to be done, but it was all useful. She was always willing to help and answer any questions. If I could take every level of Italian with her, I would.

Paola is an incredible professor! However, as with any language course, beware that 5 credit hours means a lot of work. Daily homework with extra studying on top of that... I probably spend about 1-2 hours on Italian daily. She is a native speaker and explains everything well. Always SO helpful when you go into office hours!!

Paola is AMAZING! She is from Venice, so is a native speaker of Italian which is very helpful. I had her for both 110 and 120, and learned so much. She will help you as much as she can, making the class fairly easy if you put in the study hours for vocab and such. Take her if possible!!!

She was so easy to talk to and created a space where everyone felt comfortable to discuss heavy topics. She was did an incredible job teaching this class, and I wish she was staying at KU. If you have the chance to take a class from her I highly recommend it!!
Dr. Ghazali is really amazing!!! If you are a responsible student you will get an easy A. Her lectures are not boring. She is willing to help everyone.
Amazing teacher who cares about everybody, Enjoyed her class so much.

I loved taking her class. She would be the first professor I would go to if I needed help with anything. She really takes time to make you feel like good about yourself and she is truly the most amazing person I ave ever met.

Marwa is my girl!!! I was dreading this class until I took it and she has made me want to come to class, do work for her class, and always always is there for me whenever I need it. I even decided to take another class from her and will prolly always take a class from her. She is just the absolute best person.

Marwa is the best professor I had at KU. Her class is very interesting and it will change your life and perspective. It was a therapy for me. sessions are interesting and she will make it fun and easy. She is very knowledgeable and open-minded. The discussions are great and she respects everybody.

I took her for a winter break online class and she is very clear in her videos. She's also very nice and quick to reply to emails. My only complaint is that her voice is so soothing and relaxing that I literally went to sleep listening to one of her lectures haha.
Marwa is a great speaker. I have NO interest in enlightenment philosophy and she made it relatable and fun!
Absolutely WONDERFUL teacher. I hate history and somehow she made everything interesting. The class discussions are phenomenal!
Marwa is great at lecturing and always tries to help her students succeed. The only complaint I have is that she is a slow grader.

Best HWC teacher there is. If you're enrolled in a different section now, it's worth your time to completely switch your semester schedule around in order to take her section of it! She is incredibly helpful and super engaging. She delivers lectures so well that I only ever had to read the textbooks when I was writing papers. She is very flexible and is fairly accepting of late work. Western Civ is a drag but Marwa makes it easy, clear and understandable. Also very responsive to email questions.
Marwa is sweet, funny, and a babe. I could tell she really cares about her students and likes what she does. She always made my days a little better and managed to make western civ bearable.

Marwa is an incredible teacher.  She not only is down to earth but knowledgable and willing to help.  She earns students respect by being relatable yet still is distinguished as a teacher because of her knowledge.  I have recommended her to numerous friends and they have all loved her as much as I have.

One of the best and fun class I have taken so far.  He's explain material really well, and he's funny.  I wish to have him as an instructor for all of my math classes!!  Adam rocks, period!

Dr Sousa is inspiring and very engaging. He is very nice and smart!

Great teacher! If you are at all into Shakespeare or Brit lit, take a class with him; he is extremely knowledgeable and, therefore, the class won't be an easy A by any means. He is a very very vague teacher, his test questions are very open-ended and he doesnt give clear responses.  He allows you to choose your own essay topics which i personally do not like. I learned so much from this class. Dr.Sousa is an excellent instructor, gives lots of constructive feedback on writing projects, and challenges his students to be better than what they already are. Worked extremely hard for an A, but the experience was completely worth it!

This guy really knows his Shakespeare! You read a lot of different plays and discuss them after as a class, which I like. There are two papers and when I was confused on my second paper, he helped me think of a thesis and I did very well. The final and midterm are hard, fyi. I loved this class and thought he was an awesome teacher!
Very helpful teacher

great teacher.  Very helpful

great!

great teacher & great class on journeys of discovery.  highly recommended.

she knows HR topics real well
