I am not the best at english and somehow tested into this class. For me writing is fairly difficult and he is also unclear on exactly what he wants on papers. He gives 3/4 paper topics and that is all. He offers a lot of help though. Discussion is also important because it is worth a lot of your grade so if you don't like to talk, don't take this.

It may be completely played out to say this, but Dr. Outka changed my life. This was my first semester as an english major and he's the reason I stuck with it. If you're inquisitive and self motivated he is the teacher for youhe was always really helpful and great at helping me take my ideas to the next level. He was indispensable to my education.

The readings are demanding, but all in all it's really worth it. The class and Outka offer access to the poets in a really fresh way. It's engaging. Honestly one of my favorite classes in all 4 years.
I took Outka's seminar on Biotech and the Posthuman.  The subject of the class was pretty interesting, and the whole class is basically discussions and reading.

Literally the worst class I have ever taken. We did not learn a single thing about english or writing, which is what the class is actually supposed to be about. He rambles on about philosophy all day, every single day and it is honestly just painful. He does not respond to emails and is not clear on what he wants in papers, tests, etc. Hate him.

I didn't expect to enjoy a course on American Literary Environmentalism, and was taking it as a requirement for honors in the dept. However, this class makes me think every day about my environmental impact and has introduced me to a canon of  literature I didn't realize existed. Though extreme in his views, Outka respects students. Class is fun.

He's brilliant. Before his class, I just needed another capstone. Expected "nature writing" course which I was not looking forward to. I was wrong about the nature writing, his approach is much more interesting and valuable.

Dude is brilliant. I must have copied down 50 different things he said verbatim just so that I wouldn't forget them. It's a lot of reading, but that is to be expected from a 500-level class taught by a sincerely engaged professor. His deadlines are flexible if you are willing to talk with him. I seriously recommend taking a class with him.

I deeply regret taking this course from this professor. He lectures the entire time and is not open to varying opinions regarding the readings. It's INSANELY boring. Mind numbing would be an understatement. Paul grades incredibly hard and gives difficult exams.  Seems like a great guy, just not my kind of teacher.

If you are really looking for a class highly enthusiastic about American Literature, than this class is definitely for you. But there is A LOT of work and reading required, the midterm and final are both extremely difficult, and he is a tough grader who does not give you second chances. He also lectures all class and can be exceptionally boring.
he's brilliant. take his class. you will learn, but you have to want to learn in the first place. his class makes you want to learn more, which is ultimately the point.
Absolute worst lecturer in the law school.  No help at all, and no concept of how to properly teach and demonstrate lawyering.  Avoid at all costs.  Remain in her section at your peril!
i like her!!!!!

She and her class were as useful as a bag of hair.  Gave an assignment, then no help.  Had the opportunity to sit in on 2 other instructor's courses - Oury should do the same.  Wasted my time and $2,400 in her class - not to mention her attempt at lecturing to the class as a whole.
No Comments

She couldn't help me on my memo as much as I would've liked (and I don't think that was her fault so much as it's just the way the system works) but her class presentations were fine and she always seemed to want to be helpful.

Oury is definitely the worst teacher I have ever had, in my life. . .kidergarten on up.  She cannot articulate a damn thing for anyone to learn, teacher/professor is not in her vocab.  She is HORRIBLE and if you have to take her SORRY!!!!!!!!!
Oury is the worst teacher i've ever had during the entire time i've been in school. she is incompetant and should be banned from teaching

Had him for Phsx 212, he's a really nice guy and was always happy to help during office hours. One of my friends had a conflict with the final and Professor Overholt let him take the final later that day with no questions asked. Very good class.

Knows his stuff, but is patronizing and won't give much guidance when asked for help. Tests are unreasonable challenging and not like the in-class work of homework. His attitude really ruins this class. Good luck with him
He is such an awesome and fun professor! He is a little hard to understand at times, but he is extremely helpful when you go to him. He's okay, but not great at explaining the super hard stuff.
Professor was not good at all, teaching methods were very poor, and didn't help students in need

James was one of the most unorganized professors I have ever had. He took what was supposed to be an easy A type of class to tough B. He rarely ever responded to emails and took forever to grade our speeches.

Worst teacher I've ever had to be perfectly honest. DO NOT TAKE HIS COURSE! He doesn't return paper work, respond to emails, or follow through with what he says he will do. He will cancel class ONCE IT HAS BEGUN. Class will be sitting in our room waiting and 10 minutes into class we will receive an email stating class is canceled. Awful teacher.

James is EXTREMELY disorganized. He lost one of my speeches, so I will never know what grade I received. He didn't remember either. He's an extremely hard grader and in this class you learn absolutely nothing. He never emails back and you won't know your grade until the last day of class.Take this with another teacher, save yourself.

I don't know how he is still a teacher. The MOST unorganized teacher I have ever had the misfortune of having. Takes ages to grade, then doesn't enter the grades online. He expects grad student work from an introductory class. He is terrible with emailing back/office hours. He is very unclear about assignments. Very often condescending as well.

For a 100 level class he is ridiculous. Expects way too much out of students for one of the easiest classes at the university. It's very hard to understand his expectations. Can be funny, but this is his only redeeming quality. I suggest any other teacher for COMS 130 possible.

Terrible teacher. Extremely lazy and too tough of a grader on speechs for a 100 level class. Very confusing quizzes even if you read the textbook. He will not cut you a break i was 1.5 points shy of a B and didn't give it to me. Just bad at teaching in general. Much easier Coms teachers out there than him trust me.
Really fun class. If you take COMS 130 try to get this teacher. Sooo laid back, loves chatting, but you can still learn a lot. Do the readings and he loves cutting breaks for good students.

Awesome man, if you have him take him at all costs, he does require you to do work outside of class but he will make you learn in a fun way. This guy was the best teacher I've had so far. Funnest class ever!

He is one of the best professors I had in undergrad. His lectures were awesome and engaging which made me happy to go to class each day. Normally professors are boring and just read of power points but Orr was very engaging and made sure we understood the material by making the difficult concepts more easier to understand.

I only had Dr. Orr for a couple of weeks as my previous professor got fired. All I can say is that his lectures are easy to follow and his test was similar to the exam review he gave. He's a genuine professor. He wants you to understand the material. You are required to buy the launchpad (which has an online book). Don't buy the hard copy.

His lectures were full of going into depth about erroneous tangents of the subject matter that were not being tested over and sometimes confusing. He was very unsure of himself and the topics he was teaching that day. I did not enjoy his teacher. Beware he loves clicker quizzes

He only taught the first half, but was helpful by drawing and writing helpful notes on the screen. For a big lecture hall, I felt like I got a lot out of it. His clicker questions were simple. He's retiring, which is too bad because he is experienced and I really enjoyed his laid-back style. He provided excellent help when I asked about the final.

Dr. Orr  was a great Biology Professor. I had him for Biology 150. This class is an easy A for you read the Biology book and study Orr's lecture powerpoint. I thought his test were fair. Lectures can be BORING because of his monotone voice, especially since its an 8am class, but its endurable. We had clicker questions so ALWAYS go to lecture.
Super nice guy. Saw him dance on a table once. Material and tests are hard, but he's pretty willing to help

Dr. Orr is a very likable professor, but his lectures can be confusing at times, and I found his tests to be pretty difficult. It is important to study and read throughout the whole semester, and not just during the week of a test. Make sure to go to class to get points on clicker quizzes.

I absolutely hated this class. The lectures were very boring and hard to pay attention to. The lectures are very brief and don't really match the exams. The exams are very detailed and many of the questions are lengthy and tricky. Reading the book and thoroughly understanding the material is crucial. It was very difficult to study for the exams.

The test questions are pretty specific and they make you think. Showing up to lectures is important because of the random clicker quizzes. Lectures are pretty dry and boring. I found myself sleeping pretty often. The lab is easy and you have unit tests every week. As long as you study you will receive an A in lab which will help your overall grade.

Got an A, so my comments are not spiteful. They're true. Orr needs his notebook to teach. Of course you'll have to read the textbook you purchased, but expect for it to be the only source of studying. Lectures are not useless but surface level only. No prior knowledge needed, just read. Orr personally teaches but relies on TAs for everything else.

Lecture can be monotonous, but wake up and take good lecture notes because this is primarily what is on the exams. His tests can be pretty tricky so have an excellent understanding of the material. I personally thought the homework was a bit difficult but the lab is definitely a breeze. Went to lecture, read the book, got an A. Simple as that.

I get the sense that Dr. Orr doesn't understand much aside from what's in his notebook. He makes lots of mistakes! You absolutely need to read the book to do well on exams. You can drop 1/3 exam scores. You'll hate group activities where he makes you watch a video lecture and then talk about it when he could have just lectured in class. Average.

Innocent and tired, but passionate and caring. Teaches from the book by rewriting notes on overhead. Without his notes, his understanding is brief. He paired cytosine with cytosine (not by mistake) and forgot pyrimidines. Lectures cover only the iceberg's tip. Read the book! Exam questions from book company. Provides previous year's exam. Easy lab.

Orr's made it clear that our exams were only over what he has taught us in class. His TAs were on top of things when it came to blackboard and allowed the students to know exactly what sections are on the exam and were great about review sessions before exams!

He is a good teacher, but his tests are really hard. They don't really follow his lectures, the student gets the outline of a subject and has to be able to understand the entirety of the subject for the test. He is a very passionate teacher but I think his test are unfair. I study two weeks ahead and still get about 65-70% on each test.
His lectures do not match well with the tests. The lectures cover the bare bones of the material. The student is left to fill in the gaps on their own.

One of the best professors I've ever had. This is a class that I actually look forward to going to at 8AM. He teachers the material well and keeps it interesting. The tests are very straight forward and the study sessions and old tests are extremely helpful. Great class. I would highly recommend it!

Awesome professor! He is clear, obviously enjoys what he is teaching, and teaches with his own written notes as he goes through class instead of reading from a boring powerpoint presentation, making his lectures much easier to pay attention to. I just wish he had taught the whole class instead of half of it.

I don't know what these other people are talking about. His tests were impossible! I never got anything better than a C on any of them because he would constantly change what he would test you on (i.e. lecture notes, study guide, or textbook). Good luck.

The class is easy if you take notes, read the textbook, and study. Online homeworks are easy. The BioPlus program is extremely helpful, and the lab is easy. Dr.Orr is very monotone, and it is hard to stay awake. If you get past the monotony, he's a good professor that follows the textbook.
Dr. Orr's class is easy if you go to class and study. Also, Dr. Orr has had many years of experience and his teaching style reflects that. Great professor!
Professor Orr is amazing! He's a fantastic lecturer, and best of all, he grades very fairly and obviously really cares about the success of his students.

Dr. Orr is a great professor and really values his student's success.  He follows the textbook really well and although going to lecture sometimes may be a drag, he explains things really well.  He was also very approachable and always willing to answer any questions.  Great professor overall!

Prof. Orr is an unique teacher with lots of quirks to him. He goes off the textbook very well, and he explains all the concepts well. He is fair with his students and gives every student a fair opportunity any regards to quizes recitation and your overall grade. Take the class, it's not that bad, and he's an above average teacher.
Good teacher.  Lecture notes coincided with exam questions nearly perfectly.  Never read the book, just reviewed the notes before each exam and did well.  Attendance is very important to do well.
Professor Orr would do well to not reiterate ad nausea. The class spent many days reviewing the information that had been covered the class previous. And lectures were him on broken record.

Professor Orr would manage to not repeat the same topics in class that he had covered a class prior and to not spend so much time looking for recognition that students understood while in a 500 person hall. Entirely too easy to fall asleep.
fantastic teacher, he gives great explanations, and went over all pertinent material. class was organized very well with lab and homework.
I did not believe he was clear on what was on the exams. Studied for a good week for one test and still got a 70. Worst teacher I have ever had.
Great teacher. Great sense of humor. Reading the book helped out a lot!!! His notes were easy to follow. Tests were easy if you study his notes. Go to PLUS sessions. Online homework was also helpful

Professor is very hard to understand during the lectures. His notes are NOT in order so leave room for clarification or be prepared to reorganize. He is willing to work with the class. Refer to old tests and the end of chapter quizzes in the book for test questions. The Mastering Biology study area helps too.

I only attended about 4 of his lectures, but he made me so uncomfortable that I didn't really want to go back. The material is so easy I wouldn't waste my time attending class and listening to his creepy stories and overall awkward presence. Take the class though, probably one of the easiest A's you will get in college.

The lectures got long but go to class and write down everything down that comes out of his mouth. The go back and read the book and reinforce it. Another good class to look at test files because he uses old questions a lot. The book sucks to read but I found it really helpful. Good teacher, kind of boring lectures put pay attention

He is very willing to help and really is a nice old man. I enjoyed his class mostly because he explicitly will tell you what is on the test and will even provide you with last year's test. No trick questions, he will only ask you on material he went over in class. Don't buy the book. $200 on it and only get $5 back out, you will be fine without.

Orr is a great professor. He really cares about the student. I am not going to say this is an easy class, but you can achieve an A if you put the work into. There is lots of extra help and the information that you need to study for the test is pretty straight forward. Orr is Hilarious. Do not stress the class.

Good teacher. The notes don't go in order and they are NOT on powerpoint. you actually have to pay attention in class to get good not cause they are mostly pictures of how things function. If you study hard you will do well. I got a 97% in the class. I slept through a whole unit and got a 98 on the test, its not that difficult. The quizzes are supp

Bad thing about this class is it is at 8 in the morning when all you wanna do is sleep. I wish I had been more prepared for this but he's a good guy. His exams are pretty straightforward. If you take BIOL 646, you are guaranteed to have him since he is one of the three teachers.

Class was extremely boring. He repeated the same thing ten times. Like he would say Adenine goes with Thymine a hundred times. We got it the first time so no need to repeat things over and over again. Read the book if you want to do well on the tests. four tests and none is dropped.

I thought that he was a good teacher.  If you read the book as well as his notes, the material made sense.  The Tests are difficult though. I studied for a week for the final and got a 66%.  Don't let the class fool you as being easy.
Worst teacher I have ever had. Steer clear. So Boring I feel asleep every day, 4 tests, he does not drop any tests or curve.
gives the worst notes possible they are horrible and go in no order.

Sometimes it gets boring...but thats just the material.  Not really a great way to make mitochondria interesting, but Orr tries.  Odd sense of humor but very entertaining.  Tests are not bad, everything is completely off of notes in class, text useful for clarification, not a full read. gives old tests for review.

Sometimes it gets boring...but thats just the material.  Not really a great way to make mitochondria interesting, but Orr tries.  Odd sense of humor but very entertaining.  Tests are not bad, everything is completely off of notes in class, text useful for clarification, not a full read. gives old tests for review.
Funny guy, very clear.

Legit teacher. It's a hard subject and the way it is explained makes you fall asleep, but he's really helpful and gives a copy of the old test to help you study. Definitely read the book, go to every lecture, and GO TO PLUS BIOLOGY. So important...Plus Bio is what helped me get an A.
Worst Professor EVER! DO NOT TAKE! I REPEAT! YOU WILL WANT TO PUNCH HIM IN THE FACE! TESTS ARE IMPOSSIBLE!

You have to go to class. He says it's not mandatory but if you want to pass, GO. It is boring, but I'm proud to say I've only fallen asleep twice. You have to hardcore study for his tests because they are difficult. I recommend reading the book if you want a B or A.
Sounds like the host of Whad'ya Know on NPR. Good professor.

Although you only have attendance grade for lab, you need to go to lecture to even somewhat understand him. He was BORING! If it wasn't for lab, I would've failed, and I don't fail. The tests were not close to the material that was lectured. I don't think you have a choice of professor, but I would try a community college before him.
He is a very good teacher. Go to class!!! and if you do bad on your testes make sure you get an A in lab, it'll help a LOT. Hard class but if you study a crap load you'll do fine. (read the book)

He talks to students like we are little kids. His lectures are boring, his jokes aren't funny, he is one of the worst science professors I have had. We do not need to hear that glucose has 6 carbons more than 5 times. We got it after the 3rd time thanks. His voice is really annoying as well. Bills to the Back!x10.
This class can be hard if you don't attend lecture. READ THE BOOK and don't slack in lab (its 25% of your grade) Overall not too difficult, I got a B.

This is a VERY hard class! The professor seems intelegent but he repetes himself so much. He uses too many words to get the point across. He is not a good communicator. The power points do not help very much, you have to write down everything that comes out of his mouth. The good thing is that he goes right along with the book. overall: HARD

Class attendance is a must for this class.  Yes, he posts the powerpoints online after class, but they contain very little information.  Tests are challenging, require a lot of memorization, but are definitely doable! Labs are a pretty easy A, no lab reports :)!

Extremely clear in his explanations. He is definately passionate about what he does and the subject matter he is teaching. Almost all of the material comes from his class lectures, but most of the information can be found in the textbook. Great class.

I have taken two classes from him and he has been great! The class is easy and interesting as long as you go to class! Listen to what he says carefully because he will give away the answers to his test.

I loved Dr. Orr. He's a great professor--really knows his stuff. Sometimes he seemed to give too much information in one lecture, but was always good about presenting the material in more than one way (notes, diagrams, charts, etc...) making it easier to comprehend. DO THE READINGS! and study hard for tests
No Comments
I thinkt that the class was not really that hard, but it provided a good entery level biology. I would take his class...

He's boring, but a nice guy. The tests were hard, but not impossible. When he posted the answers for tests there were ALWAYS errors, so make sure you double check the book if you think a posted answer is wrong. I was very disappointed how incompetent the TA's were....

Orr is ok. He tends to treat his students like they are in kindergarden especially when it comes to tests.  The tests are held in class, so everyone has to squeeze into Budig. Sit in the back and you won't have to sit in between people. Orr relies too much on his TA's. It makes him seem helpless.
he's a pretty funny guy and very nice, notes get a little bit confusing when you go back and reread them. other then that hes a good at lecturing and keeps it as interesting as biology can get

I got bored with his 8 AM lecture, but once you get 50 points in quizes you can stop going without it effecting your grade.  That is, assumeing you're good in biology and can learn from a book.  He posted all of his powerpoints online, but does a lot of extra notes during class.
funny guy.  he kept me awake in this 8am class!
good teacher
hes a helpful guy
Tests are very easy
No Comments
He talks like the guy for the eye drop commercial that says "for dry red eyes, clear eyes is better"  Class was interesting- he has a lot of dry humor.  I thought exams were hard though!
Orr is a good guy.  Class is VERY difficult b/c it was at 8:00!  very hard to stay awake and pay attention.  the lab section will launch your grade since it is combined with the lecture grade.

Professor Orr is an awesome guy! I hated biology before taking this class and loved going to it by the end of the semester. Orr got me excited about the subject. He only tests over what he lectures, so reading the book is just for verifying the information.
Boring, but smart and helpful.  Good class..

Excellent teacher. Makes 8 am bearable. Very approachable. More than willing to go the extra *2* miles after class to make sure you understand. Also very willing to work around weird circumstances. No better teacher to take this class from!
Very easy class.  Lab even easier.  Interesting even at 8am!  Strongly rec. taking his class.
Extremely Easy!
Great teacher!  He made the most difficult concepts seem easy and always managed to keep me awake at 8:30 in the morning!
He is a great teacher.  He makes the boring stuff interesting and always gets you to laugh, even if it's a corny science joke.
for 8AM he was an awesome teacher!! Funny old man.  i recommend taking a class with him
The class was interesting, even at 8AM.  He's pretty cool.
Dr. Orr is a really nice man who always is willing to go out of the way to help students.  He is also a great advisor.
No Comments

An absolutely amazing professor. He took the time to answer all of my questions and was even available after hours. I scored really well in this class with only moderate work. His lectures take care of Most if the course work.

Michael is one of my favorite professors. He makes class so interesting and is very passionate about the subject. He's really good at getting the whole class to engage, and always makes students feel like anything they say or any questions they have are valuable. I thought the content would've been so boring to engage in, but he always makes it fun

Class is a little lecture heavy and he doesn't use powerpoints, so it's important to go to class. He can be quite interesting and really cares about the material but sometimes goes off on tangents. His pop quizzes are difficult unless you fully understood the readings. He's very helpful if you go to his office hours. Slow to upload grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Very engaging class. The content is some what boring, but he makes it easy to understand (given you pay attention). Highly recommend a class by him. Incredibly down to earth person, and truly lives by what he teaches in class. Wants all of his students to be the best at what they do and succeed at their maximum potential. *Two-Thumbs Up*

Dan is an engaging lecturer. Related every topic to your everyday life (you learn A LOT). I'm a science major and taking 400, 500+ chem and bio classes, and learned more in his class than any science class. Too bad he won't be at KU anymore. The man lives economics. Couldnt thank him enough for sharing his knowledge and insight. Take a class by him

Dan Owens is the best professor I have had at my time at KU. When I went in to his office for help, he was super nice & spent ample time making sure I knew the subject. His class is engaging (3:10 Funnies!), the exams are very fair, and you will leave knowing more than you expect. He also plays great music before class. Highly recommended!

Great guy; great professor. Workload is reasonable and grading is fair. Attendance is a pretty big part of the grade, so be sure to go to class. You'll probably want to go anyway, his lectures are very engaging.
His lectures are long and boring and you can just read the book. Tests are hard. The questions are very confusing and wordy.

Dan is a really interesting and funny guy.  His class is fairly straight forward and consists of non cumulative tests, homework, and attendance.  There's a ton of note-taking in class and him constantly writing on the board and you having to copy it down can be fairly distracting.  His assigned textbook is top notch, though. I'd take him again.

Dude is dope, lectures are cool and he can teach while keeping it engaging and relevant. As an econ major I would def recommend him. Not much hw besides keeping up with a reading or two test are pretty clear cut too.

Loved his lectures. He teaches the subject so that it makes sense and it's interesting. Class is not just a repeat of what the book is talking about and is worth going. He is one of the best teachers at KU. I've taken Econ 535, 522, and 524 with him and loved every class.

I had Dan for both 522 and 530. I'm about to graduate and he's been the best professor I've had at KU. He makes what can be sometimes dry subject matter pretty entertaining. He's also incredibly smart and shows you a lot of "mind candy" throughout the course. His tests are also very straightforward, he pretty much tells you what's on it.

Dan Owens is hands down the best teacher I've had at KU. I'm an econ major so I enjoyed the lectures, but even if you aren't an econ major the lectures are still entertaining. Dan truly wants you to get a good grade in the class and help you with whatever you need. You would be stupid not to take a class of his.

Professor Owens is the complete package - funny, knowledgeable, and understanding of students. If you study hard before each exam and consistently go to class, you'll do great. I'd strongly recommend taking his class.
Professor Owens is sarcastic funny and knows his econ. You have to work, but you will leave knowing your stuff.

Come to class daily since there is a 2.5 point grade for coming everyday. If you do the homework, and rewrite to better understand the notes/graphs this ends up being really helpful for the tests. I thought the book helped with graphs and case studies. Put forth some work and effort and you can get an A. 4 exams only. Great class and professor!

Dan is a fantastic teacher. There is a participation grade in the class so attendance is required, but if you have any interest in economics you will want to be there anyway. Dan gives crystal clear explanations and his teaching method is engaging. Won't try to trick you on HW and tests, everything comes straight from the notes.

Absolutely loved him. Brilliant guy. Incorporates knowledge from real world case studies into lectures to help teach the theories. Remarkably effective and very interesting. One of the best teachers of any subject I've ever had. Class is simple, but challenging. He's very clear with his expectations and it shouldn't be hard to get an A. Great guy.
The only reason to be an econ major. Best professor at KU.
Dan is the reason econ is my major, he is the best teacher I have ever had and he is a brilliant guy. Then only class I look forward to every week.

I cannot stress how much I appreciated taking Dan's class. Probably the most important thing to note is how abundantly clear he makes his expectations of students.  There are no surprises, no tricks.  The man simply loves teaching and he makes his students love learning. Funny, too. Definitely recommend!

Dan is truly an amazing professor. One of the best I've ever had. He makes everything he presents interesting and connects it to real world material. I can honestly say that he has added the most to my general understanding of economics. You will  not regret taking a class from this guy. People rarely miss class because it is so interesting!

Absolutely one of the best professors I have ever had. He relates everything to real life situations and takes a personal interest in his students. More than willing to meet one on one with a student to make sure they are understanding the material. Meets one on one with every student at least once. I would recommend taking his course.

Dan is new to Kansas University, and will teach his first class there in the Spring of 2013.  The above ratings are approximately what he rates after 64 reviews for his teaching at Johnson County Community College.  Interested K.U. students can look him up through that college.
I took finanacial markets and institution, with her and I had to drop it. Dont take it with her. Its suppose to be an easy course, but she make it harder.

It was a challenge but I learned a lot. She is very helpful and avail. out of class. Tests are easy, similar to the study guides. If you are serious about your career, take her class, otherwise shop around :)

Had her for Fin 430 too. She is a bit hard to understand, but she does her best. Focus on the study guides she gives, as that's what is on the tests. I started skipping classes near the end of semester simply because everything came from those study guides. She also gives 10% of her grades for attendance. Group project for Fin 430 class.

Ozde was so hard to understand with her accent, but very knowledged on the subject. I personally had trouble with her teaching style; reading straight from the slides, with little explanation. She was more focused on how much she could cover rather than the quality of the subject she was teaching. Very frustrating class overall.
She is very committed, lots of tests and assignments, but I learned a lot! Not an easy class.

Lisa does not look or act like she wants to be in class. She is always the last one in (and sometimes late I might add) and always in a rush to leave class. She is extremely dismissive towards questions and is patronizing. Her class is not hard as long as you follow along, but remember that she gives horrible instructions and omits important things

This class was a little fast paced through the database. If you get distracted you'll fall behind basically. The outside group project was inconvenient especially over thanksgiving break. Pick a reliable person as your partner. The final is easy as long as you pay attention. If you did well in the first half of the class, you'll be fine
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Lisa is nice and willing to help if you ask. The class is pretty easy and straightforward and the grading criteria is very clearly outlined so you know exactly what you need to do. Boring class, but it's easy.
I didn't like the database stuff in this class. Its kind of tough and the final project was alot of work. But its an okay class.
Lisa is what you would expect if you imagined a sorority girl all grown up, she is conniving, unintelligent, and always has a fake smile. She plays favorites, so try to be nice to her.

Most of the class is intuitive, it's the grading that makes it difficult. Ottinger and the TA are VERY aggressive in their grading of homework and projects-you better have everything EXACTLY as she wants or you will lose points.
She only talks about weird stuff bid on ebay...
She makes the class harder than what it really seems.

Lisa cares about what she does and wants the ku business school to be one of the top notch in the nation. She has done a lot for this school and works hard at her job. Her class isn't very hard you just have to do the hw. Going to class isn't that important either. Some advice for students is to do the hw assignments and E.C.
BORING! She rambled so much throughout lectures and would backtrack to say the same thing again and again without even realizing it.  She does know what she's doing, but she's an idiot.
I think that this class is really boring... blee I have problems to stay awake. Am I the only one??
No Comments

I agree that the lecture is extremely boring and not worth the money I paid for the 3 credits.  I could've just bought the books and learn by myself if it's not required.  However, I don't agree that you have to be good at computers to do good in all the assignments and projects.  As long as you follow the tutorials it'll be fine.
No Comments

if you know computers VERY VERY easy. if you don't, it's just a bunch of techno-language and random little news about managing IT today. go to days that there are speakers, the speakers are interesting anyway.

Class is VERY VERY boring- her voice is monotone.  She talks way too much about her daughter.  I had more homework/projects/exams than an any class I've taken at KU.  Basically- a waste of time for students trying to get into the school of business.  Sorry, I know it's required!
lecture is pointless

Okay she is okay with this class but the TAs grade stupid things off with the assignments you do outside class.  I haven't taken one note in class and i have an A.  It's kind of a current events class.  Just know the review and you'll get good grades on the tests.

All I can say is hold on.  It is the most boring and frustrating class ever.  Not because the material is hard, it just boring and not worth while.  Some homework assignments take forever.  She is very unclear and the way the class is set up is dumb.
Tests are all memorization from lectures and book. For final look at tests you previoulsy took.  All questions are the same.  She is boring, but easy.
If you are good at computers you will do good in this class.

The course itself is easy, because it mostly focuses on basic computer skills.  However she makes it harder than it should be and is a horrible teacher who will spend half the class talking about stuff that doesn't matter.
The most annoying class I've ever taken.

If you are willing to engage with the class materials in French - and put up with Dr. Scott's British dryness - I would recommend giving this course a try. Unlike the grammar-focused 100 and 200 level FREN courses, this class teaches you to engage with and appreciate French literature on its own terms.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. Scott was amazing and I loved taking his honors seminar. The material was very interesting and he led great discussions that made us think more deeply. Would highly recommend this seminar to any freshman honors student.

Professor Scott is an amazing professor. I made a scheduling error that caused me to miss some assignments for class and need to be on an alternate schedule. He was accommodating and fair. I enjoyed his class a lot. He made the material interesting and gave good feedback. It's clear he cares about his students and their success!

Professor Scott is a wonderful professor who is dedicated to helping freshmen get a good start to their college career. He grades very fairly, and assignments are few. Throughout the semester, he has provided us with opportunities to get familiar with resources on campus that help students succeed. I would take his class again and recommend it!!
Great professor who will make you think

Took his Monsters 101 honors seminar & loved it. Highly recommend taking if you have even a mild interest in sci-fi. He's very passionate & encouraged original thinking. Great selection of media analyzed in this class. He has a great sense of humor & his class is a great option for a freshman honors seminar. He gives good feedback on writing.

Paul Scott was the best professor I could've asked for my freshman year. The Sci-Fi class was so much fun, and I made so many friends in the class. The material is intriguing and thought provoking. A wonderful guy and a pleasure to learn from.

This professor is incredibly fun and silly while remaining respectful and decently professional. Our class discussions led by him were incredibly fun and the topics we talked about were all different and interesting.

Honestly cannot speak highly enough of Professor Scott. never even wanted to miss a class, loved our discussions and a lot of the materials. favorite class. our groupme always talked about how amazing he is and how much we appreciate him lol. so thankful for him and learned a lot. lucky to have had him. helped remind me why i continued with french

Fren 177 was a very easy class (as it was also a first year seminar) but Professor Scott made it incredibly interesting and encourages a lot of discussion. I loved the class and hope I have him again.

Bloody love Professor Scott. First, the accent is cool. Second, he is passionate about the text, and knows the text on a very in depth level. And third, cares about his students. Don't pass taking a class with him.

Prof. Scott is an absolutely amazing professor. He makes the content interesting, and his course is very insightful and informative. I also loved that he gets to know his students on an individual level, and is incredibly helpful by offering you feedback on your works. I highly recommend taking his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: This guy is amazing!  He made me excited about french again.  Best professor in the french department.  He is goofy, but also teaches students that all sci-fi had origins in french.  Take a class with him and you will change your minor to a major.  Keep on keeping on Scottie!

Prof. Scott was an incredible professor. He really knows what he is talking about when it comes to French Sci-Fi. The class was very insightful and I found that I learned quite a lot about the subject matter. He is very helpful and he is always willing to hear feedback about how he can improve. I would be happy to have him as my professor again.

I took French Sci-Fi with Prof. Scott, and he wasis hands-down the best French professor at KU. He grades fairly and will really help you. He gives honest feedback, and he's very quick about giving grades back. His lectures are fun, and he's very down to earth, which makes him easy to get along with.

Paul Scott is easily one of the best professors I have had the pleasure of learning from. He is the reason for my love of French and switch to the major. I have taken two classes with him and they were both amazing. He is organized, intelligent, and very amusing. He chooses readingsbooks that are interesting (UNLIKE OTHER CENTURY LIT COURSES)

Prof Scott maintains an insightful and interesting lecture and encourages class discussion. He is more than familiar with the literature covered in the course yet agreeably stirs the intellectual pot by posing new and provocative conjecture. Great reading selections and constructive discourse. Thoroughly enjoyed his class and miss the discussions!!

Professor Scott’s course was very eye-opening, and extremely engaging. Prior to this course, I had little to no interest in 17th century French literature. Professor Scott was always available, and extremely encouraging. If you’re in search of a course to fill a void that you didn’t even know existed, this class is a perfect match.

Professor Scott is a great professor. Highly knowledgeable and highly entertaining. Was always willing to edit a rough draft of a paper, essentially ensuring a good grade if you put in the work. Reading the other reviews, yes he might make some sexual jokes, but they are all relevant considering the sexuality of most works of French literature...

Just really the worst professor I've ever had. Chose the most boring books to read and then didn't explain them. Ambiguous grader who assigns random stuff to fill time and then makes it a huge part of the grade. Awful.

Very poor. I am shocked he has any positive comments because all I've ever heard about him is negative. Self-centered and petty. Spent class talking about self rather than Frn Lit. Learned nothing. Maybe wrote good reviews himself? Seriously, he's awful.

Paul (he insist to be called by Professor Scott)is a guy who is very knowledgeable about the subject in which he teaches. For the most part he is a good teacher. But sometimes he make comments that are very inappropriate and borderline offensive. However, most of the comments are in French so not very many people understand the sexual innuendos!

Professor Scott appears to be a fun-loving, fruity professor on the surface. Wait until he hands back your first paper. Assignments are ambiguous and poorly delineated. No learning of actual French is included as he does all the talking and you do all the listening. And 90% of the time he merely talks about himself and his confused sexual orientati
All I can say is that this guy does the extra mile. He took time to meet with me on many occasions, answered a ton of e-mails, and is just a caring, warm teacher. Thanks PAS!

He is very passionate about his subject and is always willing to offer help and suggestions. He expects a lot but without  being challenging this class would be really boring. The texts are above the difficulty implied with a 410 level class but  it is obvious that he chose them because they are the best books on the subject.

He is among the three worst teachers I have had at KU in the last 3 1/2 years. He expects you to understand VERY complicated french books that only a fluent speaker can read easily, and lectures AT the class, instead of making sure you understand. He turned what is LISTED as a culture class into a high level literature course. AVOID AT ALL COSTS!
He's entertaining. You have to do the reading but as long as you're willing to do the work, you'll learn a lot.
he has a lot of obscure information that is fun, but he can be short tempered sometimes, the class was decently entertaining
Full of energy and enthusiasm. Full of anecdotes. Excentric 2!

Paul is great!  He is so much fun, always bouncing around.  He is a ball of energy and has a fun sense of style.  He seems to love his job and he really tries to get the conversations going.  You stillhave to put in a good effort, but if you want a fun and interesting french class look for him!  I had a wonderful time!  Thanks Paul!

This guy is funny, entertaining and knows his stuff. I enjoyed this class a lot (and did 326 with him last semester), and recommend him to anyone who wants someone who cares. And that's saying nothing about his wild blond hair!

Super nice guy, bad teacher for this specific class. Would read directly from the slides…which just had equations on them. Did not elaborate further. Office hours were helpful. Not a harsh grader, but only after realizing that nobody in the class knew what they were doing due to his questionable teaching. Talk about cats to get on his good side.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: You definitely should read the textbook, attend SI, or do tutoring- something more than notes in lecture. Dr. Peelaers is nice and seems to want to help his students, but he doesn't realize we don't know that much/are vastly less smart than him. Tests seem harder than class examples.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: You get daily worksheets about concepts for points so attendance is sorta mandatory but sorta not if you have a friend who can send them. I think Dr. Peelaers overestimates his students understanding bc the worksheets and tests seem harder than the examples he does in class. He's very nice and wants to help students though.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Not a good class. Take online

This professor only goes over slides and explains concepts in terms of equations. No real world examples, little to no help, and lectures are extremely hard to stay engaged. The class average on the first midterm exam was 28 percent before the curve. I would highly recommend not taking physics with this professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Lectures weren't that engaging but I enjoyed the content and the professor. I describe this class as "physics 1 with differential equations." It is very helpful to know computational methods for the project.

This class tackles topics that are serious, relevant, and at some times very personal. You will get a lot out of this class if you participate and engage with the material. Great professor and great class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I took a freshman seminar: because the course was new it could probably do with some adjusting but was still enjoyable. They were very considerate when I fell behind in work and despite attendance affecting your grade, I still got an A due to good personal relations. If you stay on top of the work and are generally nice/participate you will succeed

Slavic Folklore, honors was a fun class. It is not a tough class, but I still learned a lot about not only slavic folklore but also Slavic culture. Prof. Perelmutter was a great instructor. She communicated very well on Canvas and through e-mail. She also gave very good feedback. She seemed passionate about the course & her students.

Dr. Perelmuter really cared about students. She gave extra credit and allowed you to hand in late assignments with no penalty. She was also super helpful in getting information for your essays or writing assignments..
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I took this class for honors credit and I would say good things about it, I learned a lot, it was challenging but still easy to get an A, super interesting. I would take this if you need honors credit!

I really enjoyed SLAV148 online! I took it without many expectations but it ended up being one of my favorite courses. Perelmutter gave awesome feedback and the assignments felt both worthwhile and interesting
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Took Discourse & Identity. Renee is helpful & encouraging, class is accessible. Work load seemed relatively light: read/discuss, reflection papers, & a short research paper. Content perhaps leans more towards linguistics than my personal preference. Seems to produce important work in their field and has familiarity with the topics they teach.

She's an amazing human being. One of the best professors I've ever had. One of the most interesting classes I've ever taken. If you have the option, take her class. I'm in LING 338, Languages of the Jews. This is a new class, which is why ratemyprof doesn't have it yet.

This was a fabulous class, I learned a lot. I originally took it for an easy A but I ended up liking it. Because it is a shortened class you really need to stay on top of everything. If you do the work by the deadlines you should be able to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Awesome professor who really wants her students to succeed. I highly recommend her.

The lectures were incredibly boring, I would always just fall asleep. There's a lot of homework, and by that I mean A LOT. Good thing is as long as you do homework the exams should be easy peasy for you and they are much easier than hw's. Be aware that in order to pass with an A in his class you need a score of 93 or above
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Hard class and unforgiving grading system
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: i actually think petr is a decent lecturer and a good guy, but his classes are structured in such a way that makes them very challenging. although I got an A, I had to work very hard to get it. if you want to succeed in this class, you will need to pay attention and actually learn the material, sometimes on your own time. don't cheat or use AI.

The lectures are unbearably dull, so monotonous that I stopped attending altogether. If you enjoy filling in blanks, you'll love it. Everyone I know in that class agrees: skip the lecture and read the textbook instead. It's far easier to teach yourself than to learn from him.

He understands how to teach a difficult topic. Ill admit his lectures a bit boring but full of content. I like how he takes feedback from students and improves the course (recently made exams MC and theyre reasonable) but the grading scale is really rough: 90% for 3 exams, 10% 14 homeworks. Homework and textbook helped me learn. Overall satisfied.
He is genuinely one of the worst professors ever. Not a very understanding guy and doesn't teach the content well. All I can say is good luck

Dr. Petr is a rigorous professor that gives in-depth lectures with ample hw question examples that he walks through during class. If you attend class, take notes, do the hw on time, and review before exams you should definitely succeed in 461.

He was an okay lecturer, but it really just felt like he was reading the book at us. 

The notes are fill in the blank and not available on Canvas, so you have to go to class if you want hints of proofs that might be on the test.

If you have to email him or talk to him for anything he can be kind of rude and blunt, he also is a terrible emailer.

Long boring lectures that do not teach the content well as he uses complicated examples and the lectures go over so much content that his notes have to be fill in the blank to keep up. Very hard tests so be prepared to study more than you ever have before and not give attention to your other classes. Professor is not good

Petr might be the most boring lecturer I have ever listened to. He never posts lecture slides and has fill in the blank lecture notes, which make you feel like a toddler just filling them out. I stopped going to lecture and did better on the last exams from reading the textbook. I would probably enjoy a beer with him over going to his lectures.
Great professor. If you actually attend class and do the work, you should easily succeed.

He is super lecture heavy and he teaches completely by the book, which for some people isn't that bad, but it can make it incredibly difficult to follow. He can explain it well if you ask good questions, but it still can be very confusing. Also our class didn't get quizzes so the tests were worth a LOT of our grade. Decently leniency on grading.

Attendance is required for submitting homework and quizzes. Quizzes follow the book closely/ Homework grading is weird since not all are graded. Expect to teach yourself as the professor mainly rewrites the book. Choose a good seat because he uses a whiteboard and notes aren't posted. The textbook can be confusing.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Kind of baffled at the reviews. Homeworks are much harder than the exams. Don't cheat on the homeworks, and the tests are very straightforward. None of the math problems that he gives us on the exams are difficult to solve -- they're very dependent on the concepts. People love complaining instead of doing the work.

Petr is a fantastic professor but he is difficult. EECS 461 is a Stats course and generally most people just scrape by - therefore thinking the class is too hard or Petr is bad. If you want to do well - you have to put in the effort, but Petr gives you the resources to succeed. You can't miss any lecture/HW but if you show up you'll do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Y'all tripping so hard, if you did the homework the exams were much easier. A lot of people just cheated on them and got destroyed. What you expect? Quizzes were taken directly from the book and he told you which ones to study for each quiz AND if you didn't get it, 2 of your lowest were dropped. Quit playing round you bums KU is light work too.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Stats is hard and none of the lectures were online so you HAVE to take notes and read the text. However, he's good at teaching the material: you will actually learn it. Everyone who gives a one is just salty because the class isn't an easy A (also only three people showed up to the discussion sections regularly...). Do the work and you'll survive.

Decent guy. Lectures are boring and long. He just rewrites the book. Nothing is posted on canvas to aid study. There's a quiz every week from a pool of quizzes in the book, anywhere from 5-10 quizzes. They're not easy, so it's basically like studying for a mini test every week. Sometimes over topics we haven't yet covered. Tests are painful. :(

First class I've taken where I went to class and took notes 100% of the time but was still completely lost. No help outside of class, might as well have only read the textbook because the lectures are the EXACT same. Also for some reason refuses to use capitalization when writing emails or announcements to students.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor does not know the concepts. He wasted 2 hours of our time as students during finals week to "Review" for his final while he fumbled around with 2 problems. No notes posted and NO EXAMPLES, Just him rewriting the books theorems on the boards. Attendance required or you will fail though even though attending teaches you very little.

Petr hosted a 2 hr review session 2 days before the final, and it was an absolute joke. He spent the first hour writing theorems which stemmed off 1 basic question someone asked. The next hour was spent of Petr trying to solve a simple example problem someone gave him. He kept messing it up, and ended up using his notes to finally solve it.

Professor Petr is very old school. You will have one homework and quiz per week, quizzes have a huge impact on your grade. Most of the content comes from the textbook, but when he feels like it he will cover content outside of the textbook in lecture. Go to class, do the homework and you should survive.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor cares about students and teachers the course very well.

This was just a 1 credit hour introduction class, so the grade is pass/fail based on showing up and a handful of assignments. Dr. Petr was always careful to ensure that grading criteria was clear, and sent out many reminders to keep us on task. He is easy to contact outside of class if need be.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Very good lectures and very helpful. He is willing to work with you to help you out. The only problem I have with him is that his tests are harder than anything he does. His "practice tests" and homework are harder than the actual exams. In the exams he mixes material together into a way that you haven't done before. So study hard for tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Petr is a great circuits instructor.. Homework was similar to exams, but sometimes he wrote his own problems (as opposed to book probs), and they were hard to understand what it was asking. Quizzes were tricky, and could easily be the deciding point on whether you get an A, B or C. He provided curves on exams, as they were usually pretty tough.

Professor Petr is a nice and caring man, but unfortunately as an instructor the lectures consist of mainly copying lecture notes that are regurgitated at a fast pace. The in class examples do not compare to the homework which causes difficulties. The lecture is almost not worth attending for info, you may be better off just reading the book.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This professor Dr. Petr is the only professor at EECS who is not sexist.
He is the best teacher I've ever seen. Grade him good! His lectures are beautiful. His behaviors are not sexist at all.
Self taught self learn class, professor is not a good instructor, 55% of grade is based on 3 exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Much of what he teaches is not in the book or online, so you have to try to understand hismind-numbing and poorly explainedlectures. Attendance is also forced via homework and quizzes. Regarding assignments, they take too long and are much more complicated than what is taught in lecture. All in all, this is the worst class I have ever taken.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Only had an introductory class with him but he was friendly and helpful.

Dr. Petr is the best EECS professor I have ever had. His class was not easy by any means, but he is extremely clear and thorough with the material and the grading is fair. Nothing was ever a surprise on any test. He will even tell you when a homework assignment was going to take more work than usual.

You will not pass the class if you don't go to the lectures. He's a very easy test grader though and gives a lot of partial credit for answers. You probably won't use the textbook for anything but homework though.
Prof. Petr is a very structured lecturer, and is very clear in what he expects. His clarity makes the subject matter easy to understand and straight-forward.

Professor Petr's lecture is very straight forward. He is very organized in his notes and follows the book pretty good, for the most part. To get an A in the class, you need to put forth effort. He has homework due every week, with a help session that a supplemental instructor teaches. You basically due you homework in there and quizzes once a week!

Yes, he is a hard teacher, but you will learn in his class. The homework can be hard and frustrating, but its do-able. Overall, Professor Petr is a good guy. If you don't have a TI-89 calculator, you might want to get one for this class.
Hard teacher. All the homework comes from the book. He's hardcore that you read the book! Wants you to understand everything about the subject. Lectures are pretty organized.

great teacher overall. hw assignments are long and frustrating sometimes. tests are fair but he likes to be a little tricky. this class could probably be easy but prof.petr makes it a bit more difficult than it probably needs to be.

One of the best teachers I've had. Notes are extremely well laid out and he takes an interest in his students. You really do have to go to class or you will get behind. Homework assignments are long but are relevant to the tests. Take this class if you know how to study.
Extremely helpful, methodical, fair and knowledgable. Cares a lot about students and his research assistants. He is the best teacher I ever had!
I dropped the class because I was taking 22 credit hours. He is still an awesome professor though.

Material is difficult but he is a very good teacher.  Gives the most organized lectures of any professor I've had yet, which makes it somewhat easier.  Homework assignments are ridiculously long, but they do help prepare you for the tests, which can be somewhat difficult.
Spectacular Teacher
No Comments

His homework assignments are incredibly long and his tests are pretty hard, but he really knows his stuff and is a good teacher.  He's also very organized, which makes taking notes easy in his classes.
Good instructor and very well organized in class. Beware of the final.

Excellent lecture. Homework assignments were straightforward. Very cool demonstrations. If you put effort into his class, you will learn what you need to know. Make sure to do all of the practice problems and read the book.

Excellent teaching skills. Very organized. But beware of the grading. Very partial to his research assistants. You might want to be disconnected from him in any way other than class sessions to get an impartial grade.

Pushes you to work hard, long homeworks, very fair in terms of grades, cares alot about students, teaches you everything in a clear and organized way, very respectful and serious in class. You will be very happy and satisfied with your grade.

Turn in your assignments, go to class regularly, and participate: that's all it takes to get an A+ in the class. Ben is a really funny, nice guy. I highly recommend him if you want  an interesting but relaxing class.
Ben is an awesome teacher! He is funny and really smart. I really enjoyed the in-class discussions and I never wanted to miss class. If you need to take a good English course go with Ben!

He is the most amazing and interesting and friendly professor i have seen at KU. You will never be bored in his class, and he always gives out a lot of extra credit and is very very understanding. Best professor i have had so far!
Great teacher, really funny.  Doesn't take a lot of grades and class is mostly discussions about stories.
He is extremely helpful, nice, and passionate about his job. His expectations are high, but as long as you communicate with him, you will be just fine. He has a lot to offer academically.
Really helpful professor
Ben is awesome! He's a pretty funny guy and gives his students a lot of helpful feedback on papers. Class is really laid back, and most of the time we get out early.
No Comments
If someone could make a 10 minute class seem like a week, she wins the award.
Very easy grader and willing to help you if you have any questions.
Too strict on participation for a 1 credit class.
She is just not a nice person and takes her 1 credit hour class wayyyy to seriously
not it,

This class was a very easy A, the readings are almost optional because nobody wanted to grade that hard. I put in C level effort and got back an A, if anything just appreciate the simplicity of the class.

This class is really easy. You get five absences from lecture and attendance to the discussion section doesn't seem mandatory. There are no tests, just a few writings which are simple to complete. He gives away books during lecture, and while the lectures can be hard to follow it's clear he cares about his students.

A ridiculous amount of reading for very little points or results. I cannot stand professors who treat their 100 level class like its some advanced place for learning. Maybe these old professors should catch up with the times and realize that no student wants to be reading 35 pages for a 5 question quiz. You will learn absolutely nothing in lecture.
Take the honors version of this class it's way easier. no quizzes or essays. so easy. he gives out free books too.

Ray Pence is a pretty good professor. Although, I didn't like all of the readings we had to do for the class. The lectures were fine but not thrilling at all, just him going over slides. He is a pretty tough grader I will have to say though, and there is only a few assignments so that makes it hard if you don't write enough on assignments.

I took an online AMS/SOC class from him and found the readings to be totally relevant to the material and what he was asking. There is a lot of reading, but it isn't overwhelming and it's dotted with videos and documentaries to help. You do need to have done the readings, but if you present clear arguments, you'll get a good grade.

Dr. Pence was by far my favorite teacher freshman year. He has a nice personality and grades fairly generously, but does assign a lot of reading. It isn't too time consuming, maybe an hour or two a week, but nonetheless, you have to know the material. He tends to go off on tangents and can be a strange one, but is a good guy with fairly easy hw.

Not a difficult class, but went through the entire thing in bewilderment- the syllabus changed every week making it impossible to plan ahead. Lectures tended to head in odd directions and were very dry. The essay prompts are entirely unclear. Do not recommend unless the professor can create a better sense of direction.
Pence is one of the worst professors I've had. He caters to students without drive and lets decent students fall through the cracks. Very frustrating and completely unhelpful.

This was the most interesting course I have ever taken. A lot of the material was tough, and Dr. Pence grades papers harshly, but then at the end of the year he offers many opportunities to boost your grade to an A. He's tough, but he understands he's tough and really relates to the students. Recommend taking AMS.
Wow, this class was unreasonably difficult. He grades papers very hard, but nothing else. Be prepared to do a ton of writing. My lowest level class and it gave me the most problems, weird.
The class if pretty difficult, but you get out what you put in. Definitely one of the best classes I've ever taken.

He wasn't the easiest teacher I've had, but the work I put into the class was well worth it. He's pretty easy going, just always remember to bring your book to class and be ready to discuss. The class content was informative and interesting. I highly suggest this class to any SOC or AMS major.

Dr. Pence is a solid professor- he's well spoken, polite, and articulate- however, the class could get really boring at times. The class is pretty easy, and at times really interesting, although some of the reading can get a bit dry. Quizzes in nearly every discussion session, midterm/final, and two short papers were assigned throughout the course.

Incredibly frustrating professor. Somewhat helpful during office hours, but not at all in class. Easy class to just float in and not learn anything. He's a weird one. I sincerely wish I had dropped the class with a "W" than stuck it out just for the sake of how frustrating he is.

He chooses interesting readings and the load isn't onerous. We wrote 5 essays on the semester and there was pretty much no other homework. He grades your body of work at the end of the year instead of assigning grades for specific papers. Just talk in class and he will probably like you, which helps to get an A.

I think DR.Ray was great professor beacuse he teaches you in an easy way and he tried so hard to let us understand the matrial.I don't think his class was boring, he was funny!!I RECOMMEND TAKING ONE OF HIS CLASSES REALLY ENJOYABLE CLASSES. YOU HAVE TO WORK HARD THOUGH. :)

He's a good helpful prof., I didn't read all of the readings, but I had to study for the exam, he was so helpful in all 3 assignment. I didn't get A in all of them and I only had the syllabus extra cridet. I thout it will be harder. I got an A on it. Good luck for all and hope u enjoy it. :)

Dr. Pence was solid. His lectures were a tad boring but he was a nice guy and cracked some jokes. He knows and understands the subject. I'd take another class taught by him. He's really smart and the class wasn't too difficult or overbearing.
Clear on his objectives and doesn't try to trick you on his exams.
This professor always presented interesting topics! Some of the issues were touchy subjects, but the way he presents is neutral. His lectures can drag a little but the readings were fascinating.
Dr.Pence is a good prof. though I admit his lecture could be a bit lively. But this guy knows tons  of stuff! I recommend you visit his office and talk in person. he is quite a nice guy and helpful.
This guy gets creamed constantly because he is a hard professor... but if your a bright child this class will be a joy to take... hes what got me into American studies

Dr Pence was at first a weird guy, but as the class went on I got used to him and the topics were interesting. However, I feel like he doesnt present the material very well, so you just have to read the book like CRAZY.. I had Will Bishop as my TA, and he was super nice. And DO THE EXC!! that saved my life. This course is decent, just have to study

Pence was a really good teacher. He always wanted to help students and he made really good study guides that followed the tests accurately. You need to turn in notecards to class everyday but they take two minutes if that. He's pretty liberal and if you hate that, it doesn't matter because he does a good job of respecting viewpoints. I got an A.

Outside of the extra credit (which if you don't do, good luck), this class would have screwed me over. No help from anyone, took days to get a response, and the exams did not cover what was on the study guides. Not the worst teacher on KU, but certainly one of the Top 10 worst

I ended up getting an A, but I had the world's worst TA for this class.  The worse part was that Pence defended her when he knew she was wrong.  Pence cares about his students, but he seems to worry about taking care of himself first.
Easy class if you attend. Notecards due every class for attendance, but you can still miss a few classes and get a decent grade. Tests are pretty easy if you listen to lectures.
The guy seems like a decently nice person, but his ability to identify main ideas is just not up to snuff. He asks the most ridiculous questions on his tests that I've ever seen.

This is a hard class, no winging it. Reading and notecards for every class. Not helpful. Tests are extremely hard and never seem to relate to the study guides. Good luck if you take it.. I only went because Sasha Kaun was there :)
Pence is a good prof.  If you think you can wing this class you're in for a surprise.  Reading is moderate, but you have to read to well on the test.  Overall it was enjoyable.

Dr. Pence is a great teacher.  He really wants you to do well and wants you to learn.  You must do the readings to know what is going on.  There are 3 tests, a paper, points for attendence, and points for discussion.  He also gives extra credit which really helps if you do it.  If you do the work, you will do great in the class.

I took this class to fulfill a humanities credit, and I do not recommend that anybody do this. If you like sociology, then you might like this class. Not a bad teacher; a lot of reading involved and make sure to do the optional study guides b/c they come in handy for studying. Offered lots of extra credit opportunities and even curved final grade.

WORST TEACHER EVER!!!Absoulutley worst teacher and class i have taken in four years, the university should fire him,the tests are ridiculous, studying is useless, his lectures are basically liberal anti-american propaganda and none of it flows or makes sense! Boy do i wish i went to this site before enrolling..spare yourself dont do it!

one of my favorite teachers and people ever!  the topics are always interesting and he keeps things moving with videos, current events, etc.  i recommended ray's class to my friends and they all loved it too.
Ray has high standards for himself and his students.  Super-smart, always helpful, and challenging but down-to-earth.  If you're a slacker and a whiner you won't like him or his class.

Except for few occasions, he was generally clear in his lectures.  Considering the fact that he is dealing with few hundred people  in a big classroom, the quality of his lectures was not as bad as other people would think.
HORRIBLE teacher -- incompetent, disorganized, boring, repetitive.  Impossible to muster respect for his authority.  Avoid at all costs.
His expectation is high for the intro class, but you can learn a lot from this class. He really cares about students--You should visit his office and talk to him!

Truly the worst teacher I have had in my college career to this point... His lessons had no flow whatsoever, he took drinks from his water glass in mid-sentence, and would call people out all the time in class for being off task.  I think the school should have to pay me my money back after this class.  I learned absolutely nothing...
Final is BRUTAL.  Class average was a low C

I am upset with how much money i am paying to have this guy "teach" my class.  I learned nothing and he was very pretentious and unprepared for class.  He needs to realize that this is an intro level class.  Lastly, he's looks like a major creep-o w/ his pony tail.

Very difficult teacher, but he's not a bad guy.  He makes you write a notecard every class, and randomly calls on you to see if you were there for attendance, so that's no good.  I'd rate him a C+.  I wouldn't recommend it, but there are worse professors out there.

This guy is so boring.  I have 3 friends that sit beside me, and they all fall alseep.  His tests are VERY hard.  If you can not comprehend literature at a very high level, I would suggest not taking this class unless it is a must.  Last test average was 70%...I was luckily above average.  Good luck.

My friends and I enjoy making fun of Ray all the time about his awkwardness and no toleration policy of newspapers.  His class was so bad last year that the university sent an apology letter to the students of ams110... that's pretty sad if you ask me
At the beginning the first test was so hard he curved it by 15% but he made the final much easier. Make sure you read everything and try to go to class...he is very boring and rude though.
Ray is one of those teachers who really cares about education. Don't take his class if you don't want to work hard. (My girlfriend thought he was hot, though)

His test are ambigious, so it doesnt reward you for learning the material and studying. The material is dry. He is open for public scrutiny but refuses to actually acknowledge it. If that makes sense.
He is psychotic, and enjoys public scrutiny. The only thing you need to do for an A-> don't bring a newspaper to class!

Your gpa WILL fall. He will not give you an A on any essay. He will not give you a 100% an ANY assignment. Asking for help will not do anything. Seems like a good guy but this experience was stressful all the way. If you take his advice to improve your essays, you may end up with a lower grade.

Do not take his class at all costs. I had to withdraw from the class to save my GPA as a usually straight A student. His lectures and paper guidelines are so convoluted that you have no idea what he's talking about or what he expects from you. He is so dismissive and unwilling to bring your grade up that it's almost impossible to do well.
