reviews.comment: Technically took ENGL 314 but there was no option so I'm just prefacing it here. Wedge is a great guy who loves to crack jokes in class but he is a HORRIBLE grader. Class average of Cs and barely adjusts the curve. I'm saying this as a straight A student usually: he does not grade fairly nor appropriately. His classes will absolutely tank your GPA.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment:
The reviews aren't lying. Even if you think you are good at hard classes, you're not exempt

Absurd grader. 3 essays are 50% of grade, which is fine, but most of his grading is procedural nitpicking or entirely unpredictable qualms that are not addressed in assignment prompts.

Don't take ever, not worth it, 8 weeks of frustration.

Without a doubt, the most difficult 200 level course I have ever taken. I took it for an elective expecting to get a good grade, just to come to find out how tough of a grader this professor is. Getting a C on an essay in his class is about equivalent to an A+ in any other english class. I would not recommend taking under any circumstances.

Professor Wedge takes the fun out of writing. He overanalyzes essays and goes against traditional writing rules (States you can write however you want in class). He is a tough grader, an A in another class is a C+ at best in his class. He seems to grade easier though if you participate and show you're interested in improving your writing.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: (Half sem class) A lot of reading and writing. expect to read about 7 novels in half a sem. tough grader. should not be this hard for a 200 level course. grades essays with minimal input and no direction. Wasn't willing to give more than a B- sometimes B on essays. better off taking this class with literally anyone else at KU
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Do NOT take his class. Try to get any other english professor at KU. He is a horrible grader and is not willing to give out anything better than a B- on essays. He is very condescending and tends to pick on his students in class. I would never take his class EVER again.

I would never take this class again simply because of the professor's attitude. Was so disrespectful and told me plainly, "It doesn't matter how much effort you put into a paper, if it's not good you're getting a C." Has so much unnecessary work and you are expected to read a whole book and write an essay every week. Would not recommend him at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I have never had a professor less willing to give an A. The best essay I wrote, according to him, was my first one. Every single one got progressively worse, even though I was taking his advice. I saw him about an essay and made all of the corrections he suggested and I got a C-. His lectures dont focus on writing, even though thats whats graded

reviews.comment: Super sweet teacher and I respect him as a person. The homework was super easy, but the test and essays were rough. After my first essay grade, a C, I went to his office hours to get help on my second essay. He gave me some things to fix and I was under the impression that I was on the right track, but I still got another C.

reviews.comment: The man himself is sweet and endearing, but his teaching skills are rough. I recieved extremely harsh grading comments on essays, so I brought it to his attention as well as the good ole "assign paper but provide no in class guidance or peer review". I stated that I personally did not learn that way and his response was basically tough love.

reviews.comment: AVOID AT ALL COSTS! Ridiculous amount of reading (not diverse) V hard grader. CRAZY EXPECTATIONS FOR YOUR WRITING. Would show UNDERGRADS examples of work from people w/ MASTERS! reviews.comment: Alee was a great and knowledgeable professor. Just go to lectures and lab and it should be a pretty easy class.

reviews.comment: Gave extra credit opportunities, but SI's are needed if you want an A
She's nice but the class isn't an easy A you got work for it.
Acct 200 is hard but it is not hard because of Alee. Huge lecture and she teaches just fine. Really depends how good of a TA you get. Lab matters a lot

Alee was a great professor for accounting, she is always willing to answer questions during lectures and clearly wants her student to succeed. Her lectures are easy to follow and made the material very digestible.
Loved her!

Alee was amazing! She does not want a single student to fail in her class and makes sure we all succeed for the future. I highly recommend taking this class even if you are not looking at a future career in accounting.

Alee was amazing!! She genuinely cares for all her students and does a great job trying to get people participating in lecture. She takes her time to answer all questions. She picked amazing TA's who were all very helpful. Take advantage of the help room and SI sessions.

Alee and the whole ACCT200 team is so amazing. Alee made lecture show that accounting is not boring and she made me want to come to lecture. The course really shines with the TAs. Every TA that she has is the perfect role model for any B-school student, highly recommend building a relationship with your TA.
Alee really knows her stuff.  She cares about students and wants them to succeed.  SI sessions are really helpful for extra practice, especially close to exams.

Alee is the goat. She cares about her students a lot. I wouldn't have wanted to take this class under anyone else. 410 is tough at times but with her if you study you will be fine. Unlike 320 however, quizzes are pretty much daily. Make sure to do High Level Notes specifically for those or your quiz grade might dig you into a hole.

Alee really respects her students giving them a sense of belonging and helpful nature in her lectures. She hires teaching assistants that are the spitting image of her and how she wants the class to be taught. While she is tough, it is only because she wants you to succeed. I would definitely recommend her as your instructor if you have the chance!
I loved having Alee as my professor. You could tell that she had a huge passion for both teaching and for accounting. She made me want to come to lecture everyday.

Alee is super knowledgeable about accounting. I enjoyed the way the class was set up and liked her lectures. It's a lot of information at once, but the TA helps to break it down further. Brings in alumni to speak to students, stays to the schedule, and is super organized. Highly recommend
Alee Phillips was good. She was very direct and gave great lectures. Only issue being her over use of abbreviation and scheduling issues. She was good and I would recommend taking her class

Alee is a wonderful professor and challenges you to think at a high level on accounting topics. Take notes when watching the videos since the quizzes are a little tricky. I learned a lot from the interviews with accounting professionals.

Most of the accounting material Alee goes over seems overwhelming in lecture, but she selects talented TAs who do a great job of helping you outside of class. More than anything, Alee is a great resource. If you reach out to her, she will go above and beyond for you.

There is some group projects but they are easy. Accounting is not hard if you show up, but if you miss a class the TAs can not give you notes on what you missed. Be prepared to have friends in the class to get notes on missed lectures. Outside tutoring was so helpful, show up to SI sessions and you will be good. Alee was funny and a good professor.

Alee and the ACCT200 team are amazing. The TAs are awesome and care about their students. Alee gives good lectures and you can tell she really wants her students to be successful. Make sure you show up to help room, stay on top of your homework and get extra help and you will be great in 200. It's a tough course but Alee and the TAs make it great

Alee is a great lecturer and person. Her lectures are straightforward & she will emphasize the key takeaways from each page in the course packet. Try to understand the material on a *conceptual* level--exams have lots of conceptual questions & the FRQs are not similar to the exam reviews. Don't just memorize how to do problems mechanically.
Alee is fantastic and really cares about her students. Show up to lecture and do the homework and this class will be great.
Alee Philips is goated. Study the course packet

She really wants her students to succeed. Attend all the lectures, do all the extra credit, and spend a good amount of time outside of class on the material, and you should be good. Not an easy class to get an A in unless you really put in the work. She really is caring though and is willing to help.
Pretty engaging, very professional, lectures went pretty fast but got a bit repetitive--always the same format.

This is a typical 1 credit class that is fairly simple, videos and quiz once a week on Sunday. One paper at the end of the semester. She is a great professor and person that is easy to reach and always willing to help. I've met with her outside of class to discuss my accounting degree reqs and she has done so much for me. Easily one of the best.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Alee is absolutely wonderful. Her class was straightforward and taught the relevant information in an easy to follow format. I really appreciate how she gives reminders and sets clear expectations. Additionally, she is very personable and when you speak to her outside of class and genuinely cares about students. Definitely take a class with her!
discussions are the key to understanding the material. was a chore, but required. she is a good instructor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Definitely a weed-out class. So if you're not an accounting major this class will feel like a chore. She reminds students about the many resources to use if they need help. Lectures are boring and aren't recorded so if you are gone for a class, you have to ask someone for notes. Did not learn much from lectures, but labs were the most helpful.

Alee is such a great teacher. Even though the lecture at times can be long, she always is entertaining. She really makes sure that there is resources to help you understand the material if you do not understand it.

Alee was a really good professor that really cared to make her succeed. It was really a tough course, ACCT 200 is seen as the weed out class for the b school, but it is such a good class to take.IF you pay attention, the labs are super helpful as well as the TA's. Go to help room, do the activities, and look over everything and you will be fine

Accounting was my favorite class that semester and I truly enjoyed learning the content and going to class. Lectures and labs get a little long and tedious but you will gain so much knowledge in a short amount of time. She will only teach what you need to know, she is straight to the point, and reiterates the information to help students remember.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: One of the best professors at KU. Cares about her students success and teaches in a way that is engaging and informative. Not the easiest class but do your homework and you will be fine. Handled COVID protocols better than any other professor I had by adapting her teaching so you could actually learn. Great person and great professor!

This class is basically an interview with accounting professionals and alee is a good moderator. The class is graded on attendance and 2 papers, so show up and turn in the papers on time. Alee is a good mentor and is there for students if they need help.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: 410 is not an easy class, it requires a lot of academic responsibility. A lot like 320 structure wise, 3 tests, hw due almost every class, lots of quizzes (hers are extremely hard compared to 320). She is an amazing professor and wants you to succeed but she can't study for you. I don't know how people get an A in this class but it's also a hard B

On your first day, Alee will intimidate you. Alee's ACCT 320 will likely be one of the hardest classes you've taken. You'll fail quizzes. If you learn to correct what you did wrong you will pass the exams. Trust her advice, she won't steer you wrong if you need help. She provides excellent feedback and will help you succeed if you stick with it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Alee is very open and helpful. The class is difficult and requires a lot of outside class work. It's the content that makes this class hard, but Alee is very helpful and teaches very well.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Alee is a great teacher who knows her stuff. Accounting can be a dull topic but she tries to make it interesting with real life examples. The test are hard, and the first one is always bad, but you learn as you go and they get easier once you learn the style. Make flashcards, study the course packet, and you'll be fine.

Alee was super nice but the class was very tough. The only difference between honors and regular was the addition of a few easy projects. 320323 might possibly be the hardest acct class at KU. She and Kelvie teach the exact same course but personally I think Alee is a better teacher.
Tough teacher, but you learn a lot. If you just study (but I mean really study and understand what you're studying) the course packet she provides, you'll be fine.
She is too much.
Very enthusiastic teacher. Keeps you engaged and makes class very interesting. Clear and knowledgeable. I highly recommend this teacher

Challenging class but Alee is an awesome teacher, you learn a ton.  There is a quiz every class so you can't really miss classes, as well as 1 or 2 homework assignments due almost every class. The tests are difficult, but the grading scale works so that you can do pretty awful on the tests and still come out okay in the class.

Great teacher, kept me awake, very easy to follow along with notes and fill in as you go. I feel like I actually learned quite a bit and received an A. Quizzes can be tough if you don't review the material before class but there are plenty of spare points so you'll be fine.

In the words of Alee Phillips, "This is not ACCT 320!" Indeed she was correct. The material isn't inherently difficult, but you must work hard if you expect to get a good great. There are a lot of easy points (i.e. quizzes, hw ect.) She does curve the class "slightly" which is awesome. The test are not terrible, but the multiple choice will get you

Alee is a great teacher especially considering how dry the material can get.  She is very helpful and responds quickly to emails.  Do not take the homework and quiz points lightly because you can do well in the class without doing well on the exams.  And the exams are extremely painful.  Detail is important on exams.  But she's attractive and cool.

Alee taught this Fall class with Prof Mason and they were both great. Attendance is mandatory as well as paying attention in class because the TA circles the room like a vulture.  The readings can be boring but the quizzes are easy. They are easy on the grading of the paper too and you get points for just turning in the other assignments.

If you do all the hw(which you get extra credit just for doing ALL of the hw), these classes (320 & 410) are a cake-walk. She sets it up so you can get a low C on every exam and get an A in the class. Her MC on exams are tough, but there are always 2/4 answers that are easy to rule out. Super hot, too. Just sayin'.
Decent class for finance majors, more thorough understanding of financial statements, and Alee is smokin' hot - you'll never miss class due to this final point alone.
Definately makes sure the theory makes sense so you understand why things are done the way they are.

You will have to go to class and take notes if you want to pass. It is not an easy class, so don't save it till your last semester. Try to take it just after you took the first couple of acct'ing classes. Study your ass off for her tests...

Very clear, structured class. If you stick to her system of note taking in the packet and actually do the homework, the class is very manageable. Alee herself is very wiling to help if you have any problems.
Tests make you hate life. (but you will learn the material).

I cannot stress enough that you need to fully understand the notes for an exam. The problems should be easy if you understand acct at all; the MC will bite you in the ass if you don't understand it. DO THE HOMEWORK and you will do fine. I did horrible on quizzes and the first exam (74%) and still got an A

Had her for 320 and 410, she is nice and is very willing to help you. The tests are extremely hard though. Her class is setup where 60% is test points/40% other (hw, quiz etc). The 40% is very easy so just do okay on the tests and a B is doable.
Alee is here to destroy you. She is a nice woman, but the real reason for her tests is to depopulate the world. Her tests are meant to encourage students to kill themselves.

She is a really nice lady but she just isnt that great of a teacher. She will ask things on homework that we dont cover in class and its accounting so you cant just make stuff up, your supposed to follow rules.

I found this class to be very difficult. I am not particularly good at accounting and the tests in this class proved to be very difficult. The material was not particularly hard but the way questions were asked was what made them difficult. If you take this class make sure you get all of the points possible on homework/WSJ to provide a buffer.
Exams can be tough, but she offers a lot of easy points to redeem yourself. If you look over the chapters/homework problems a few days in advance, you're good to go on exam days.

I do not recommend this proff at all.. horrible.. esp on a test day. Even though you will do fine in all other parts of the class, her tests are made to kill your grades and i mean it when i say this, if you still dont believe this, go ahead take her class and experience it.
Very easy class! Attend each class, put your phone away and listen to the lectures and get a lot of useful information. Homework assignments are very easy should walk away with 100% with ease.

Her class is'nt bad at all, but come test day she has no heart. She must make her tests to hurt grades. She offers alot of points in other areas so hopefully that will help, but I would not recommend her to anyone.
No Comments

I also took 410 with her.  She is an awesome teacher and really works to help you learn the material, not just memorize facts!  I would completely recommend her to anyone wanting to learn accounting, if this is an ABE, you may want to pick a different course!

Great teacher!!!  Very helpful and explains everything very easily.   I would DEFINITELY recommend.  Only bad thing I have to say is her tests are kind of difficult, but she gives you so many other opportunities to do well so it shouldn't matter.
Pretty tough and fast-paced, but thorough. I wouldn't recommend this as an ABE--take something else if that's what you need.

I thought she was really hard... her tests were impossible.  She's a nice person, but I've heard there are much easier professors for Financial II.

Very difficult course.  Don't take it unless you are interested in accounting!  She goes through the material very fast and sometimes gets confused and messes up.  The tests are very hard.  Do all of the homework and do well on the quizes and you will be ok in the class.
Everybody likes her. Explains clearly, teaches only the most important and useful stuff (although there are still a lot...)
good teacher. worth taking the class just to look at her :) really, does a good job with the material
Excellent teacher--hard tests, but I would definately recommend her.
great teacher.

His HSES 372 class was pointless to go to as all he did in class was go over the powerpoints and not explain anything further. All tests and quizzes were online and easy to find the answers. Easy class but did not really learn anything.

I've never had a more boring and monotone professor.  I gained nothing from his lectures.  Everything on tests was from the book - which he didn't even reference to - you just had to figure it out yourself. I also can't get an email back from him, and it has been over a month.

Lectures weren't the most exciting, but I did enjoy this class! Your grade is entirely off of quizzes and three exams, so every point counts. Overall no complaints, I found the class material interesting and it wasn't at all demanding of my time. A nice break in my super busy courseload. Take Gallagher for Ex. Phys if possible!!

reviews.comment: The whole class is tests and quizzes, no other grades. Attendance is not mandatory. The way he lectures is basically reading the facts straight off the slides so it was not much help. Very monotone and hard to listen to.

Crying cause I have to have him for another course at KU. Went to him for help and his advice was "if you're struggling that much just drop the class" LIKE NO. not spending another grand to retake a class you should be better at teaching. absolutely hate his class, his teaching method, and just everything!

reviews.comment: Great Class Hot Professor
Hes a pretty good teacher. Not the easiest grader but its easy to get along with and is readly to help with whatever you need.
Great teacher

Dr. P is probably one of the best professors I've ever had at KU. He truly cares about the success of his students and will do just about anything to help you succeed. He met with me multiple times outside of office hours, even if he was busy. He always has a kind thing to say. His class is hard, but he does his best to help! Best professor ever.

He's great! Just complete the readings, go to class for quizzes on random days which he offers extra credit on all 9 quizzes and you can drop 2. He has 3 exams & weights them so your best exam is worth the most. He is really nice & offers lots of help for you to really learn the material. He has pretty interesting lectures too, even got $ once!

Course content... not exactly my first choice or idea of enjoyable. However, Dr. Pleskac makes it easy to listen and is just an all around good person. He is funny and seems to really care about his students.

Dr. Tim Pleskac is a real gem. He is a great teacher and person. However, if you take Judgement & Decision Making, be prepared to do pretty bad. This is a psychology class but really has nothing to do with Psychology and has turned into more of an economic and ethics class. Be prepared. Extremely hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Pinkston is a pretty chill professor and so was this class. He gives extra credit and mostly everything is completed in class except for studying for the exams which were very easy if you listened to lectures. He really cares about this subject and also really appreciates student feedback.

He is a very good professor and he allows for multiple opportunities for students to get credit back. He also cares to speak to students after class. I'd stay and ask him questions about the material and he was always open to conversation.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This is a great, easy class. Attendance is taking during lecture but it is for a small percent of your grade. Three easy tests and no assignments that are not completed during discussion section.

Amazing intro course, he's the reason I chose ABSC as my minor. Lectures were engaging, fun, and well structured. Exams were easy and directly related to class material. Readings were super manageable. He's also very funny and values student participation, he often walks around and asks how people's weekends went. VERY personable and knowledgeable.
Class is pretty easy with a fair amount of work. Gives out an insane amount of extra credit, so very easy to keep grade up if you do the extra credit. Pretty interesting and not too difficult.

Professor Pinkston is amazing! He gives out enough extra credit to make your grade go up from a C to an A. If you have an A by the end, you don't need to take the final. This is a perfect class to take for your first semester freshman year to help get into the grove of college.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: We received soooo much extra credit which really allows students to pick themselves up if they drop points. 3 points is given for attendance in lectures and quizzes are easy if you take notes in class and from the textbook (very well written and easy to understand - good for freshmen). All round a great professor and very passionate and engaging.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This guy is great. He is a compassionate person who you can tell has a lovely bond with his family. Along with that, he's very educated in his curriculum and answers questions in a way where you can understand. Every ABSC student has to take ABSC 100, and you are in good hands with Pink Man👍🏽

Dr Pinkston is not only an incredible professor, but also an incredible human. He is kind and compassionate and very accommodating to students with physical and mental disabilities. He is easy to talk to and outgoing, and I found his class very interesting. My attendance was not the greatest but his course was really easy and it was not mandatory.

Dr. Pinkston is incredible. Our class met once a week and I attended only the first week's class and finished with an A. All reading and mastery quizzes are online and the final, at least for me, is fully online. I loved this man. He was so kind and understanding and actually made his class enjoyable.

Dr. Pinkston was really nice, only besides some rude-ish email responses to question(s) I asked. There are weekly reading modules, chapter quizzes, lecture quizzes, then the in-person Interteach lessons you MUST attend. In what may seem like a lot is not truly that difficult. As long as you actively participate in classes you will be fine!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Grade is 3 essays, some discussion posts, and a final. For 203, upper 25% of grades on all 3 essays was a C. Highest grade on any of them was an 85%. Writing parameters are unclear and not "rubric-based"—so no clue what he wants. He doesn't teach the material: you are essentially just reading books and then doing the homework, no video lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Do not ever take a class with this professor. He expected us to read 200 pages weekly and do essays worth 50% of our grade. Save yourself time and stress and take a different course.

Professor Wedge is a great person who is willing to meet and talk with you about your writing. That said, he is a very tough grader for what the class is supposed to be (ENGL 102). He doesn't believe in the university grading scale, so he doesn't give out pluses or minuses. What should have been a B+ for me ended up as a B.

Do not take his class under any circumstances! I had him for English 102, and for the second easiest English class at KU, he makes it way too hard. The way he grades paper is also ridiculous, he expects us to be Shakespeare in order to get a somewhat decent grade. He also reads every discussion board that we do and grades our responses.

You will strongly benefit from being active in class and joining office hours once in a while. To receive better grades, you must show Wedge that you care and that you're trying to improve. Grading criteria is clear, but subjective. If you show effort and improvement throughout the class, you have nothing to worry about.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Makes a 100 level English class unnecessarily difficult. Seems to delight in making it almost impossible to get an A
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: this class was the worst class i've ever taken. he expects you to laugh at all his awkward and stupid jokes. he's assigned 10 books for the semester and we get essay after essay. Me and everyone else are getting straight C's on all the essays. so, take this class if you wish to RUIN. YOUR. GPA. and experience hell for a semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Made my freshmen year a living hell. Makes you read 100 pages a night, and gives pop quizzes frequently at the beginning of the semester. There is little extra credit opportunities and his favorite pastime is to belittle his students. 100% would recommend taking this class with a different teacher, if you can't.......... good luck.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Wedge expects you to write a certain way. A C on a paper is a pretty average-good grade. I was shocked. I had him for an Austen and Hardy class. The dude talks about sports way too much. I'm never taking him again. Everyone else says the same thing.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Wedge teaches this class in order to persuade the indecisive honors student join the English dept. Like many others, he overanalyzes novels that IMO should be taken at face value. We read like 9 novels. Essays are graded difficult; to the point of discouragement.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I enjoyed this English class a lot. Professor Wedge is very entertaining and will help you when you need it if you visit his office hours - that will help tremendously on your essays (worth 50% of your grade). Make sure you go to class and participate and you will get a better average grade. Also, he does single letter grading for the final grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I love prof wedge he is appropriately challenging for honors students and clearly defines what he expects of you.

After the first two weeks of class, you will realize the gpa destroyer that is this class. We have read 7 different books that are beyond time consuming, and he requires a close reading of each. Otherwise, you will get destroyed on the final when he makes you list character names (first and last), authors names (first and last), and specific quotes
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Dr. Wedge is one great professor and I am glad I had him for my first english class in college, but get ready to read and work extremely hard on your essays. You might think your paper would get an A or maybe it would in any other environment but in his class it'll probably receive a C. Good luck!!

Dr. Wedge leads a good discussion but he grades extremely hard. Essays that in my other English class would have gotten an A+ received a C+. If you don't write the way he wants you to write, regardless of the quality of your content, you will be marked down significantly. Class participation is a must. Overall he's a great teacher and super fun!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Professor Wedge is a wonderful, dedicated person, but he is an extremely tough grader. If you don't read the texts, this class will make little sense to you.  The essays are compelling but VERY difficult.  He does give his students a ton of outside time though and a few extra credit opportunities.  Overall, I enjoyed his class, but is was HARD.

Wedge gives constant essays and has a deep, inexplicable hatred for the traditional "5 paragraph essay" that's been taught for our entire lives. There's lots of reading but you can just read most nights and pay attention to lecture. Great in-class discussions, but get another 105 prof if you can. SO much work compared to other 105 classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Wedge? Extremely rude and isn't interested in hearing your opinion if it's not his. Hopefully you don't have a funeral to attend during the semester because it will be counted as one of your two unexcused absences. As for his grading, he's the type of guy who will tell you your paper is great in office hours and give you a C when you turn it in.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He's a really tough grader, and don't skimp on attendance. Make sure you do all the reading for his classes, because he tends to have pop quizzes. He's really nitpicky on essays, but he tends to grade his students based on how much you've improved over the course of the semester, so as long as you make progress, you shouldn't fail.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: He's always available and will give you plenty of time to have him read over your essays early and make changes. When he does grade them, he will be ruthless. As long as you show improvement throughout the semester, he'll give you the best essay score overall. He's a pretty chill guy about everything though.
Seems to be more interested in getting the job done than doing the job well. His feedback was irrelevant and unhelpful, almost as if he hadn't actually paid attention to my work.
Completely sucks all the fun out of the literature. Reading should be fun, not a chore. Memorization of the text is an old-school philosophy that should be abandoned.

As a person- he is a truly great guy, kind of awkward but cares about his students. As a professor- incredibly challenging. Only take this class if you want to push your essay writing skills to max capacity. Achieving an A on a paper is nearly impossible, even if you bring it to the Writing Center and in to office hours.

He's a great guy  very likable, but his class was incredibly difficult. I've never worked harder for a grade. You HAVE to keep up with the readings or you'll just get lost. The exams are really difficult, as are the papers. That being said, he was always willing to work with me outside of class. He was incredibly helpful and a real stand up gent.

An absolutely terrible professor. It is almost impossible to get an A on essays even if you go in to office hours. Ridiculous amount of reading. Midterm and final are part quote identification from all the books read and part essay. I HATED this class and do not recommend this class at all.

He's a very nice guy but what he expects of his students is impossibly difficult. Expect to read 9 different novels/stories with hours of readings each night. The thing about his class that is ridiculous is that the final exam is part essay part quote identification, and he expects you to remember the first & last name of every single character.
The worst instructor I had at the university of kansas.

Professor Wedge is as hard as others make him sound. However, if you are willing to put in a little bit of effort, you'll probably improve immensely. He cares about students who care, so if you actually try, not only will your grade be better, you'll likely have an advocate for recommendations later on. If you want to write well, take his class.

I took 3 honors based writing courses at another university and have never struggled like I have in this class. I took my paper in 3 times and still got a C+ (I have an almost perfect GPA so this is very out of character). I try hard, complete all reading and assignments (2-4 hours a night) and it doesn't show in my grades. Cool guy, harsh grader.

Do not take this class. Seriously. Expect about 200 pages of reading a night, and four essays. Essays are graded extremely harshly, with feedback that isn't clear and makes it hard to improve. He is a great guy with funny stories, but unless you have a passion for English and are willing to put in tons of effort, take it with a different professor.

you have to read the books if you want to pass his class. He's a nice guy to talk to about sports, but when it comes to school work, it's his way or the highway. He doesn't sympathize with missing readings and will call you out at some points.

Very, very, difficult grader. No matter how hard you work, he will not cut you any slack. It is nearly impossible to get an A on any essay's or the mid term. The final is also extremly difficult and impossible to get an A on since its cumulative and one of the parts is a 900 WORD ESSAY.

I have always considered myself good at English and figured this honors class would be an easy A. Although I ended up with a B in the class, Professor Wedge challenged me on my papers more than any other teacher I have had. He is a funny guy who is more than willing to help you improve your writing. Not an easy class, but I gained a lot from it.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS! Wedge is an extremely difficult grader and his expectations for essays are very unclear. If you're lucky, you might get a B. His discussions are interesting but the reading load is very heavy and you will spend all semester stressing over your grade.

Must work extremely hard for an A. Even if you work extremely hard, don´t expect an A. Basically have to do every reading and be involved in the discussions to do well. A nice guy that tries to be funny (doesnt really succeed) and make class interesting.
Must read your books. Grades hard on essays-write well or expect a lower grade. A discussion-style class. Uses movies.

Wedge was AWESOME! This was a major authors course (Austen and Hardy). He was very helpful, hilarious, and encouraged us to come to office hours. He does grade papers hard, but if you write them early and go to him, you can get an A on the paper. There were random quizzes just to make sure you did the reading and they made up your hw grade.
DO NOT TAKE! Wedge is rude, unhelpful and an extremely unreasonable grader. Doesn't give clear assignment expectations and is unhelpful in office hours. TAKE DIFFERENT CLASS.

I am an English major who does well in and enjoys my classes.I love to read.That being said,this class was bad. Wedge is old-fashioned. Workload is impossible.He zaps the life out of literature by refusing to discuss the text in a greater context. He wants you to memorize facts about the texts without engaging in creative/out-of-the-box thinking.

Old-fashioned grader. Don't expect to get "A's" on the paper. A lot of busy work, that must be done or else you have no chance of an "A" or even a "B". He is a good guy, and cares about the subject; but it is not easy. I would advise not to take him. If you do, just be very good with your papers and go to him as often as possible when you need help

Like everyone else says, insane grader. That's not so much a problem as how little he cares about students lives. It doesn't matter if you have 3 jobs and a multitude of life issues, if you're not at EVERY class, you FAIL the class. He's also incredibly unhelpful with papers and you can't read anything he writes on your essays. STAY AWAY.

Great guy. Not an easy A, and you'll definitely have to read your stuff to do well on the tests (all quotes and essay answers). I would take him again -- he's likeable, intelligent, and challenged me as a critical reader. Don't debate him in class, though. He gets defensive. Wouldn't recommend to non-English majors.

Unfair at grading.  It is impossible to get an A on a paper.  If you do a rewrite and fix everything he counted off for, the grade doesn't improve.  He picks lousy books to read and the reading load is impossible and too heavy for a 3 credit hour class.  He thinks everyone in the class loves English and can't wait to change their major to English.

He is a bit of a curmudgeon and a BIG fan of Ted Hughes, so be prepared to defend yourself if you think (as many scholars, professors, poets, writers and students do) that Hughes was a real****. That said, if you show up for class and endure it and work hard, you will do alright.
It may be impossible to get a good grade on a paper. Who knows though!
Wedge was a great teacher and I learned a ton. He knows his stuff. Expect to actually have to work but if you use his office hours or email him, it's possible to get decent grades.

Essays take 20 hours. 4 hour Reading assignments twice a week. Ask him a question in office hours, and he will tell you "I'm not writing your paper for you". Is mean in office hours, talks about his life in class.

This class is hard. If you want an easy english grade, dont take it.  His essays are impossible to get A's on, and if you go talk to him about them he only helps a little bit.  His midterm and final are all quotes and essays - quotes are hard as can be.  He is a funny guy and a great guy, but his class is hard.

this guy is very hard...makes you read way too much and expects everyone is an english major who cares slightly as much as he does about british lit...pretty hard grader and has random quizzes. always says to stay on topic during his boring lectures yet talks about his family and social life (softball) i do not like this man at alllll
Grades waaaay too hard.. I had never gotten that low of a grade on a paper before taking this class. I would not recommend it.

This is a great class if you want to spend hours reading and working really hard for an essay grade that is merely half of what you deserve. The lectures you learn about the book, Wedge's family, and international soccer. However, despite the hard grades on the final and exams, the overall grade is not that bad.

Amount of reading is uncalled for. He thinks we all want to be english majors. Grades papers way to hard. Class is a total gpa killer. I would never let anyone I know take a class from this guy. Class is ridiculous. Professor is boring and hates partiers. Always tries to talk about his family like we care. DO NOT EVER TAKE THIS CLASS!

Not a bad teacher but a very unrealistic amount of reading assigned and grades way to hard on essays. I always received good grades in English classes up until his course. I would not advise taking ENGL 105 from him

He grades EXTREMELY hard.  He's a nice guy and tries to keep class interesting with his mostly bad jokes, but expect to do an unrealistic amount of reading and get bad grades on your essays.  The tests are even more difficult.  I would've taken something else if I had checked here first.

Worst teacher I've ever had. His grading was impossible-he's supposed to be grading freshmen, not scholars. I've always been good at writing papers, and he tore mine apart. It wasn't even helpful, just demeaning my thoughts. The reading was very long and unrealistic. Plus, he's judgmental, so if he doesn't like you you're out of luck. Dreaded going

Amazing Professor. His class made me change from a PolSci Major to an English major. He's a very hard professor but well worth the effort to take his class. He grades very hard on essay's and participating in class discussion is a must. If you want a challenging class that will make you think and that you will grow from, take this. Plus he's funny!

Incredible teacher, impossible course.  The readings are insanely long and he grades the essays harder than any teacher i've had.  The final is on quotes from the books so you have to read them all, sorry no sparkotes.  Just be sure that you improve on your essays and make sure that he likes you and you should get a good grade.

He is very hard, but a great teacher.  I LOVED his sports & lit class, but his brit novel was much more difficult.  i felt like my grades kept getting worse, but he understands effort and ultimately rewards it.  nice guy.  take the sports class, you will love it!

Avoid Wedge at all costs. You will work twice as hard for half the grade. In one week, we read 250 pgs from authors like Woolf, Joyce, and Eliot PLUS turn in our 3rd essay. His essays and tests are ridiculously hard, hard for hard's sake. He wants to turn your writing into the sylistic equivalent of wearing black socks with shorts and sneakers.
Not an enjoyable professor.

Wedge is a nice guy and probably a good teacher, but what bothered me about him is that when I went in to talk to him about a paper, he was not helpful and told me very bluntly that most students simply expect a good grade if they visit him. Well, I was trying to get help, not suck up to a professor. He was insulting and definitely not helpful.

Fabulous English class.  Somewhat time-consuming and demanding, but definitely worthwhile.  He grades on improvement of papers, so just make sure that you learn from your "mistakes" and adapt to the writing style he's looking for.  Ask for help and you'll receive it.  Ask for jokes and you'll get dumb ones.  Cool guy, though.
No Comments

If you don't love poetry, don't take Wedge. I think he cracks the same jokes and makes the same puns every semester, but tries to pass them off as spontaneous. Gives verbal and essay quizzes randomly.
very tough grader, great guy though.  don't take his classes if you're looking for the easy 200 level grade.
No Comments

VERY difficult teacher. But he's really passionate about English, so the class is bearable. Even though the essays are hard, he's always willing to help outside of class. Go into his office hours! He's gives great input. Overall, I'm glad I took his class.

Extremely hard! The class would have been more enjoyable if memorizing was not instructors priority. He should have put more emphasis on this aspect before the midterm. Overall he is  interesting and has a passion for teaching the subject.
grades super hard.  funny, interesting but grades really hard
No Comments

I fell in love with Thomas Hardy in this class. If you like the romantics, Wedge is a great guy to teach them to you. It's been about 4 years since I was in his class, but he still helped me out with summer enrollment this year. He actually loves teaching and helping students out, which is more than I can say for some.
Wedge is so awesome.  He is very helpful, but grading is pretty hard.  The class is so much, I loved it.

Wedge is a cool guy but he's extremely hard. If you're used to getting As on papers and want to keep that streak going, don't take this class. You may think you're a great writer now but he will prove you wrong. If you want to be challenged this is the class for you. Also, his final is comprehensive and ridiculously difficult.
Wonderful guy. Really nice, but grades kinda hard. Worth taking his class if you can get in.
Fun, fun, fun, guy.  Excellent teacher who honestly wants students to improve.  I greatly recommend taking a course of his.

Kevin isn't a bad guy, but he shows clear favoritism to some students, and if you are not one of his favorites, he'll make sure you know it. The class is really really hard and after exams if people don't do well he puts them down and blames them rather than his awful teaching.

Kevin is a great guy. He actually cares for students especially if you engage with him. The test are HARD, but if you put in the effort, you will be rewarded. Just showing up will take you a long way. He's helpful in instruction and doesn't mind answering questions.

Kevin is awesome, great guy to talk to and one of my most entertaining professors. But the class itself is tough and Kevin won't be cutting you any breaks with the tough exams. He will give generous curves though and you can get massive amounts of extra credit on the exams. Be prepared to try in this class and you'll be fine.

Kevin is a great guy and professor, the material can just be difficult to comprehend. Tests are a large part of the grade, but there is an opportunity to make up a bad test (final will be 40% of grade). There were a couple pop quizzes throughout the semester. I would take him again, but glad I don't have to take this class again.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I don't understand the hate on this professor If you're active in class and try he will try to walk you through whatever you're confused on. He's very down-to-earth and understanding. He conveys material as you'd expect, he trys to make it relatable and interactive. Overall great professor and wants his students to succeed.

0/10 on this one. You can tell he doesn't really care about this class. The material in this class isn't supposed to be hard but he's such a terrible teacher that it's so hard to learn anything from him. Anything I learned I taught myself. I had an easier time in BSAN 202 and FIN 410 than I did in this class. Worst professor I've ever had by far.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Kevin is a good teacher and good person. Students who care about putting effort into the class and subject will succeed and thrive in the class. Quizzes and tests are very doable with preparations he allows. He will put as much effort into you as you put into the class. Very upbeat and keeps the class up to date with current events. Would recommend
Kevin is a pretty nice guy but he isn't really great at teaching. He doesn't explain concepts well enough and gets mad when people don't know what's going on.
HARD Class

The way he teaches is just so unhelpful. He just talks and talks and talks and I can't even make myself pay attention. He doesn't relate anything that he talks about to what he's talked about before. He just makes it so confusing. He's also a huge goofball, which isn't a bad thing. Just funny. But I wouldn't suggest as a professor.

Kevin's tests were very difficult. He would tell you what is on the tests, but then put stuff on there we never learned. The homework was easy and helpful for the quizzes, as well as the practice problems. They class is not meant to be online, which made the seconds portion of the course more difficult. Quizzes were hit or miss on difficulty.

Kevin is great! He came off strong when introducing the syllabus, but it really was not as difficult as he puts out. He clearly tells you what will be on the exams. You will need to study diligently to get an A. The quizzes are tough! Go to class to get practice problems for quizzes and tests. You will get out what you put into this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I've had at KU. Caring, helpful, and taught me a lot of things that will help me in future classes/work. I looked forward to his class. Highly recommend
Cameron is a really nice guy and makes class engaging and fun. Would 100% choose to have him as a professor for all of my classes.
great instructor. There is a textbook but all of the readings are linked on canvas. Easy to pay attention in his class. Quizzes every week that are open note. The writings are fairly easy
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: No doubt the most understanding professor at KU. Sets due dates and clear expectations on assignments. Always friendly and fun, just a really good guy.

(COMS310) Best professor I've had at KU. Cameron is truly an understanding professor who wants you to succeed. He does well at lecturing the material and tries to make them interactive. He's super lenient on deadlines and wants students to try their best. Just communicate with him and you'll be fine! I would definitely take another course from him
Best Professor at KU. His teaching methods are phenomenal & you can tell he actually wants his students to succeed. Very understanding and will work with you so you can succeed in his course.
This class is amazing! Dr. Piercy is amazing, by the best class I have ever taken at KU

Dr. Piercy is one of my favorite professors at KU so far. Since the first day of classes, he created an atmosphere that made everyone comfortable speaking up/participating. This class is based around working in a set group/team throughout the semester. If this worries you, just know that Piercy is there for advice/encouragement. He's fantastic!

Took 320 during 1st semester of hybrid classes. Half our class would meet Monday, while the rest is online. On Wednesday those kids come to class and Monday kids are online now. Great teacher, very clear. Pushes you to try and do better each class. Good amount of reading but once you have done the entire reading the class will make so much sense
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: He truly cares about you. Such a great professor. Only thing I don't like about this class is the group projects because my group never did their work. Otherwise, I highly recommend him. He's super organized and nice.
One of the best teachers I've had at KU. Actually cares about his students. Really liked the class discussions everyday. There are also only quizzes and no tests, so make sure to go to class.

In my time in the Communications area of study at KU, I've found many of the professors to be very pompous, pretentious pseudo-intellectuals... not so with Mr. Piercy. He gives you as many opportunities as can be expected of a professor to give when passion and he made a class on Relationships in Digital Media fun to come to.

One of the best professors I have ever had. A professor who genuinely cares about you as a student and will give you every chance to pass. He was an awesome dude, and I cannot say enough good things about him, honestly.
Best teacher I have ever had
One of the few instructors from communications that isn't full of himself.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Cameron was an absolute homie that I know everyone in my class loved. He was fun, smart, and genuinely cared about our learning experience. He is a tough grader but if you go to class and learn the material, you'll be fine. I wish I could take another class with him bc he ended up being one of my favorite teachers in the COMS department.

Not sure what all these entitled children complaining about having to actually work in college are on about. This 300 level course had minimal reading for even a 100 level, course is graded on discussing readings in class and a few SHORT papers. 2000 words is nothing in college. Enjoy teachers with an opinion! It's a goal of university to open up

Absolutely too much work for a 100 level class. Get ready to cite every single sentence you make, even if its material required/covered by the course (Pickett 2017). This instructor is very politically charged and be concerned with your agreement to the underlying messages.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Some of the homework he assigns is outrageously long. 12 page midterm for an intro level class, a discussion assignment where you have to watch a 2 and a half hour movie and answer questions. His lectures also include false, over-simplified, or politically charged information presented as fact. Some material isn't even related to geography.

In past classes didn't give tests, but for some reason he decided to have 2 tests when I took the class. The tests were take home and you had 3 days to complete. But the tests consisted of 20 short answer and 2 essays that were 1000 words each. There was an extreme amount of writing due to a discussion assignment due every week that was 500 words.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

Theres also a weekly online quiz that uses the book but you can take it as many times as you want.

1: He seems very rude and condescending in his instructions for assignments. 3: He makes you buy a $30 online game that was used for ONE discussion assignment worth only 7 POINTS. 2: His extra credit opportunity requires you to buy ANOTHER book from Amazon. 4: This class is too difficult and too deep for a 102 level class. Maybe a 200-300 level.

He was engaged in everything we learned and made even the things I had no interest in (like phylogenies) interesting. If you have the chance to have him as an instructor, do whatever it takes to make a section taught by him fit into your schedule.
He is the best teacher ever! He is young and can relate to college students. Super funny and I really learned a lot from him.
Very helpful. I really enjoy his classes. He is funny which makes class fun.

He explains things in ways that actually make sense and doesn't feel the need to follow the textbook if it's dumb. Prepares you for very exam, and makes fun of his classes.

Marcel is easily the best gta in calc. Try everything you can to get into his class. His lectures are actually interactive and he explains topics in ways that make any topic easy to understand and succeed.
THE GOAT!!

BEST math class ive ever taken and best math teacher ive ever experienced. His lectures are very thorough but also hilarious and sarcastic. He makes sure we are prepared for each test and quiz by reviewing in class with us and providing us with lesson questions . Fun random activites all the time. He has statistically the highest scores on exams.
love this guy
Very good guy
Easily the best teacher I have had at KU so far. He cares about the students and your grade, if you put in the effort and time it's and easy A.

There is a lot of writing in this class, and the projects are very long and time consuming. However, Bobkowski is a fantastic professor. He is super helpful and understanding. Professor Bobkowski is a very caring, kind, and helpful professor. He'll tell you point-blank if he doesn't like an aspect of your work, but he'll also tell you things he loves about it. reviews.comment: There's a lot of professors who teach J302, and you might hear about how different the classes may be. Don't sweat it, take 302 with Bobkowski. Not the easiest class per se, but good god did from him. Super available and understanding. Show effort and he'll realize it. I would take a class with him in a heartbeat if I had the chance.
He is a great guy and a great professor. Very accessible and very understanding.

I thought I knew what it meant to learn. I was wrong. I was blind and Dr Bobkowski helped me see. I was mute and Dr Bobkowski gave me a voice. The sky was black, but now there is light again. Dr. Bobkowski saved my life. Now, I make 10 figures. Thank you Dr Bobkowski, thank you.
He frickin rocks. So funny yet knowledgeable. I would take his class again in a heartbeat. Not a lot of work. All of the content is very interesting. Expect a lot of participation (seminar setting)

He is a real nice guy, but he expects a lot more out of you than this class should. If you aren't willing to work hard in this class then I would suggest to find a different teacher. He is a VERY tough grader. Also, he won't tell you what you did wrong or what you need to fix unless you specifically ask him on your own time.
Best class I took!  He's easy on the eyes, but more importantly he knows what he's talking about and helped me understand the importance of the subject.  Great class!

I LOVED this class! In the beginning I thought it would be the one I dreaded going to the most, but Bobkowski is really funny, and an awesome guy! His class is easier than the other 302 class, but you learn all of the same things as the other one! TAKE THIS CLASS

I am honestly surprised his easiness is rated so low - not only is his class incredibly easy (I have a 97%), there are no tests and you actually learn a lot in there. I enjoy coming to this class. Anyone who has to take J302 - take Bobkowski. You won't regret it.
He is a good teacher and i learned a lot of useful stuff from him. If you pay attention and come to class, you will get a good grade. I got an A-.

Prof. Bobkowski is the greatest! His class is a lot of work at times, but you do learn a lot. He will also do anything to help his students if you are willing to put forth some effort. He is my favorite teacher in the J-School that I have had so far. Definitely take him for 302 if you can.

Bobkowski is the bomb!!! He is super funny and made a typically boring class very interesting. He does expect a lot out of his students but that is why he is a GOOD professor. I probably learned more in his class than any other class I took this semester.

I had Professor Bobkowski for Journalism 415. He expects a lot out of you and is a pretty tough grader. Don't expect to give a small amount of effort for an A. However, he is always willing to work and meet with you outside of class.  Bobkowski has been one of my favorite journalism professors so far.

I had Bobkowski for J301 for his first year at KU. He is a hard grader. He expects a lot out of you. He kinda seems unapproachable. But I had him with a small class but he would make us laugh. My overall rating is good, but could improve.

You either love him or hate him. He is hard to understand at first and honestly just a kind of awkward guy, but he's super funny and understanding. If you ask questions during quizzes he will usually help the whole class with the problem and end up doing a group quiz which is nice. He also gives lots of help on exams. BECOME HIS FRIEND.
funny and understanding
Hard to understand. Confusing. Switch out if you get him.

This class was difficult and required a lot of work. You have assignments online due after class which I hated. They were hard because you had to be ultra specific or else it was wrong. Really enjoyed having Bea as a TA. She was super sweet and knew a lot on the subject. Only issue I ever had was that the class ran late sometimes and I had to rush to my next class. Otherwise good! Assignments were manageable,  but a few quizzes that required doing the readingsgoing to lecture. Nothing too hard on the quizzes though.

The class itself is a weed-out class so it's already a hard class, and Bea helps you through it. She is actually from Spain so it was good to have a native speaker as the teacher, and she was really understandable in her speech. The worst part of the class was the My Spanish Lab assignments online. GET THOSE DONE.

Prater is the best professor at KU Law. I'm finishing up his Evidence now class and would take it again just because he is the professor. He is brilliant, wrote the book, and really cares about his students. The class is hard with tons of info. But, what do you expect? It's law school. Prater is awesome, really hilarious and his class is super fun!

Prater is the best professor I've experienced at KU Law.  He is an expert in his field who loves what he does.  He's a notoriously tough grader, but he genuinely wants you to learn the material.  Don't be afraid to ask questions and express any concerns you have to him, he will do his best to make sure you understand.
Everyone should take him! He's the best to learn Evidence from, he really knows his stuff.
Prater teaches you how to actually practice law in a courtroom. He is probably the best prof at KU Law be sure to take him if you can.
Hot.... com'on hes smok'n!  Lock this man up, he must be breaking some law for being  hot, inteligent, entertaining and a brillant teacher.  10/10 !
agreed, you have to be a girl and go on his boat! this prof. gives a very bad reputation to KU-Law. he cannot control himself. he does not have any respect for his age or position. what a shame!
be a girl and go on his boat, you will have A for sure!

Who knew law school could be fun?  He has an entertaining teaching style and clear approach that makes learning boring rules very interesting.  Lots of audience participation in acting out situations.
Smart, entertaining man who truly wants you to do well in the course, on the bar, and in your eventual career. Highly recommended.
Excellent teacher who truly cares about his students.  The review session for hearsay and character witnesses were great.  One of the best teachers I have ever had.

prater is a good teacher, but he makes us act out his little evidence fantasies, which is kind of disturbing! and his head is really shiny!
great class, even greater professor.  Not as hot as Hecker in jeans, but cuter.

a double chili pepper.....

Very very easy class and the content was actually interesting. He gave so many opportunities for extra credit and allows make-up exams. Quite literally impossible to not get an A with all of the chances he gives. He knew his students by name, provided useful feedback, and was a generous grader. Attendance not required but lectures were fun!

He is so nice and caring. He does not grade based on deadlines, instead, he grades based on the students' individual goals. He makes a point to get to know each student. There is no homework and he makes it really easy to want to engage in class. The class is a great structure too.

He gives every opportunity for you to succeed. Such a cool person and cool class. I also appreciate they didn't charge a textbook and made a packet where you give $10 of all the readings you need. Way better than a textbook

Stephen is really friendly and easy to talk to. I can see his passion for linguistics through his lecture. The exam was reasonable, except for the first one cause everyone didn't know what would happen. It's an easy A if you pay attention during lab and class because they will go through what you need to know multiple times.

Stephen Politzer-Ahles is a very knowledgeable guy. He is a little qwirky for my liking but he is still streight to the point about the subject. His tests are not difficult if you understand what he is looking for. He is a really nice guy I just found his class extreamly boring. He is easy to work with and is accomidating if you miss class.

Stephen is VERY knowledgeable of his field. During lectures, he poses many different "what-ifs" and theories which is a nice brain stimulator, but it can sometimes yield confusion rather than critical thinking. The discussion is extremely helpful because that is the more "straightforward" aspect of the class, and it creates a nice balance.

He was the best! Polizter-Ahles was always accessible outside of class and cared for each and everyone of his students. He made my first semester at KU great! I got sick and missed some exams and he let me make it up whenever I felt better. He is very sweet and really shows a passion for what he teaches!

The work is not heavy at all, I dedicated 2-3 hours outside of class per week and ended with an A. She was always available by phone outside of class if we had questions, which I really appreciated. Overall great class.
Dr. Pope works hard for those that who put in effort. Understanding and very intelligent. Important to put in work outside of class will affect your grade.
Enjoyed the course had to wait two semesters before it was offered, this lady is funny and engaging. Dr. Pope knows her material watch out for statistics and communicate any trouble areas.
class was much easier than I had been told it would be. It is a mandatory course for the Psych degree, stay on top of material.

I have taken Dr. Pope for the past 3 semesters she has also become my mentor, I would not be published 4 times as an undergraduate without her guidence and subtle direction. If you really listen you will walk away with truly valuable knowledge of statistics, validity, and scientific proceedure.
Can be awkward Dr. Pope, makes the material seem easy. Make sure you pay attention she is fast thinking and may outthink many who are not paying attention. Love her!

reviews.comment: Dr. Pope is pretty eccentric, but she knows she is. The material is well presented and easy to understand. Make sure to pay attention once you get to the statistics part. She is brilliantly efficient at stats and forgets others do not access statistics as well.

Tough course lecture heavy but worth is takes a few weeks to settle in but then the material lightens up and Dr. Pope is willing to work with those she does not have in lab understand the topics at hand. Too many other students were in this one.
Great professor despite being very busy and running several labs.

Alot of reading !!! Dr. Pope enjoys the topic and shares enthusiasm for it. I was not so interested but she was able to keep my attention. I ended up with an solid A but had to really work hard for it most every one received an B. Good for beginning research.

This professor is way socially awkward but knows her stuff. Some of the class did not know how to take her she is kinda the mad professor in a good way. This class was awful. It was structured horribly. The whole class consisted of group work and then we were tested over stuff we barely, or never, talked about in class. Dr. Pope doesn't really know how to teach effectively. She's not good. Everything is group discussions and she does not lecture. She's hard to listen to, too. The exams have a lot of information she never went over in class. Dr. Pope is a nice lady, but she takes way too long to enter overall test grades (like 2 months). This class ended up being more difficult than I expected. I went to lecture and would leave confused; he writes in shorthand with little explanation so my notes didn't help, and talks very quietly. Once we moved online, he started posting handouts which helped a lot. Only 2 attempts for lyryx homework questions. Very responsive to emails/questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Porter is a fantastic professor. His tests are 85% of the grade but the proofs aren't too difficult, and the tests have a lot of T/F and fill in the blank questions, and he also posts old tests beforehand. Expect to learn lots of topology. Although analysis is hard, it's not as bad as people say. If I actually studied I probably couldve done better

I truthfully did not do well in this class but Prof. Porter is a great teachers. The exams were exactly what I was expecting and followed textbook but material is hard. Prof. Porter is extremely accessible outside the class and even outside of office hours. He's kind and you can really tell he's an expert in the field. HW was light but frequent.

Prof. Porter is very well respected in his department, and for good reason. He knows his stuffthat is, if you can even hear him. The Honors version of the course he does even fewer examples so you will be even more lost. Be prepared for a third of your exams to be True/False questions. I will be avoiding his classes in the future if I can help it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Respected

reviews.comment: Dr. Porter is a freaking awesome prof, he is incredibly helpful outside of class and is always accessible. He does test over things that he only talks about in lecture, so make sure to attend his lectures. He talks a little quiet, but if you are paying attention it is not hard to hear him. Highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Although he can be hard to follow or even hear at times, Prof. Porter will go to great lengths to help students out when needed. I struggled in this class at first, but then I started meeting with him outside of class which really boosted my understanding of the material. He truly cares about students more so than any other prof I've encountered.

Don't know why his rating isn't higher. Yes, he talks kind of quiet, but if you are actually paying attention you can hear him clearly. Short but useful homework assignments, study guides match what is on the tests. Lectures can be kind of dull, especially when it is theory stuff. Don't overthink it and use your calculator, you'll be fine.

Overall, a very good professor. The two non-final tests were very similar to their study guides. However, only about 1/3 to 1/2 of the stuff on the final exam was reviewed in the final study guide. So look at your old tests while you're studying for the final! He's also very quiet - it's very helpful to sit near the front.

Professor Porter deserves a higher rating than he has. He cares a great amount about his students, and he wants everyone to do well. He is very nice, and will do anything to help you out. He is a little bit soft spoken, but if you sit toward the front, it is not a problem. The tests are nearly identical to his study guides, but a little harder.

Thank goodness he uses a calculator.  I tried this class without one and cried at all the arithmetic.  This is math not 2nd grade.  He is so nice in office hours and has a dry sense of humor.  Talks softly tho so will have to listen closely.
He made a class that was supposed to be an easy A into a hard class. The exams are almost identical to the problems on the study guides he releases. Very helpful in office hours.

Dr. Porter is a nice old man. course ranges from very difficult to very easy. tests are fair and similar to practice exams(throws in some curveballs though). he's soft spoken, so sit up front so that you can hear him. get a good grade on the first test as it is easier and will give you a cushion.

He's a great teacher. If you pay attention in class and take halfway decent notes, then this class won't be a lot of trouble. He does a lot of example problems and his tests are just like his study guides, but there are occasionally some challenging problems. But if you go to class and pay attention, it shouldn't be difficult.

All he ever did was work problems in class and expected us to know how to do it on the homeworks/tests. I caught onto his style eventually; just be ready to ask questions if you get lost 'cause he moves really fast. He's a nice guy, though.

I heard this was a really easy class, but he wasn't the one teaching it then. He is so confusing and thinks everyone totally understands the most abstract points of math as well as he does. He brags about half the class getting A's and B's but ignores the other half of the class who is getting D's and F's.
Funny guy if you pay attention and catch the jokes---made the class really interesting.  Speaks softly so sit up front.  Very helpful in office hours.

He spoke so softly it was impossible to hear him! When you didn't understand something, he would tell you to see his GTA who couldn't speak English. He used different concepts than the book did, making it that much harder to study. I am a good math student and I had to withdrawl with a D because he refused to help me. Do NOT take his class!

Took this in a large lecture... maybe he is better with smaller crowds, but he never turned away from the chalkboard.  He told us that his TA's should be the helpers and not to bother him with any questions.  First test was a breeze... second was killer.

teacher told us not to come to him for help...tests had stuff from chapters that he said the test wouldnt' be over...more than half of the class dropped....shouldnt' happen in math 290....linear algebra should be pretty simple...but he makes it harder than it has to be, if you can take this class with someone else
Clear and good explanations. Tests are hard but does offer day of review. Come to class and do homework guaranteed good grade.

My TA told me that they were trying to center the class around a 'D' instead of a 'C' like most classes. For my major, any grade lower than a 'C' requires you to repeat the course. Other than this attempt to 'filter' out the students that don't belong in math or engineering, I feel he is a good teacher.
His class was very boring to have to sit through.  His tests were really hard and you had nothing to study for exams.  Avoid his class if all possible!
He's very cleaver, clear and human person. It was an honour for me to have spent some time with him in Lawrence ten years ago.
No Comments
He's very patient and helpful. Good at tying together big concepts so students could understand the point... Challenging but short assignments with fair exams.
It's HARD to be that smart and can still teach
Goes to great lengths to help out a student.

Dr. Naderi was an amazing professor and I would highly recommend any and all college students take his classes. Personally, I learned so much from him and appreciate all the information he was able to teach me.

Dr. Naderi is an incredible professor that not only challenges you, but also encourages critical analysis on multiple levels. Lectures are excellent and reading material aligns well with content of the course.
Poffessor Naderi is the reason I changed my minor to Soc. One if the greatest profs. I have ever experienced.

Pooya is a great professor, he's a very high-quality human being, a fantastic, passionate teacher,  and the best professor I've had. At the beginning of the semester: "While most professors don't consider relationship issues to be a valid reason to miss class, I believe your relationships matter, so just come talk to me and we'll work it out."

Pooya is best lecturer I've had; he's very engaging. Discussion is required, and really productive. The class isn't too difficult, just a few simple tests and one 7-page research essay (that he gives you a lot of freedom with). I've never enjoyed writing a paper this much, actually.  If he's teaching any class, I highly recommend enrolling in it!

High energy guy. Very active in his teaching and is really funny. He knew all our names by the 2nd week. He doesn't use a textbook - there are assigned readings out of some books. His weekly assignments are a little confusing, but nonetheless he's a quality guy. I'd recommend him.

Discussion Leader for Kelley Massoni's class. Super easy. Quizzes (2 of the lowest dropped), attendance, participation, and two short papers made up your grade. He was always VERY helpful with the papers, and the quizzes are open reading and open technology (bring your laptop and use the Ctrl+F function!). Pooya was great.
Pooya is very energetic, and you can tell that he really enjoys what he is teaching about. He is completely clear and attendence is not mandatory.

Pooya is the nicest guy! Attendance isn't mandatory, but I guarantee you will not miss a class...he is so engaging! The course material was interesting and he was always willing to help out if you had a question.  Not to mention, he is GORGEOUS. He won't be teaching next semester, but the next class he does teach, I'm signing up!!!

Awesome teacher and the class is very engaging. I found the class interesting since it pertained to real world matters so paying attention was actually easy for once. An A is very obtainable, a B should be a lock.
Very good teacher and good looking too :)
Pooya is an awesome teacher. His class is interesting and easy. He always wears v-necks.

Very interesting lectures, he really cares about teaching and making it applicable to real life.  I took the class as my last gen ed and found it to be my favorite of the semester.  Doesn't hurt that he's extremely easy on the eyes!
I had him for Soc 104 and took Soc 220 just because he was teaching it. He is very good and knows his stuff!
