Prof. Singh is a terrible professor. He will lecture you for the entire class, and frequently became frustrated when the class didn't know the answer to questions. The tests are purely based off the lectures. It is impossible to learn unless you have a photographic memory. The good news is everyone does so bad on his tests so theres a massive curve
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: No laptops in class. His lectures are very boring with vague slides. Does not get the class interactive what so ever and makes lectures go the full time. He is a caring professor but does not know how to engage with his students. He curved one of our exams 20% which goes to show the material he teaches us does not relate to exams. Would not take

He does ban laptops and phones. Attendance counts, daily classes are lectures with occasional group presentations. Exams were not too difficult, he does curve a good amount. Assignments are just short essays about required readings. Group projects are presentations, fairly easy
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: No phone or laptop policy in class. Was a very interesting teacher, and I enjoyed it. If you put 0 effort into the class or don't pay attention, expect a poor grade. I paid attention in class and I'm ending up with a B+ or A- without studying for the exams. Really cool guy who works with you as long as you are respectful and put the time intoclass.

Professor Singh is an amazing teacher and I loved his class. He taught global marketing for me and it was a struggle. But he helps you so much if you just simply ask him for help. He is incredibly knowledgeable and knows when you are confused. Amazing professor, hope to stay in contact with him.

Professor Singh is the best professor I have had at KU. He's funny, caring, and lets you know through both his words and actions that he is not trying to screw over his students. He wants you to succeed, and does whatever he can to help. He really goes the extra mile to make his students know that he is invested in their growth and learning.

One of the worst professors I've had. The first two tests were curved by 11% and 14% because the test study guides were no help. Very nit-picky multiple choice questions after 6-7 weeks of material made studying seem impossible. Loves to answer questions with another question. Class is insanely boring. Slides were vague. Very nice man, bad teacher.

I normally don't feel sad at the end of semesters when leaving professors, but for some reason, I choked up a little when leaving this man. Very funny. Down to earth. And love. Has real... genuine love for mankind. Very happy guy. His happiness is very contagious. Do take him! No textbook required. Attendance isn't required but u wont wanna miss.

Definitely recommend taking his class. One of the best teachers I have had in the b-school. Very smart guy who will help you in any way he can. Genuinely cares about the students and what they get from the class. Take his class if you have the opportunity!
Prof Six is so knowledgeable and kind. She will always help you if you come to her with questions. I'm really going to miss being in her class
Always tells funny stories about her kids. Great Professor, loved her class.

People say that Six is supposedly caring and tries her best to help students outside of class, but I did not see such treatment. Her feedback was not helpful and sometimes it felt like she did not want me to succeed.

Professor Six is amazing! She is very clear and concise with her lectures. She makes being a "good" (we all suck at first) legal writer attainable. DO THE LIVE GRADING FOR EVERY PAPER that she offers it. Her feedback in person is really helpful and she'll make you a much better writer. She's also really approachable and will make time for you.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I have never had a professor as unhelpful as Six. She required papers to be written a certain way and then would not help you AT ALL in office hours. She would only repeat things (never actually explain them better) and did little to engage her students. The only positive thing I can say is she was very knowledgeable about grammar.
Joan Sereno is such a good prof
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She really cares about teaching the next generation of linguists, and even if its just to get a core goal out of the way she still just wants people to love the field that she too loves. She is so nice, understanding, and very knowledgeable in her field. Fantastic. If you have the opportunity to take one of her classes, DO SO.

Dr. Sereno someone that you don't want to miss out on. I had never taken a linguistics class prior, nor was it directly relevant to my major, however this was a fantastic class that I won't forget. I mostly attribute that to Dr. Sereno's enthusiasm, understanding nature, and her overall amazing personality. I definitely recommend taking her class.

she is a good professor, nice and patient to her students, you need to go to lab section as well. exams are all based on her lecture slides and reading materials. So please prepare for the exams well, and you will receive a fair grade.
Basically show up to class and you should get a good grade. She gives out study guides for every test, so tests are extremely easy. Reading really isn't necessary. Lots of free points.

Dr. Sereno is hilarious and I love the way she teaches.  She puts up note packets to take notes on and posts all of her powerpoints on Blackboard which is really resourceful! Her discussion TAs are super great and she just makes a subject that you would think to be boring, really interesting!

She was a truly incredible teacher. Everyone respects her and the class teaches you a lot of fun and interesting things. She puts a lot of work into making sure that the subject of linguistics is fascinating for everyone, not just people interested in languages. If you go to class, study, and do all of the reading assignments, you will be fine.

Probably one of my favorite professors. Teaches with contagious enthusiasm and makes the fundamentals of linguistics easy to understand. Very lively, funny, and kind. Truly goes above and beyond to help students succeed. LING110 isn't hard to begin with, but Dr. Sereno definitely enhances it. Attend class, read, take notes, and you'll be fine.

Dr. Sereno gets so excited by linguistics, it's kind of infectious. She cares more about you enjoying class and being part of the conversation than she does making sure you know every tiny thing. Tests are fairly easy, mostly simple memorization. The notes she provides are lifesavers, but don't neglect the reading.
Very good professor. She is clear cut and wants everybody to pass. She is also very approachable and answers all questions. Should get an A if you go to lecture and discussion.

Four insanely easy tests. Four homework assignments including two essays. If you put in a little effort you can get an A on the essays. Meant to be an easy gen ed. Textbook isn't really necessary but showing up to lecture is beneficial.

Dr. Sereno is very thorough in her lectures but her power points are just snip its of things she also discussing so attending class is very helpful. Tests are pretty difficult so I recommend studying before each one. You also have to take a lecture course with it and those have weekly quizzes that can bring your grades down if you don't go.

This was such a fun class! I am a Linguistics major so I may be biased, but she made everything super interesting. She lets you use a notecard on the International Phonetics Alphabet test and did not have a final. The last test was before the last two lectures, so you got extra credit if you went to those. Definitely an enjoyable class.
Great lectures that went by fast because she was entertaining and lively.

Dr. Sereno is a great lecturer and is obviously passionate about her work. She is readily available if help is needed. The coursework is easy, however, retrieving the content necessary for coursework from BB is much harder than it needs to be. No one should ever be forced to download Internet Explorer just to view a 30 minute video.
Awesome professor, easy class, not much work, just study for test and do few fun assignments.

Amazing lecturer. Maybe the best I've had thus far. Not a subject I was super interested in but she made the material interesting and the textbooks were easy reads. One of my best classes this semester, really enjoyed it. Grading is four tests and a few assignments for the discussion class. Would recommend this class to anybody.
She is knowledgeable, fair and makes the class interesting. Exams were easy and classes were informative.
Dr. Sereno is knowledgeable, approachable, and available.  She goes out of her way to make the exams fair.  Be sure to do the reading and you will do well in this class.

Sereno is awesome. She makes lecture outlines that you can print out prior to class & all of the notes follow the outline.  She also shows many videos to help us understand the material.  The discussion classes really help as well. it is a great class to take!

Very straightforward with information. She makes things really easy to understand. TAs are also very helpful. Tests are easy; class was a breeze. Didn't have to attend, but I did because she made the info interesting.

Great professor with really helpful TAs.  If you speak any language you need to take this class.  Material is very interesting and tests and assignments are extremely easy.  Super nice and approachable professor.
Dr. Sereno is awesome! Attendance is not madatory, but lecture was interesting and enjoyable! Her TAs are great also.  This class truly made me consider linguistics for a major.

Dr. Sereno is by far the best professor on campus. This class is easy but very interesting. I am an linguistics major though, so my opinion may be a bit skewed. Go to lectures and discussion, no need to read book. She gives you a note card for the test.

Dr. Sereno is an amazing professor! She definitely knows her material and is extremely helpful when you don't understand something. Besides that, she's also very funny and makes the class enjoyable and engaging. Highly recommend taking her classes.

A great professor! Her lectures are easy to follow even without her organized powerpoints. She gives helpful study guides before each exam & answers questions clearly & entirely. Not only is she smart, but she's always willing to help. I hope to take more classes from Sereno.
Best professor on campus!

She is amazing! If you are taking hard courses and need a class as a easy elective, this is the class! She puts her outlines up couple days before her exams, but trust me you only need like 5 hours to study for each exam to get an A. She gives plenty of extra credit that you don't have to worry about your grade in there. The TAs are helpful too!
Amazing class! She is seriously one of the best professors at KU. She helped me so much, and her TA's are also equally as amazing. TAKE THIS CLASS!

She's clearly a genius but definitely not a snob. She's always very happy and engaging. I never had a problem paying attention in class and she breaks down the information so you can understand it. Plus, we got to use note cards on the test. I recommend this class to all my friends.
She's one of the best professors on campus for sure

Dr. Sereno is a great lecturer who is very engaging. The class is easy while still being very informative. This is the perfect class for someone who is considering the major or who is interested in knowing more about the subject because it covers all areas of linguistics. You will leave the class with a new perspective on language.

There is a reason that Joan and all of her kin keep getting rewards and commendations, and that is because they're all brilliant.  between Joan and her husband, I'm pretty sure they make Stephen Hawking re-evaluate his life choices.  Her breadth of knowledge on pretty much all aspects of linguistics, and especially psycholinguistics is impressive t
Dr. Sereno is soooo nice and despite the fact that her class is easy there is a lot of information.  She's extremely intelligent and her tests are not difficult.  I LOVE JOAN SERENO!!!
Joan is pretty much awesome. If you're thinking about taking a class from her, do it. She's enthusiastic and helpful and engaging.
As a linguist, I am enamored by her love for linguistics, and her expanse of knowledge. She clearly enjoys what she is teaching and enjoys the students who are learning it.

She is the greatest professor ever!!!Her lecture is really exciting and I am certain you will NEVER get bored!She is always very nice to everyone and really cares about her students.   SHE IS AWESOME!! TAKE THIS CLASS if you want to make your college life enjoyable!!!!
Dr. Sereno is a GREAT teacher. I would recommend any class from her. I enjoyed the class and got a good grade. I barely read the readings, but still got A's on every test. Also, there's no final!

Nice and very fun. Take this  instead of LING106! Read the texts, they will appear on the tests but you probably won't talk about them in class much if at all. Great class, just go to lecture and read! If you miss a lecture she will go over the main points the next class, so don't miss 2 in a row or you'll be lost. Tests are multiple choice & T/F.

she is so friendly and holds very interesting lectures. the class was great and if you miss a class you will be fine, going to the discussion is helpful and cuts your study time in half. I never read the text book, and only studied for about 1 or 2 hours the night before the test and got an A
Loved this professor, she really knows how to teach. She's very dedicated and into what she does.
LOVE HER! Easy class- you might not have to go every single time, but you will want to becasue she is interesting and funny. Wonderful teacher- highly recommended.
She is so enthusiastic and makes classes really interesting and fun!

She's a really great professor.  She's funny, enthusiastic, and obviously loves to teach.  Tests and assignments are very fair, and she's really helpful in and outside of class.  Take any course from her that you can.

Joan is very knowledgeable and enthusiastic about teaching. The "Language and Mind" course she offers is very interesting. You can learn a lot of fun factor about language. It is a great class for linguistics. She is also the kindest and most patient mentor I have ever met. Her classes are highly recommended.

ARCH 747– Prof. Silva is laid back and lenient. He is not very involved, but for this class it isn't really necessary. It was meant to be in person, but was moved to online/zoom. He gives you a lot of time do your work and isn't a tough grader.
Detached. Not invested in me clearly. Very disappointing. Not able to communicate professionally.

Kapila is an amazing and fun studio professor. He genuinely cares about his students and ensures that they have a life outside of studio. The way he maps out the semester guarantees that. However, if you want to take him, you MUST know your way around the software. If you let the software hold you back, you may not get the project you hoped for.

Professor Silva is the professor to take if you truly desire excellence. His class is the most difficult I have taken at KU and I had many sleepless nights. However, he will push you to be the best. The projects from students in his class always stand out.
taught me how to communicate as an architect; he really understands economy and concise thought.  he does expect alot and is not shy about telling you what he thinks.

Ben is a very fun professor, and his lectures were easy to digest. However, the tests in this class were VERY difficult since there is multiple choice, short answer, and an essay question all within a 75 minute class period. There are no practice exams for this class, so studying is tricky. I will definitely be taking more classes from Ben though.
A great, fun guy. Beware though, tests are often very challenging!
A very fun and energetic professor. Tests can be hard though, be prepared to study!

If you get a chance to take a class with Ben, do it! He's the most fun, caring, passionate professor I've ever had. He talks to you like a peer instead of a student, which is really refreshing in a college environment. The guy knows his stuff and is always excited to share it.

One of those classes where you can tell the professor has been reusing the same slideshow for years without updating it. He was not very good at explaining things and was unclear what was expected on writing portions of the exams.

Only professor I've had with pop quizzes, but they're very easy if you just watch the pre-lecture videos and take notes. Semester long research/group project. Exams were easy because Dr. Sikes made it extremely clear exactly what was going to be on them. Two field trips were fun. I learned a ton about fungi. He even cooked for us in class one time.

Dr. Sikes was one of the coolest, kindest professors I've ever had. I will definitely take a class with him again if I get the chance. BIOl414 was also a pretty easy, interesting class. Just do the readings before class and show up to lecture. There's also 2pt extra credit assignments you can do after every class, which is super nice.

go to his office hours and he will help you with your paper and really help you think through it, also then you will have something to talk about in your reflection. Often times the reflection is lengthy and worth a lot especially on final paper.
He was a good teacher.
Dave was a great teacher. He had a great personality and tried to make the class as interesting as he could.
Loved having Dave as my English teacher, he grades a little tough but fair and has a hilarious personality. Would take his class again if I could
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: David was a great teacher! He gave me fair grades and good feedback on what he was looking for on each assignment. All assignments that weren't big projects were completion points, and there were plenty of opportunities to make up absences/missed work.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He is an overall really chill teacher. He tends to curse, but he notifies the class that that's his personality. Lecture is a friendly environment, but he is a very detailed grader of papers. He does give personal feedback on papers, which helps a lot!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He is an amazing teacher and an all around great guy. He goes out of his way to help his students succeed. If you speak Portuguese or Spanish, he will only ever speak with you in that language, in or out of class. I learned so much in the classes I took from him. Highly recommended!
His tests are usually all essay based on class discussion. He is a very good language teacher too.
He's a great teacher that teaches a language the way it is supposed to be taught. There is a lot of activity in each class and interaction with other students.
Her lectures are enough to do well in the exam. The textbook is more of a supplement than the main material. The practice exam is also very reflective of her exam style.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Slusky wasn't a poor professor. She makes her expectations clear, and exams are never deceptive; spend time with the lecture slides while studying. However, there were several instances where her lack of preparedness wasted so much time that it bordered on insulting. "Poor" motivation isn't always a student's fault (see previous rating)

The complaints here are likely from students who didn't want to put in the appropriate effort, then got mad about the consequences of their laziness. Dr. Slusky gives info-rich lectures and definitely tries to teach you what you'll need to succeed in the biosciences. Glad to have had her.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof Slusky taught the last 1/4 of our class. Her lectures actually explained the material. Only tested on what she lectured. Her tests were not too difficult if you watched her lectures & paid attention. She answered all emails & worked to explain topics I was confused on. Only things I learned in the whole class were from her. Saved my grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Richter is absolutely amazing, I received a 95+ on all three of his exams. I genuinely believe Slusky's purpose in life is to make things as difficult as possible for students. I think she really enjoys fighting with students on grades because she refused to round numerous 89% exams... Terrible lectures and an even worse person. drop slusky from636
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I found professor Slusky's lectures to be well organized and engaging. I really liked the way she outlined the main concepts at the beginning of lecture and then recapped at the end. Biochem is tough, and lipids and membrane dynamics are complex topics, so you definitely need to read and study hard for her test.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Tests are very confusing and the class material isn't well organized due to her unclear delivery method. Read the book. As I am told she is known for research but not teaching. Exceptional knowledge base without the ability to adequately deliver it to students. She should stick to research

She tries really hard at teaching, but you can tell she's unclear about what she's teaching. She gives a lot of indefinite answers. The subject material is easy, but her test was super confusing. It's harder to figure out what she's asking than it is to answer the question. If you ask her about a question, she won't clarify it either.

Slusky is rather confusing while lecturing. Many of times she seems unsure of herself and is all over the place. This leads to a lot of confusion in students. However, she does do a couple online lectures that are far more organized. You must read the book for this class. Exam is tough but not impossible. Memorize your amino acids!

Terribly unclear at almost every turn. A professor known mostly for research, I'm not sure if she's taught a day in her life. One of four professors teaching the class. Overall she simply has a hard time communicating her knowledge in a way that makes sense.
always mad looking man with weak teaching skill, had temper, used foul language in his office, made an error in grading and didn't fix clerical error (cost me 20 points in final exam).

Really knows his stuff and his lectures are clear, but very boring due to the subject matter (not his fault). His problem sets can range from easy to extremely difficult, but exams are not much different from the homework. Study the problem sets and you'll pass.

Dr. Sicilian is a brilliant professor. He takes a complex topic and strips it down to its most understandable form.  His lectures are meticulous and he ensures that every student understands the fundamentals of microeconomic theory. Another excellent professor within KU's economics department.

The lectures are dry but if you're trying at all to pay attention to WHAT he's saying, it's really quite interesting. He has a better grasp on economics(or at least how to teach it) than other professors I've seen. ASK THIS PROFESSOR QUESTIONS OUTSIDE OF THE COURSEWORK. He really knows what he's talking about and he will engage you. Great proff.

Stands at front of class all hour not moving unless he sees a phone out then he's all over that person. Tests are literally verbatim off the study guide so you'll want to prepare for them about a week in advance b/c the study guides are long. Jot notes in your PRGM in your calculator (on the first 3 tests) if you're feeling lazy and want an easy A.

This course is tough in some ways, but prof Sicilian certainly makes learning the material significantly less difficult. All the attendant concepts are contained within the lectures and explained well. The homework provides more than adequate preparation for the exams (it is significantly more difficult, but the same sort of problems).

He is one of the best professors I learned from. He is well orgonized and konows what he is going to explain to his students. His exams may be long but if you study well, you would probably got A's. His office is open to all students all the times.

Finding out that this guy is the head of the econ department makes me think that my degree will be absolutely worthless in the real world. He composes himself like an insecure candypants and cannot teach. Makes tons of mistakes and is unreasonable. Might be suitable for easy lower level classes but should be allowed to teach the real deal

God-Awful. This class is a great sedative and will keep you sawing logs for fifty minutes. He fails to explain anything greatly and stands still for the entire class period. It is awful and I do not reccomend him as a teacher to anyone.

Yes you WILL fall asleep in class. His test are 30 questions so if you miss 3 thats a B. What kind of test is that?! He is very boring and Aplia is easy but it is a small chunk of your grade. I would NOT recommend him as a teacher. The only time towards the end that I went to class was to dicussion because he is very boring.

Boring teacher -.- !!!!! but this is an easy class. Make sure you review the test material on the blackboard site before you take the test.  Go to the discussion section and you'll be fine (they cover all the material in class in an easy way !!!) Take this class with a friend so you guys can "cheat" during the attendance quiz ^^
Very boring during lectures. If you go to discussion and do your Aplia homework, you'll get just as much info as if going to lecture. Do review problems from Blackboard and you'll do fine on tests.

To sum up this class.. If you go to class you will fall asleep or be tempted to leave. This class is extremely easy. You can complete the class successfully if 1) You know how to do all the study questions 2) Repeatedly run thru study questions 2-3 hours prior to exam 3) Complete aplia homework 4) Show up to discussion 5) Obtain important informati
Prof Sicilian makes complex concepts understandable and worth understanding.  Really got me in to economics.
For the tests, just study the review and you should be fine but he might throw in some tricky problems where you have to use different formulas for the same problem.

Took Econ 144 with him Fall 07, and it was a cakewalk. My easiest class of the semester by far. You do have to go to class, but that's easy attendence points anyway. Homework is probably the hardest thing in the class, but it's not that bad. Test are just like the review questions...Incredibly easy to study for.

The worst lectures I've had to attend. Despite my best efforts I always fall asleep. If you read the book and do the practice problems the lecture & discussion class are redundant and completely unnecessary. Overall, a waste of time.

This is by far the easiest class i have EVER taken at a university. His lectures are boring, and i usually text messaged or read the paper. He gives quizzes for attendance tho. The homework is the easiest thing ever along with his tests. If you dont get an A in this class, you should drop out of school.

Sicilian does not hold a comprehensive or intelligent class at all. Instead he forces mandatory attendance in a budig size class (unheard of) and holds the most boring lectures I have ever heard in my life. His tests should be easy, but for whatever reason I as well as the rest of the class have struggled (20/30 class avg). DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!
This class is so boring! and he takes attendence in a huge lecture and will yell at people for leaving in the middle of class. dont take this class if you dont plan on going to it.
I had this class on Fall05 and yeah it was so easy that I only had to take 3 tests out of 4, which were the only times I went to class !! Oh yeah, forgot to mention: I made an A :)

I had this class in Spring 05, but I hear it has gotten harder since then.  This was, by far, the EASIEST class I've ever taken at KU, and maybe in my life.  Sicilian got his point across (though lectures were boring, and not necessary to attend) pretty well.  The tests were based off the online homework, which was a cake-walk in itself.

This guy has a pretty easy class if you do the homework and study from the homework. However, he sucks as a teacher and is completly incompetent when it comes to teaching the material and making the tests.

I'm sure that he knows the information that the class is supposed to cover, he just cannot convey it to anybody else with any success.  Luckily, if you read the book and do the homework, his tests are cake.

Class material may be difficult for students with no exposure to economics, but he makes most things fairly easy to understand, sometimes to the point of being repetitive.  If you read the book and do the homework, the tests are easy.  Over half of the messages in my email are from him answering student questions.
Class is very boring but not too hard. All lecture slides are online, and tests aren't too hard either. He makes a lot of mistakes though which is annoying.
Very clear lecture and easy to understand.  Exams very easy too.

Professor Sicilian is a highly intelligent man who is very capable of teaching economics. He tries to make ECON144 as easy as possible, and as such, makes the lectures repetative to the book. His heart is in the right place, and the material in this class is highly useful to all individuals in any profession.

very knowledgeable, but home-work and test were very hard and confusing. I could tell that only few (2-3) students fully understood the calculations.. and materials....The final was worth 50%  of Total grade..and it was mad..
He is so boring to listen to and there is no point to going to class.  The online homework is so repetative and long.  The class is easy though.

This class is so dumbed down and cheesy, I have no respect for it.  Sicilian has a lisp (you can imagine how that affects the pronounciation of his name) and is frustrating to tolerate in class.  He covers the material we were already assigned, so going to class is pointless.  At least I'll get an A
Slusky is a great professor. Just be ready to pay attention during lecture and do the practice problems. The class moves quickly so you have to stay on top of the material.
He's very willing to meet with students the class is a matter of effort. If you're taking a lot of classes it won't go well, but if you want to learn He's your guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He was a great professor! A little on the quick side, but if you take good notes in class you'll be fine. You can drop one or both midterms if you do well on the final, so that's really nice. Very math intensive, so have you calc skills ready. Most importantly, he is a very nice person, and is very involved with his students.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: If you miss the lectures it would be hard to catch up. He's a great professor but he is very fast so you really have to be attentive. Exams are hard, you actually have to practice the problems. The class average was usually about 50% but don't worry there's a huge curve and he drops one or both of your midterms if you do better on the final.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Great teacher. Class moves fast with a lot of calculus involved, but if you can follow the math, it will make plenty of sense. Very helpful outside of class with homework and general questions about other classes/jobs/research/etc.

HW is completion, lectures were clear but he goes fast and you need a good grasp of calculus. Tests are over a large amount of material and pick very specific problems (that may not be on the hw). This was his first semester teaching so he may have gotten better but test averages were really low (pretty substantial curve at the end though)

What everyone said is right. Tests are very hard and its very math based. He does go very fast and it will be easy to lose track in class. My final grade was good(because of the sympathetic curve) but first 2 tests were horrible.

The only issue is that he goes over the material way too fast, especially in the math. Got an 95% on Test 1 and a 30% on Test 2 and 93% on the final, did all HW, attended all lectures, and lots of self studying. Ended up with an A because he dropped Test 2. If you don't want to take a chance with curves, and aren't strong in math, don't take him.

I was clueless on what is going on the entire semester. He teaches really fast and makes things difficult. First midterm avg was 41%, second was 15% for both his sections combined. I did terrible on both, but did the HW, never missed a class. Somehow got a B- with a class curve. He is willing to help, very tough, but wants us to succeed.

She is helpful getting through the class with Rowland, but honestly she is obsessed with debate and makes it impossible to get ahold of her. Her office hours were during the lecture hours (probably so she could do debate instead) so I skipped the lecture because she wasn't replying to emails and she still wouldn't give me the time of day.

Talya was my TA and the only reason I made it through Coms 235 with a decent grade. She's extremely caring and down to earth. She went out of her way to help me navigate Rowland's class and was very patient with my struggles. Talya's very knowledgeable and a Great teacher!! Take her!!
A nice girl and a hard grader. Midterms are hard. Speeches are clear but you should prepare very well to get a good grade.
Amazing professor! She is the reason I am majoring in communications. An absolute delight and I'm sure she will make a difference in this world; probably as president.
Prof. Slagle organized the course so that we could get the most out of it. Sometimes hard to do in an online course. Reading is heavy, but applicable to class.
Love how he was student-centered about all the work and assignments.
Overall was an okay class. Must be a self-learner to average good grade. Assigns 2-3 papers a week with an average of 5 pages per paper.
A great class and a very helpful prof.

Amanda is a very good professor. She is more than willing to help anyone who asks, and she always responds to emails in a timely manner. The class has interesting material, but the class activities can be severely boring at times. Overall, I would recommend her class though.
She is probably my favorite professor at KU. She is very helpful and if you actually try, you'll get an A+.

Amanda is amazing even though she is a teacher she is a student as well & she just gets you. There is reading assignments every night then class discussions the following class period. 3 major papers, 3 mini papers, 20 min discussion leading, and a 10 min presentation. Sounds like a lot but it is not bad. this was my fav class take her if you can!!
She's a great, hardworking teacher. She's very clear, and she's really fun!

Best teacher I've had at KU so far! For intro and intermediate stats he makes his own guided notes booklet, which makes understanding the material and reviewing easier. There are no tests in 516, just 7 long assignments.

One of the best professors I have had at KU! He is very knowledgeable on the subject and is very willing to help students. Tests are not bad as long as you review the material. Allows you to use a front and back page cheat sheet on tests. Class is based on tests, homework, and clicker questions.

The course notes are provided in a spiral-book format. He teaches directly from the notes. Studying for this class is easy because of the very well organizational skills of Prof. Slocum. Attending class is mandatory if you want an A. Caring Teacher. Willing to Help.
He tries to put a lot of content in his classes. Good value. The prof. is also very willing to discuss research ideas with you and quite helpful.

Great teacher, very knowledgeable of subject and very willing to help with anything. Tests are long, but not hard if you attend class and take the notes in the book he provides for you. Gives the option to make a full page front and back cheat sheet for the tests too.
One of the friendlest professors here. He is quite caring and understanding, and the classes are all very good. You should have no problem if you do some of the reading and attend the lectures/labs.

Excellent professor, very clear presentation of material, makes sure everyone understands before moving on, always ready to listen to students' views on the subject, offers tons of feedback on written papers, overall, one of the best professors I've had.
Very knowledgeable.  Very intense. Very dedicated.  Listens seriously to your ideas.

Ben was a GREAT professor. He is a complete genius and you can tell how much he likes the curriculum and his students. Best TA I've ever had.  He can be a bit rough when grading papers but always offers constructive criticism which helped me become a much better writer.

I never got to see Ben, but he was extremely fair with his grading. He grades papers a bit rough but if you meet his guidelines and criteria you should be fine! The class is amazing and you learn quite a bit, the only poor thing I have to say is I wish I would of taken it on campus and not online!

LOVED this class! I had learned some Greek myth in high school, but not nearly as much as I learned in this class! The class consists of 3 exams, 1 10 min. presentation, and (almost) daily homework assignments (1 page responses). Participation and attendance are a part of the grade. Ben is a super cool guy, I would highly recommend this class!

Doesn't just teach you how to do the bare minimum, but really makes you understand what you are doing and why. Some students think he gives them more explanation than they actually want, but this is the only effective way to teach stats. In this class you actually learn.
BEST STATS PROFESSOR EVER. Will make stats seem crystal-clear like first grade math. I TRULY understood concepts I had previously only "learned."

Billy is, hands down, the best professor I have had for a statistics course. I consitently learn more in his courses, and though the material is very challenging, I feel much more confident in my own skills and abilities afterwards. Amazing professor!!

One of the BEST professors you'll encounter anywhere.  Knows his field well, and is MASTERFUL in explaining how it works.  You could search for years before finding a better person from whom to learn ANOVA.

Dr. Skorupski is one of the best! He's knowledgeable, very organized, communicates well, and really cares about the students learning. Nerdly! Plenty of well-planned homeworks and nice, challenging tests. :) He puts his AWESOME class notes online before class. Print 'em out, show up, and soak it in!

She made this class really interesting.  There was a lot of in depth information, but we had a quiz on each chapter instead of huge tests, which made it easier to learn.  Lots of videos, quests, and online class interaction.  I didn't need to take this class, but I'm glad I did.

It is easy material if you go to class, study, etc.  She shows a lot of movies, clips, you tube, etc.  She really likes what she is teaching about and is very knowledgabe, which helped a lot.  Tried to make the material interesting, but just like any other big class with a lot of people it was a bit boring.

Very easy class. Didn't even have to take notes all semester, because she put all the power points on blackboard and that is where nearly every question to each test comes from.  Do the study guide she gives you before each test or else you most likely will not do good on the tests
much like a high school health class, maybe a bit more in-depth, happy with the class, need to study for tests or you will do poorly.  does give points for being in class.
Really easy class, but you do need to go, or have a friend sign you in and turn in the worthless worksheets. her tests were somewhat wordy, but overall really easy class. she is really boring though!
extremely boring teacher, but the class is a joke. Easiest class i've ever taken.
Very nice and helpful. Pretty easy class but still interesting.
No Comments

Dr. Smith was phenomenal and it makes me sad to see her poor rating. I took her Bees class which was so interesting and fun. She takes notes and learns everyone's name at the beginning of the year. Her lectures are interesting but they are lengthy and it is hard to stay focused. She is honestly one of the sweetest professors I have had at KU.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Took a biology of spiders class as an extra "easier" class among the rest. There was SO much work, quizzes every week, and the assignments were graded incredibly hard. Our midterm was huge, plus a 2 part final and 10 page paper. the second part of my final and paper never got graded & I spent hours on them. Got an A in the class, but not worth it.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: Yikes. I'll start off with the good - Dr. Smith is a nice lady and has cool purple streaks in her hair. Beyond that, there isn't much to say. To put it mildly, her lectures are incredibly boring and difficult to follow. I am a bio major and even I despised the class. It somehow made me hate organismal/evolutionary bio even more than I already did.

-I would never suggest to take this class ever! She is not helpful at all. She is really sweet outside of class, but she never even has any office hours scheduled, so no one ever really sees her outside of class. - She makes things more difficult than they need to be and has put stuff on exams that was never lectured over. Beware taking this class

Deb is a cool lady. She studies spiders, has purple hair, and really cares about what shes teaching. However, she tends to ramble and her lectures are hard to follow. A lot of times, the tests are more lecture based than textbook based so be in class and pay attention. Is also very bad with technology.

Dr. Smith is a super nice and caring person. Her lecturing style is random and hard to follow though. She gives away test questions in office hours sometimes. Lots of group work. Some tests were really hard (plants) and others were super easy. The test questions were really vague, so ask them to clarify during the test if you don't know.

Interesting lady. Had blue highlights the first week of the semester then purple a few weeks later. Not clear on essay assignments or expectations. Rambles a lot. Her grading doesn't make much sense. It kindof seems like she just pulls a grade from the air. She'll give you the grade you deserve in the end.

Got an A somehow; still not sure how. Lectures were better than Ballantyne's, but still uninteresting, and I love biology. Don't take this class unless you took AP Biology in HS, because there is far too much material to call this an introductory course. Doesn't understand student motivations; once said after receiving an email about grading that she hates students who care more about a grade than learning. Was rude and condescending. Also has 4 browsers on her computer, for variety, I suppose.

Unclear in her methods and condescending toward her students. Her grading is very, very harsh! I don't think anyone got an A in her class. Once, when a student of hers emailed her asking what they should study for the final, she replied that there's nothing she hates more than a student who cares more about their grade than their learning.
looks at you as if you were an idiot.  Also not very open minded or open to interpretation
Great teacher who knows her stuff. Unlike most other science teachers, she leans towards the students' benefit when it comes to grading. Lots of extra credit opportunities.
Really nice teacher.  She has nice power points and is funny.

I appreciate Kent's kindness and enthusiasm—he clearly cares about his students. That said, his teaching style didn't work for me. I often found his explanations unclear.  I think the class would benefit from more concise and structured instruction. The projects were fun, but they sometimes lacked clear direction or deeper purpose.

Kent yapped too much, project brief days never made sense. He wasn't my direct studio professor but he was always popping in and looking at our stuff. It was honestly disruptive, he ran all three studios like they were all his when in reality, they weren't.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I've taken 3 classes with him, and Kent Smith is an amazing professor who I will be sad to leave. He cares a lot about his students and is very fun. He also gives wonderful feedback and I feel like I've improved so much. However, the workload is the heaviest of all my classes, and Kent will expect you to finish it all to a high degree.

Kent is a patient and fun first year teacher for BDS classes. He gives good feedback and helps push your designs to the next level. He is also willing to help you out if you ask questions. Yes, the lectures are about 3 hours long but the homework will take even longer. Make sure to bring snacks and set aside studio time to get your projects done.

Kent is the goat, not much to be said. Super approachable. He wasn't even my professor but it felt like he was teaching my class. Even after freshman year if I see him around, I go to him for help when I need anything. Cares about his students and is knowledgeable.
What an amazing teacher and hilarious guy. No clue why he's teaching, he could be taking over the design world.

Kent is an amazing professor and a really great guy. He is super approachable and makes an effort to build connections with his students. He will be honest with you about your work but is always super kind about it (as long as you are putting in effort)

I honestly loved kent so much. His class challenge me a lot and stressed me out but I made a lot of friends and learned a lot from him. He helps everyone so much and wants you to succeed. Sometimes he can be vague on projects but is always fast to answer questions!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Kent is the nicest teacher I've ever had. You can talk to him about anything and on projects, even if your project is literally a piece of paper he will still find a way to give good feedback. I'm taking another one of his classes next semester and I can't wait.

Kent has a really laid back personality and he's a genuinely kind person. However, his grading can be a little brutal, but it's usually for a good reason. I saw him and his family in a taco shop, nice people.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Kent seems like a nice guy. However I personally hated his class. I am by no means a horrible artist and do enjoy drawing from time to time. But I struggled with this class and found the workload to be too much for a full time college student. If you don't enjoy drawing you better learn to love it around Kent. Suggest taking with another Prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Kent is one of my favorite teachers I've ever had. I've taken various classes with him but this time around illustration was a lot more than the previous classes. At times the coursework expected felt overwhelming, but in the end Kent is just trying to push his students to be the best them. Take Kent and you will seriously grow so much.

Kent is a wonderful dude. He's obviously extremely passionate about what he does, and he seems genuinely happy to be there everyday. As long as you put effort in the work you give him, you'll do just fine. He looks for personal growth, not just technical skill. Also the dude is hilarious and is generally pretty caring when you're having issues.

Took intro to Animation as an extra studio so I was definitely not as qualified as the rest of the people taking the class, but no matter everyone's skill level he was proud of the work that was done and as long as you pushed yourself it was good. Never saw an actual grade for the class through the whole thing, so it was hard to tell where I stood.
Best professors Ive had here at KU. Teaches you everything you would need to know and is always available if you have a question.

Kent's a good professor and is very passionate about what he teaches, which shows in his enthusiasm in class. He's a real tough grader and expects you to work super hard, but is kind of minimalist with his feedback so sometimes it's hard to figure out what direction you need to take to tackle the rest of your project.

Truly inspiring. The best teacher I've ever had. He pushes you to do the best you can do and helps you figure out how to do it. He's invested in each and every one of his students and he really cares if you succeed. Kent has helped me gain confidence in my work and in myself. Great teacher, great guy, great artist.

kent is a strong teacher, but you really have to push him to get good feedback. he really cares about you and wants you to succeed though, so as long as you show up with the work and put in effort based on his comments then you'll succeed in his class.   also don't take his class if you hate the word 'celebrate'

Kent is by far just one of those people you respect so much because of how much he cares about art.  He is so outgoing and loud and ready to voice how you can change a project in innovative ways.  He likes to get others involved with how you can fix your project.  He is by far the most passionate person I have ever met.

As a non-drawing kid, I was absolutely terrified that I was required to take a drawing class. I took Kent because of how highly others recommended him, and I'm so glad I did. He really pushed me to care and improve while making it clear that I was being graded not on the quality of work I produced necessarily, but by the effort I put in.

A very inspiring, understanding, insightful, and helpful teacher. The perfect guy to have help you when starting out in design. He has high expectations, but pushes you (in a nice way) to achieve them. By far the best teacher I've ever had.

Kent is the bomb dot com. Guy can turn any conversation into an inspirational speech that makes you want to punch a bear and become president of Canada. Even if you fail miserably at a piece he'll still find a way to praise it.

Kent is an ASTOUNDING teacher. He has a knack for teaching, and is wonderful at giving constructive criticism. You never feel unworthy in his class.  Makes you work for your grade, but that's only because he cares about each and every one of his students and  knows we can go above and beyond with all of our work.

Kent was my drawing teacher for first semester and I had him for one BDS project. Hes very nice and passionate about the field and teaching. He gives very good constructive criticism. He will praise you along with point out flaws but in a helpful way that doesn't feel like a stab to the gut. Overall great guy with some badass tattoos.

Kent Smith was my favorite teacher I've ever had here! He's an inspirational and amazing  teacher, with a passion for art and design. I never felt like I was doing things wrong in his class; I only felt that I could be doing things better. He gave amazing constructive criticism, emphasis on CONSTRUCTIVE! Was born to teach and is an incredible ally.

Leo is honestly a very amazing professor. Very caring and understanding and will work with you. His class is very easy to understand and do well in and I would highly recommend. Easily one of my favorite professors in all 4 years. Only thing is to memorize the fish on the practicals really well, but he even makes a quizlet and study guide for you!

Leo is the best professor I have met at KU in any department. His lectures are filled with content and he always has a story to go along with them. The class is based off of specimen lab practicals and exams. If you just go to the lectures and pay attention, with only a little outside effort a very good grade is achievable.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This was my favorite class at KU. I had professor Smith for BIOL152 too, where he was great, but he really shined in the smaller class. He cares so much and is exactly what you hope a professor will be. He is there for your, inspirational, and has developed a FUN and fair class where you learn about fishes. You will not regret taking this KU class!

He's extremely engaging, and has really interesting stories about his life. His lectures go extremely fast, but they are recorded so if you miss anything, you can go back and watch them. Do the reading before the lectures and you'll be fine. I found this class to be extremely easy, but I know lots of other people struggled with it.

Professor Smith is a cool guy who really loves biology. I've never had a fish biologist as a professor and he shared some very interesting stories about his career and biology in general. The class is not terribly hard, you just have to make sure you read the assigned chapters and take notes in class. He lectures relatively fast but records them.
He is amazing!!!!

I've taken Leo twice now, and he is by far my favorite professor at KU. He's so knowledgeable and passionate about what he teaches. If you have the opportunity to take his Ichthyology course, do it. It's such an interesting class and he make learning the not so fun fishy things fun and engaging. His GTA, Matt Girard is awesome too!

I'm currently taking  his class w Dr. Mort and I have to admit that Prof. Smith isn't the best at keeping us engaged. He puts up interesting examples but then explains them in a non-interesting way. He tries for sure but not the most engaging professor. Be ready for group work, clicker questions, and a lot of reading.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Prof. Leo Smith is passionate in what he teaches. We respect him especially because he is not merely a professor and REALLY knows what he teaches, but he also travels under his field of study and shares what he learns from his experiences. He goes slightly too fast during lectures, and group work is unnecessary, but I have learned much from him.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This was a very chill and easy class. I wouldn't say I learned much, only because it felt like Dr.Smith was talking down to her students a lot. This is a good class to take for a KU core or a pre-med requirement because if you put in a few hours a week: easy A. Don't procrastinate the research.
She is a good professor and cares about her class. It is a lot of note-taking and paying attention, but it's not that hard of a class. I really liked her and she made online class work.

she's nice for the most part, but if you have an issues regarding launchpad she's extremely unhelpful. she can come off rude in her emails, but is chill during lecture. lots of reading and note taking, this class requires hours of work if you want a good grade. overall she's okay as a teacher, but if you are someone who needs help, don't take her.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Psychology is not my intended major nor am I interested in taking a related class ever again. However, Allison made this class enjoyable! Her lectures were clear with some engaging activities. The workload was manageable and easy to maintain an A.
Dr. Smith can come across as intimidating, all he wants is the best for his students.
Kind and caring, does well to create quality band. Shows could be more demanding but I understand considering organizing 300+ people is not easy.

He's what you should expect from a director. Wants the band to look & sound our best (& makes us work for it) but is fair with accommodations when we can't do something because of time/weather/etc. Attendance & participation are required. Band is a big commitment, but incredibly rewarding. Dr Smith cares about the band, & we all love & respect him.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Has a gift for organizing the amount of band members there are with the staff he has. Shows are always large pictures, not so much animation. He brings a lot of energy and expects the same in return. Attendance is expected, missing/being late certain rehearsals will drop you a whole letter grade. KUMJ is one of the best parts of my time at college.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He could have been better. I admit he was a lot better than my high school band director, but I still didnt really care for him. He can be very confusing at times, but overall he is pretty nice. I cant say much bad about him, I just dont really care for him as a person.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Clearly shows the importance in everything he makes the band does. With help of other leadership he is organized and detail-oriented for every facet of the band. I respect him and his skills definitely show. Halftime shows aren't always the best but it definitely depends on how much time we get to prepare.

He's a great marching band director. The only thing I can complain about his marching shows is that we don't do very many animation shows. It's mostly just shapes and designs (look pretty cool, but something more would be great)

Overall, he's a good marching band director. Some of his shows seem odd and can be detailed to the point that you wonder, "why?" There can be some confusion as to what he means and what he wants, but he does clarify nicely, later. He means well for the band and it's obvious he enjoys it. He might be a little closed off to outside suggestions.

Pretty good work in his first full year as the KU Marching Band director. Experienced some pushback due to a style change from the previous director (as could be expected), but has done a good job of increasing interest level and enrollment in the Marching Band. Should be a good fit for the future.

Dr. Smith has very high expectations, however, he is the wrong match for the marching band. He is a great conductor for the KU Symphonic Band and has clear goals that he wants to establish with his students but with the Marching Jayhawks, he wants to change traditional marching styles. Nice guy and is willing to help.
Crazy. Doesn't listen to any ideas. Thinks his ideas are the greatest, when they're not. Unrealistic expectations. Too big to demonstrate how to march

Majed is good. I realized that do I not know much math and I realized that Majed knows lots of math. However he does not know how to say it all of the time. So you need to ask him for examples. I think Majed would be a better instructor if he didn't have to follow some else's contrived guidelines. Anything that resembles a "flipped" class is lazy.

Mr. Sofiani is my favorite teacher.  He may come across as a bit crazy and unorganized, but he knows his stuff.  He likes to follow what the coordinator wants to do which make it seem like he's being too harsh or whatever, but he's genuinely a good teacher.  Going to his office hours and help room really helps.  Would take him again!
He doesn't know what he is talking about- proof heavy, doesn't tell you the concepts, and makes learning difficult. May or may not have failed Calc 1 in college. DO NOT TAKE

Majed is a very nice and understanding instructor. His class was definitely one of my favorites. He often jokes and pretends to be mean, but actually, he really cares that you do well in the class and actually learn the material. His teaching style is a bit disorganized but it's nice because it's more flexible. Going to office hours helps.

I really loved Majed's class. If you put in the effort and enter the class wanting to learn, you'll really enjoy it. If not, then that sucks. Majed cares about how you do and is so funny. He knows that calc is hard so he won't move on unless he feels like most of the class understands the topics. He also teaches the fundamentals very well.

God help you if you get him as a teacher, the only thing this guy has going for him is how unintentionally funny he is when floundering around attempting to teach. He will often ask the class "Guys how does this work, seriously I don't know." He also "Forgets if he failed calc one or not." which is a wild thing to say to your calculus class.

Majed Sofiani made learning this semester very hard. He graded my homework like my aunt grades men. He makes it very hard to learn because of his sub-par teaching skills and his lectures are boring. You will basically have to teach yourself calculus. Good Luck!!!!!!!!! ;)

Very bad teacher. Doesnt know what hes talking about and knows the course content about as well as his students. We have to teach him almost every class. None of the class work appears on the homework or tests. Doesnt understand how absents work either. Worst calc teacher at KU
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Super sweet, super caring. Picks great reads and assignments. Will never make you participate when you don't feel up for it but does create good classroom conversation.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Caring

reviews.comment: Probably her biggest strength is that Dr. Lancaster is a very personal/friendly professor. She's always willing to meet with you outside of class and is very helpful.  There are A LOT of reading/ homework assignments every single night and a few difficult essay assignments. Overall, a cool professor that really challenges her students.

One of the best professors at KU hands down! She was always helpful, friendly, and encouraging to students. She responded to emails quickly and answered all my questions. The class was heavy on both reading and writing, and overall a lot of work, but so worth it! Everything is on blackboard. If you ever have the chance, take the course with her!
She was never very clear. Just wrote 4 papers. Each one she gave us a grade and then let us redo them for a higher grade. Pretty fair. She likes ALOT of input from her students ie. class discussion
She acts like students are doing very well in class then gives bad grades. Also is must unclear teacher I've ever had. Changes her mind all of the time and claims it isn't her fault.
She corrected me for being too vague on a paper and she herself is the most vague teacher I have ever met.

Romance section, she was very unclear about her expectations and she wasn't very helpful. I went in to get help on an essay and she only made one correction and then gave me a C on the paper after I made that correction citing all kinds of stuff that was totally fixable if she had gone over it with me in the first place.

(Romantic literature) She's kind of spacey in her teaching, and made the class MUCH harder than a 3 credit hour entry-level english class, even for an honors section. She's definitely helpful though, especially if you seek her out and get on her good side.
Completely unclear in what she desires from students.  Assignments everyday to turn in, often saves criticism for grading and not helpful when you are in the process of writing a paper.
Rude and mean, has no respect for students of color

This professor does not invite friendly learning in the classroom. She will randomly call on students and if they are not sure about the answer she will laugh in their face. She won't let you have your laptop out to take notes, and god forbid you go to the bathroom, she will call you a distraction. Don't take GEOG 100 with her or you're screwed.

Cheong's class was all over the place. I frequently wondered what we were supposed to be getting out of the lectures and how they pertained to the exams and quizzes. Difficult to get a hold of, and no leniency for absences, even with good reason.
No clue whats even going on in this class assignments quizzes and tests are all difficult. Makes the course extremely hard to follow absolute garbo class
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Many of the lecture slides were typed in during the lecture which to me is frustrating because if the professor isn't prepared why should I waste my time? However, all tests (3 question essay format) are online and open book which is nice, but when you miss points on them, she doesn't give you feedback as to what you did wrong. But still an easy A
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: She was a decent professor, mostly because of easy quizzes. The 4 quizzes were all open book, with almost unlimited amounts of time. The 3 exams were around 50% questions taken directly (copied/pasted) from the quizzes, and the rest easy questions from the slideshows she posts online. The only thing difficult was the final 5 page paper.
Lecture and text do not cover tests. Confuse what she aimed for in the class.

She was a really good teacher. If you go to class, take notes, or just check the power points that she posts, the class is really easy. it's a basic geography course, so it's not challenging at all. She has three tests and two assignments. All are very simply and self-explanatory if you attend class. She's a really good teacher. I had no problem.

Class was boring, but going will get you a better grade (both for participation points and on tests).  It's hard to understand what she wants you to know for tests, so pay attention to what she spends time on in class and read the textbook!  Good grade if you just do the work, and she doesn't ask for much work.  She posts grades on blackboard.
She's not that bad.  Sometimes the class is so boring I want to kill myself, but every once in a while she is funny.  Class is mostly tests and one presentation or paper.

She is awful, can barely speak english and is horribly boring in class. She will put a sentence on a slide and talk about the complete opposite. The tests are awful, and cover nothing she has talked about or what she tells you to read in the book. Overall worst class I have ever taken. If you can steer very clear of this teacher.
Not a very good teacher. Isn't clear on what she expects. Reading the book is useless. The powerpoints are semi decent. Overall awful class.

She knows decent English and is sometimes funny. The class drags and her material can get a little complicated. Tests are difficult, but if you ask for help, she has no problem. Overall, pretty solid.

Dude is a straight chiller. His lectures can be all over the place but he still keeps them engaging. The class was structured around the students schedule and we were graded strictly annotations. Super easy and worth it for his stories.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He rambles so much in lectures. Better to skip him and take anyone else. The readings are soo dense as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things
Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Prof. Smith wasn't a very present professor in SOC105. The version I took was asynchronous, and the only real discussion with him I had was VIA the personalized papers (yes, for EVERY student). That being said, suuuuuper long readings but infrequent open-note tests. You're gonna be going back to the syllabus a LOT for due dates and guidelines.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: The negative reviews aren't wrong, but Smith's teaching is what you make of it. His lectures appear to digress often, making them seem disorganized at first. You may have to ask him to clarify the big picture, but the point is usually there. Smith makes the class easy, interesting, and refers to cool bits of history and pop culture. I learned a lot
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very conservative.  An imposed  regurgitation learning experience . A very kind and understanding human being. I had a problem adjusting to his beliefs especially since he imposed them on us. My question was how can any discourse in the modern science of group interactions  be absent of thesis  from women and  non westerners.
He's really boring and hard to follow sometimes.  It's really not necessary to go to the lectures to get an A as long as you read and go to discussion.

If you do the readings it's an easy A. You don't have any homework but he does give out True/False questions for the readings for you to study but doesn't give you the answers. It was hard to keep up with his lectures when he's writing. Boring class. The readings aren't that hard, plus it's a huge lecture class so you can just ask anyone for help

If you pay attention in lecture, and get the answers for the readings. it's an easy A. He is excited about what he teaches, but its kidna boring. He also likes teaching with different types of media; he uses youtube, and slideshows, and movie clips and music. Those make it a bit more interesting.
extremely boring, but easy class. Dont have to go. Half the class is from the reading and the other from lecture notes you can get from one of the other 800 people in the class.
Extremely boring man. However, this class is fairly simple if you do the readings

Horrible at teaching, but easy class.  he doesnt use powerpoints, and he is very dry and boring and rambles.  but his tests are pretty easy if you dont try and the final is even easier.  dont bother going to class.
good teacher overall but, he shows random videos that have nothing to do what you are actually learning...

Lectures can be boring, but he seems to care that his students do well. Tests aren't bad at all if you take decent notes during class and do the reading assignments. He's making our final very stress-free.
Very boring but all tests are True and False so fairly easy class. A lot of reading so take with friends to split it up.
He is very hard to pay attention to...Most of the time I'm not sure what he is even saying. The TA's for the class are awesome though.

Dr. Smith is a genius in the truest sense.  If you speak to him personally for more than 5 minutes, he will tell you things that will make your jaw drop.  That said, he's a bit eccentric and often goes off on tangents or things that suddenly spark him as interesting.  His Elements of Soc class may be a little dull, but is easy.  Theory=awesome
The class is easy if you want to do the work. The tests are all True and False. Have a buddy to compare answers and you should do good in the class.

Excellent class, one of the best speakers I've had in my liberal arts education.  Doesn't need or use powerpoint, very well structured curriculum with direct source readings.  HIGHLY recommended if you're interested in behavior in any way.

Smith is just very boring but it is a very easy class. It is hard to stay awake and he goes off on many tangents but the TA's are very helpful in discussions and all the tests are T/F. So it's easy if it's just a prerequisite for whatever you are studying.

This class was very easy. All you have to do to succeed is pay attention in lecture. The tests are 25 reading questions (T/F) and 25 lecture questions. The reading questions are word-for-word the ones he gives you so you just have to memorize the trues and the final is all reading questions. (T/F).

Dr. Smith is a very fair and helpful teacher. His lectures can seem confusing at first but as the semester goes on you'll realize his class is actually very straight forward. Do the readings, somewhat pay attention in class,go to the discussion classes and you'll have an A

Dr. Smith is a complete genius; however, his lectures are extremely boring. I find myself on Facebook instead of taking notes.  Go to the discussion sections, do the readings, study the night before and you can easily pull an A on the tests.  Just memorize the reading questions and look over your notes.

His class topics can be boring to 10 minute attention spands (which is most students). But if you are a curious person, and seek to understand some of the world's core issues that have concerned the brightest minds, then you will find this professor enlightening. His lectures are unstructured & w/o formal outlines. Best to structure your own notes

Class was super boring... If i would have been attentive i would have got an A.. but just did the study guides and got a B+. Very easy class and discussion sections help out a lot. Do the reviews and u are golden

Bring a pillow you just might fall asleep. Everytime his mouth opens my eyes close. Boring lectures that Dr. Smith really seems to enjoy. I learned nothing the entire semester. A  waste of time though you should attend and take good notes. W/effort hard not to get a C. For a good grade read everything & study. YouTube Shark Attacks College 2 c him.
T/F tests. Only 50 questions and he gives you the reading questions that are on the test. You must attend lecture b/c half the questions come from lecture and the other half reading.
He was HARD! He didn't lecture by an outline so you never knew what was easy and what was hard. He didn't want any interaction witn students, seemed like he didn't care at all

Ridiculously easy A. Exams are T/F. All you need to do is read the material and answer the T/F questions he posts online. Attendance during lectures is helpful because the exams cover part of them. Discussion sections are pretty much useless-- they don't reinforce anything, but attendance at them is still required.

A very good professor.. His lectures were mixed between interesting, and boring.. I really did not like the discussion sections, really did not do anything to help reinforce the lectures in them.  His tests were easy, and he was very helpful outside of class.  This class is an easy A or B.  However, do not talk during his lectures!

Very very boring lecturer. I dreaded going to his class. The tests are all true and false, but he words the questions to make them somewhat difficult. The final was easy, but other than that the class was pretty difficult. Not an easy A.

The class was EXTREMELY boring but so easy. His tests are 50 true/false questions so the tests take less than ten minutes. And he does have a weird thing about always hearing whispering coming from the left side... even though no one else can hear it!

Good Teacher.  He is pretty clear about what he wants you to know.  But, he is somewhat monotone, which allows you to easily lose you attention in a 1000 person lecture hall.  He also has this thing about whispering!

I don't know what these other people are thinking, but I found his class interesting (maybe I am the minority on this one).  And my discussion teacher was hott.  She looks like the sister from Knocked up.

Is extremely boring; however, is an expert on genocide and war crimes - can be an extremely interesting person to talk to. I recommend doing the reading but also, visiting him - he's a pretty cool guy to talk to.
this guy is boring. annoying. fustrating. dull. arogant. repetitive.

Prof. Smith is very intelligent, really knows what he's talking about. Assigns somewhat challenging readings that do get lengthy and boring. As long as you listen in class - he'll repeat main points countlessly - and answer the reading questions; you'll be set for the tests. All in all an interesting class
Easy class, but this professor is boring as hell.  Just do the readings and and review questions and you're set

He was the worst teacher ever...boring as hell. But you didn't even have to go to class to get an "A." All you had to do was study for an hour the night before and memorize the T/F questions and you were money! Good luck...Highly recommend for anyone and everyone haha!

boring class. boring guy. hates whisperers...will call them out on their whispering and it is extremely distracting!!! just study the T/F questions and the class is a breeze. also he repeats the same topics over and over...just a warning

this class is kind of ridiculous he picks the most boring readings and talks about them in all his lectures.  The good thing about this class is that you can easily get a good grade just by using common sence.  I honestly dont think I learned ne thing this semester.  He also is psycho about having dead silence during lecture (dont whisper)

He is one of the worst teachers i've ever had, and this was one of the worst classes i've ever taken. I absolutely hated going to ever lecture, but you need to in order to pass the tests. He is very confusing, unclear, lame, and SO boring...but the class is easy to pass---just memorize the T/F questions, and study your notes---you should do just fi
Very pedantic. Doesn't like whispering. "You, over there. I don't mean to single you out, but you're whispering. Cut it out!"

Easy A class!  To get an A, all you have to do is answer and memorize the reading question and class notes.  If the class were not so easy, this class would be torture.  Lectures are very boring and impersonal.  While sitting in the front row the entire semester, he did not once make eye eontact with me.  Also dont whisper cause he hates that!!!!
He is soooooo...BORING!!! the TA's are ok. You don't even have to attend to get an A in the class. Just read the readings online and memorize the questions.

He is a great teacher who hates whispering. Even though the lectures are rather boring Dr. Smith is still one of the nicest teachers that I have ever had. His tests are not to hard and he gives an abundance of attendance points, if you want to work it isnt the toughest thing to do getting an A.
Wonderful prof!!!
Easiest class i have ever taken.  Tests were a joke.  He is very kind, lectures were boring, but if you got the jist of it there is no reason you shouldn't get an A.
He was a really nice guy. Tests are extremely easy and an easy A.

Easiest class ever but BORING. Goes on and on and on about the same thing. We had fun counting the number of times he said the same word during lecture. Tests are easy though as long as you go to class and find the answers to the reading questions and memorize them you'll ace it.

Class is EASY.  Lectures are boring as hell as he repeats the same stuff over and over and over.  All you have to do is take his notes and study them and find the answers in the reading.  One of the easiest A's at KU
As long as you go to class, do the study guides, and look over your notes, you can ace this class.  My GTA was very helpful too.
