GREAT TEACHER!! He makes the class very enjoyable. You should take his class if possible.
Loved this instructor! Great at bringing up interesting topics. Kept the class engaged for the most part. Would recommend him to anyone who needs an extra math class. Take this class!
What a grade-A mazing instructor! So intelligent and fun, makes the course very enjoyable.

Very good course. I'm not very good at math, however he definitely worked to make it both enjoyable and understandable. Anytime I needed help, I just sent him an email, and he responded very quickly. Highly recommended!

Hört niemand zu und tut keinen ausreden lassen. Gruppenarbeit gibt's auch null und kack Benotung.
Ich frag mich wie der Lehrer ist
Digga er hat es nach deutschland irgendwie geschafft

reviews.comment: He is a really inspirational and I'd love to have him as my teacher again! Thanks for all the classes, Zsolt!

I did not enjoy taking this class with Zsolt. He is willing to help and enthusiastic about the material, but in class and while talking, he is very vague. I went multiple times and still did very poorly in the class. He didn't TEACH at all. We just sat in circles talking about what we read (or didn't, most of the time). Daily quizzes. Hard tests.

Zsolt put so much personal time into helping students, and was joyous about exploring the material with us. He could put a fascinating spin on the most boring pieces. He's a clear/fair grader who genuinely wants to help you do better. Show up, take advantage of his generosity and enjoy.

I loved zsolt. His expectations were very clear, there were no surprises in his class. The coursework was moderately difficult, but he was completely willing to help students succeed. Probably my favorite teacher freshman year.

This was by far the easiest class I've taken so far. Granted, English is my forte, but as long as you impress him with your first essay and it looks like you've actually tried, he won't give you anything lower than a B on any paper, no matter how bad.
GET OUT!!!

Zsolt is totally awesome and the best teacher I had my whole freshman year. I got a B in the class by watching the required videos on youtube..it's not hard. He's really funny too, and makes class fun to go to. 10 out of 10!
This guy is awful! He is foreign so he doesn't know how to speak english!!! I hated him more than anyone else ever and I think he should be fired.

MOST HORRIBLE TEACHER I HAVE EVER HAD. would go in for help and he still gave me to D's on both papers... when I had other teachers grade them and they were B's and A's. He has to have everything his ways and wont help you. His quizzes are the hardest things I have ever taken in my entire life. Do NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. switch teachers. horribleteach
He seems very unorganized, his quizzes are literally like tests (get one around 1X in maybe 2weeks)
THIS CLASS IS IMPOSSIBLE

Incredibly hard to get an A in this class. He is the hardest grader I've ever had.  I've never done so bad in an english class.  Very unclear about his expectations on assignments and papers and contradicts himself about the expectations that he gives.  Get out while you still can!
Awful class... very unclear and hard to please. Seriously get out of this class!

I was stretched to the limit financially, emotionally and as an artist creating buildings that have shaped my own career as an engineer. She's brilliant!!! After I took a class with her I signed up for the next one.

She knows what she is talking about.  The projects are huge and expensive, definitely, but they are always worthwhile.  When final jury comes and the projects look amazing, you'll know why you signed up.  I highly recommend Zuzanna as a first-year studio or later.
No Comments

One of the most difficult and most expensive studios available to be taken at this school. Zuzanna should probably teach a graduate level studio with her expectations. However you will learn more from her than many others and she is extremely helpful! Just be ready to put in lots of time and money, and I hope you like to make really huge projects!
